descriptions.zh: 我们已成功与§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系的神秘外星人建立第一次接触。从今开始至知悉更详细的信息为止，我们将其代称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!。如果他们具有语言，我们必须进行破译才能建立交流。
descriptions.en: We have made first contact with mysterious aliens in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system. For now, we have code-named them §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, until we can find out more about them. If they possess a language, we must decipher it in order to establish communications.

descriptions.zh: 我们已成功与§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系的神秘外星人建立第一次接触。从今开始至知悉更详细的信息为止，我们将其代称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!。如果他们具有语言，我们必须进行破译才能评估他们的威胁程度。
descriptions.en: We have made first contact with mysterious aliens in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system. For now, we have code-named them §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, until we can find out more about them. If they possess a language, we should decipher it so that we can assess how much of a threat they pose.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经成功与§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系的未知外星人建立第一次接触。我们必须尽快衡量他们是否为有机体，以方便我们将它们的灭绝程序尽早提上日程。从现在起，我们代称他们为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!。
descriptions.en: We have made first contact with unknown aliens in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system. We must determine whether they are organic with all haste so that their termination can be scheduled, should it prove necessary. For now, they have been given the designation §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经成功与§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系的神秘外星人建立第一次接触。我们应当获取更多关于他们的信息以便确定他们是否是子个体的优质营养来源。从现在起，他们被代称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!。
descriptions.en: We have made first contact with mysterious aliens in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system. We should find out more about them so that we may decide whether they would be suitable nutrition for our drones. For now, they have been given the designation §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经成功与§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系的神秘外星人建立第一次接触。我们应当获取更多关于他们的信息以便确定他们是否是我们的下一个净化目标。从现在起，他们被代称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!。
descriptions.en: We have made first contact with mysterious aliens in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system. We should find out more about them so we can assess whether they should be our next targets for extermination. For now, they have been given the designation §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经成功与§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系的神秘外星人建立第一次接触。我们应当探明他们是否可以和我们进行沟通，如果是的话，是否应当投入我们自身的一部分来翻译他们的语言。从现在起，他们被代称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!。
descriptions.en: We have made first contact with mysterious aliens in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system. We should find out whether they are capable of communicating with us, and dedicate a portion of ourselves to translating their language if this proves to be the case. For now, they have been given the designation §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经成功与§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系的新生命形式建立第一次接触。我们应当探明他们是否可以和我们进行沟通。如果可以，我们也许该以自我的一种更小的部分出现——例如一个化身之类的。

在对其有更深入了解之前，他们被代称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!。
descriptions.en:
We have made first contact with mysterious new lifeforms in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system. We do not yet know if they are capable of communicating with us. If they cannot do so, we may be compelled to present a smaller portion of ourselves - an avatar, of sorts.

Until we can learn more about these aliens, we have named them the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经成功与§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系的神秘外星人建立第一次接触。我们应当探明他们是否可以和我们进行沟通，如果是的话，是否应当投入我们的翻译算法来破解他们的语言。从现在起，他们被代称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!。
descriptions.en: We have made first contact with mysterious aliens in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system. We should find out whether they possess a method of communication we can parse, and dedicate our translation algorithms to decoding it if this proves to be the case. For now, they have been given the designation §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!.

options.script: name = INTERESTING

descriptions.zh: 尽管我们尚未从位于§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系的神秘宇宙飞船处获取太多情报，当前最有力的假说——根据其自身的行为以及它发射的尚未破解的信号里暗含的模式——是这艘舰船属于某个未知的§H太空文明§!。我们正全力破解他们的语言，希望能够尽早建立沟通。
descriptions.en: Although we have been unable to discover much about the mysterious vessel in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system, the most convincing current hypothesis - based upon its behavior and the patterns of the still undecipherable signals we have intercepted from it - is that it belongs to a previously unknown §Hspacefaring civilization§!. We are redoubling our efforts to translate their language so that communications can be established.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { first_contact_default_desc = yes }

descriptions.zh: 在§H[This.System.GetName]§!中跟踪着未确认身份的航天器的信号的同时，我们已命令附近所有部队按照标准议定进入高度戒备状态。情报部门正在试图利用那一点点少的可怜的数据分析这个妖怪，但至少我们能感觉到其有超空间航行能力，而是否具有攻击能力则未可知。或许这可能是我们与一个新的外星文明的第一次接触，我们应该采取一些措施来破解他们的通讯。
descriptions.en: Following the sighting of unidentified spacecraft in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system, all forces in the vicinity have been ordered to assume a heightened state of readiness as per standard protocol. Intelligence is still analyzing what little data we have on the bogey, but it appears capable of hyperspace travel. Offensive capabilities remain unknown. As this likely represents our first contact with a new alien civilization, we should take steps to decipher their communications.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { first_contact_militarist_desc = yes }

descriptions.zh: 我们还不能确定在§H[This.System.GetName]§!观察到的这个神秘的宇宙飞船的起源。由于这很可能是我们第一次接触一个以前未知的外星文明，我们必须避免任何可能被误解为威胁或挑衅的行为。如果他们的语言被翻译，我们有希望与他们建立和平的关系。
descriptions.en: We have not yet been able to determine the origin of the mysterious spacecraft we spotted in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system. Since this is likely our first contact with a previously unknown alien civilization, we must avoid any actions that could be misinterpreted as threatening or provocative. If their language is translated, we can hopefully establish a peaceful relationship with them.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { first_contact_pacifist_desc = yes }

descriptions.zh: 我们仍在收集据报告位于§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系的外星人飞船的数据。很可能这艘船是一个之前未知的外星文明的使者。我们必须确定他们已经跟随了灵魂的恩典，或者说他们是邪恶的代理人。我们要做的第一件事是领悟他们的语言并了解他们的信仰系统。
descriptions.en: We are still gathering data on the alien spacecraft that was reported in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system. If this vessel is an emissary of a previously unknown alien civilization, as seems likely, we must determine if they go with the grace of the spirits, or if they are agents of wickedness. The first step will be to divine their language and the nature of their belief system.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { first_contact_spiritualist_desc = yes }

descriptions.zh: 对于在§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系发现的不明飞行器的调查仍在进行当中，但是由于收集到消息的不足使得我们无法对船只的来源做出确切的假设。既然这似乎已经牵涉到了一个先前不为我们所知的外星文明，我们应当尽力截获他们的通讯以启动对于他们语言的破译。
descriptions.en: The inquiry into the unidentified spacecraft that was observed in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system continues, but insufficient data has been collected to make an informed hypothesis as to the exact origin of the vessel. Since we are likely dealing with a representative of a previously unknown alien civilization, efforts should be made to intercept their communications and begin a comprehensive analysis of their language.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { first_contact_materialist_desc = yes }

descriptions.zh: §H[This.System.GetName]§!星系发出了警报，在该星系中我们发现了一艘肯定属于异种的飞船正在开展什么隐秘的行动。该飞船的确切意图尚不明确，但其似乎是一个异种大型政治组织的代表。先对这些生物的数据进行收集或许更加明智一些，这样的话我们就可以更好地确定这项威胁的实质及其具体的影响范围。
descriptions.en: Alarming reports from the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system, where we monitored the insidious activities of what can only be some manner of xeno spacecraft. The vessel's exact purpose remains unknown, but it is likely an agent of a larger xeno political entity. It might be wise to gather more data on these creatures, so that we can better ascertain the exact scope and nature of the threat.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { first_contact_xenophobe_desc = yes }

descriptions.zh: 对于位于§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系中一艘未知船只的目击不断催生出各种各样的揣测。我们对该船只的设计完全不曾了解，这意味着我们很有可能是在和一个全新的外星文明进行第一次接触。除开知晓该飞船有能力进行超空间航行之外，我们对于这些迷人的造物一无所知。我们应当抽出更多精力来对其进行研究。
descriptions.en: The mysterious sighting of an unidentified ship in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system continues to invite speculation! Its design is completely unfamiliar to us, suggesting that we might be dealing with a new alien civilization and a possible first contact scenario. Aside from the fact that the alien spacecraft is clearly capable of hyperspace travel, we know next to nothing about these fascinating beings. No effort should be spared to find out more!
descriptions.condition: trigger = { first_contact_xenophile_desc = yes }

descriptions.zh: [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle]已经汇报了关于在§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系中发现的未知飞船的情况。其设计无法与我们先前的任何记录相匹配，这意味着我们正在与一个外星文明进行初次接触。在得到[This.Owner.GetRulerTitle]的允许后，我们得以开始分析我们已收集到的数据来破译其语言。
descriptions.en: The [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle] has been briefed on the unknown vessel that was reported in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system. Its design does not match anything in our records, suggesting that we are dealing with a possible first contact scenario with an alien civilization. With the permission of the [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle], we can begin an analysis of the data we have collected to see if their language can be translated.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { first_contact_authoritarian_desc = yes }

descriptions.zh: 公众们得知在§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系，也就是此前发现未知飞船的星系中，一场潜在的初次接触正在进行。早期获取的数据显示该飞船具有超空间航行的能力，似乎是来自于一个我们从未知悉的外星文明。来自政府各部门的代表正听取事态进展的简报，与此同时对其语言的破译也正在进行。
descriptions.en: The public has been informed of a potential first contact scenario in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system, where the presence of an unidentified spacecraft was registered. Early data suggests that this vessel is capable of hyperspace travel and likely originates from a previously unknown alien civilization. Representatives from all branches of the government are being briefed on this developing situation as well as our ongoing efforts to translate their language.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { first_contact_egalitarian_desc = yes }

label.zh: 想法子抢几个外星人，进行更加细致的调查。
label.en: Let's nab some of them for closer investigation.

tooltips.zh: §R我们会试图瘫痪并夺取它们的舰船。它们会对我们的行径十分愤怒。§!
tooltips.en: §RWe will attempt to disable and seize their vessel. They will likely be outraged at this course of action.§!

descriptions.zh: 看来那个所谓的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!属于一个未知的§H太空文明§!。尽管我们尚未获知他们来自太空的哪片宇域，但是他们的行为明显表明，这是智慧生命在活动：他们舰船中的一艘系统性地扫描了我们的恒星系，很明显是希望了解有关我们的更多信息。
descriptions.en: It appears that the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! are part of a previously unknown §Hspacefaring civilization§!. Although we have been unable to discover which sector of space they hail from, it is clear from their behavior that an alien intelligence is at work: one of their ships has been systematically scanning our systems, apparently in an effort to find out more about us.

descriptions.zh: 看来那个所谓的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!属于一个未知的§H太空文明§!。尽管我们尚未获知他们来自太空的哪片宇域，但是他们的行为明显表明，这是智慧生命在活动：他们舰船中的一艘系统性地扫描了我们的恒星系，很明显是希望了解有关我们的更多信息。我们正在采取所有可能的预防措施，防止他们获取任何敏感信息。
descriptions.en: It appears that the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! are part of a previously unknown §Hspacefaring civilization§!. Although we have been unable to discover which sector of space they hail from, it is clear from their behavior that an alien intelligence is at work: one of their ships has been systematically scanning our systems, apparently in an effort to find out more about us. We are taking every precaution to prevent them from finding out any sensitive information.

descriptions.zh: 看来那个所谓的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!属于一个未知的§H太空文明§!。尽管我们尚未获知他们来自太空的哪片宇域，但是他们的行为明显表明，这是智慧生命在活动：他们舰船中的一艘系统性地扫描了我们的恒星系，很明显是希望了解有关我们的更多信息。众多[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对当前的局势发展表示高度担忧，要求我们§H扣押§!这些无礼闯入的舰船，这样我们能够对其进行§H审问§!，而不用冒险让敏感信息落入它们之手。
descriptions.en: It appears that the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! are part of a previously unknown §Hspacefaring civilization§!. Although we have been unable to discover which sector of space they hail from, it is clear from their behavior that an alien intelligence is at work: one of their ships has been systematically scanning our systems, apparently in an effort to find out more about us. Many [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are highly concerned at this development and demand that we §Hseize§! the impudent vessel so that we can §Hinterrogate§! them at our leisure, without risking sensitive information falling into their hands.

descriptions.zh: 在最近一次不明飞船入侵§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系后，星系中的防卫系统依旧处于高度警戒状态。科研部门仍在分析我们掌握有关这艘船只少得可怜的数据，其攻击能力还是个未知数。由于这或许是我们首次接触到一个全新的外星文明，我们应当着手破译他们的通讯。
descriptions.en: Local system defense forces remain in a state of heightened readiness after the recent incursion of the unidentified spacecraft into the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system. Intelligence is still analyzing what little data we have on the bogey, but it appears capable of hyperspace travel. Offensive capabilities remain unknown. As this likely represents our first contact with a new alien civilization, we should take steps to decipher their communications.

在最近一次不明飞船入侵§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系后，星系中的防卫系统依旧处于高度警戒状态。科研部门仍在分析我们掌握有关这艘船只少得可怜的数据，其攻击能力还是个未知数。由于这或许是我们首次接触到一个全新的外星文明，我们应当着手破译他们的通讯。

我们正采取一切措施来阻止他们发现任何敏感信息。

We are taking every precaution to prevent them from finding out any sensitive information.

在最近一次不明飞船入侵§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系后，星系中的防卫系统依旧处于高度警戒状态。科研部门仍在分析我们掌握有关这艘船只少得可怜的数据，其攻击能力还是个未知数。由于这或许是我们首次接触到一个全新的外星文明，我们应当着手破译他们的通讯。

许多[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]正高度关注事态进展并要求我们拦截这艘无礼的飞船，这样我们就能在空闲时审讯他们而不必再继续承担敏感信息落入他们手中的风险了。
descriptions.en:
Local system defense forces remain in a state of heightened readiness after the recent incursion of the unidentified spacecraft into the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system. Intelligence is still analyzing what little data we have on the bogey, but it appears capable of hyperspace travel. Offensive capabilities remain unknown. As this likely represents our first contact with a new alien civilization, we should take steps to decipher their communications.

Many [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are highly concerned at this development and demand that we seize the impudent vessel so that we can interrogate them at our leisure, without risking sensitive information falling into their hands.

descriptions.zh: 位于§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系中神秘来访者的来源尚未被我们所查清。鉴于这有可能是一次与我们此前所未知的外星文明的初次接触，我们必须避免做出任何可能被误认为是威胁或是挑衅的行动。一旦他们的语言被成功翻译，我们就可以和平地与他们建立外交关系。
descriptions.en: The origin of our mysterious visitor in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system has yet to be determined. Since this is likely our first contact with a previously unknown alien civilization, we must avoid any actions that could be misinterpreted as threatening or provocative. If their language is translated, we can hopefully establish a peaceful relationship with them.

descriptions.zh: 横穿§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系的外星飞船现在正处于我们的调查之中。如果这艘飞船属于一位来自此前我们尚不知道的外星文明的使者的话，说实话看上去挺像的，我们就必须确定他们究竟是追随了灵魂之恩典的人还是已经成为了投靠恶灵的化身。要做的第一件事就是领悟他们的语言并知晓其信仰的本质。
descriptions.en: The alien spacecraft that crossed into our space in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system is still being investigated. If the vessel is an emissary of a previously unknown alien civilization, as seems likely, we must determine if they go with the grace of the spirits, or if they are agents of wickedness. The first step will be to divine their language and the nature of their belief system.

The alien spacecraft that crossed into our space in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system is still being investigated. If the vessel is an emissary of a previously unknown alien civilization, as seems likely, we must determine if they go with the grace of the spirits, or if they are agents of wickedness. The first step will be to divine their language and the nature of their belief system.

Many [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are highly concerned at this development and demand that we seize the impudent vessel so that we can interrogate them at our leisure, without risking sensitive information falling into their hands.

descriptions.zh: 对于穿过我们§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系的未知飞船的调查仍在继续，但我们没有收集到多少数据以供我们推测其来自何方。既然我们似乎是在和一个此前未知的外星文明的代表打交道，我们应当尽力截获其通讯并开始分析其语言。
descriptions.en: The inquiry into the unidentified spacecraft that penetrated our space in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system continues, but insufficient data has been collected to make an informed hypothesis as to the exact origin of this vessel. Since we are likely dealing with a representative of a previously unknown alien civilization, efforts should be made to intercept their communications and begin a comprehensive analysis of their language.

It might be wise to gather more data on these creatures, so that we can better ascertain the exact scope and nature of this new threat.

descriptions.zh: 在此前传感器确认某不明飞船的§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系中，兴奋的浪潮一浪高过一浪！来访飞船的设计对于我们而言是完全陌生的，这意味着我们也许是在和一个全新的外星文明展开初次接触。除开知晓该飞船有能力进行超空间航行之外，我们对于这些迷人的造物一无所知。我们应当抽出更多精力来对其进行研究。
descriptions.en: Excitement still runs high in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system, where the presence of an unidentified ship was picked up on local sensors! The visitor's design is completely unfamiliar to us, suggesting that we may be dealing with a new alien civilization and a possible first contact scenario. Aside from the fact that the alien spacecraft is clearly capable of hyperspace travel, we know next to nothing about these fascinating beings. No effort should be spared to find out more!

Representatives from all branches of the government are being briefed on this developing situation, but we still have more questions than answers.

Many [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are highly concerned at this development and demand that we seize the impudent vessel so that we can interrogate them at our leisure, without risking sensitive information falling into their hands.

descriptions.zh: 看来那个所谓的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!属于一个未知的§H太空文明§!。尽管我们尚未获知他们来自太空的哪片宇域，但是他们的行为明显表明，这是智慧生命在活动：他们舰船中的一艘系统性地扫描了我们的恒星系，很明显是希望了解有关我们的更多信息。我们的军用哨兵机已经准备就绪，随时准备扣押这些舰船并§H审问§!——或者解剖——船里的外星人，而不用冒险让敏感信息落入它们之手。
descriptions.en: It appears that the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! are part of a previously unknown §Hspacefaring civilization§!. Although we have been unable to discover which sector of space they hail from, it is clear from their behavior that an alien intelligence is at work: one of their ships has been systematically scanning our systems, apparently in an effort to find out more about us. Our military drones stand ready to seize the vessel so that we can §Hinterrogate§! - or dissect - the aliens, without risk of sensitive data falling into their hands.

tooltips.zh: §R我们会试图瘫痪并夺取它们的舰船。它们会对我们的行径十分愤怒。§!
tooltips.en: §RWe will attempt to disable and seize their vessel. They will likely be outraged at this course of action.§!

label.zh: 没什么需要多虑的，完全没问题。
label.en: Nothing to be concerned about, surely.

descriptions.zh: 我们没花多久就发现，这个所谓的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!实际上属于某个大型§H太空文明§!。我们位于§H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!星系的探测器检测到大量星舰在[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]穿梭，其上生活了数量相当可观的人口，恒星系内部遍布各种各样的空间站。我们还截获了海量的通讯交通，但是目前尚未找到准确的翻译手段。
descriptions.en: It has quickly become apparent that the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! are in fact part of a major §Hspacefaring civilization§!. Our probes in the §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§! system have detected starships flitting between [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] which our scans show as supporting a considerable population, and various space stations across the system. We have been able to intercept considerable volumes of communication traffic, but so far accurate translations have proven elusive.

descriptions.zh: 我们没花多久就发现，这个所谓的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!实际上属于某个大型§H太空文明§!。我们位于§H[known_system.GetName]§!星系的探测器检测到大量星舰在恒星系内的许多空间站之间来回穿梭，一个大型军用空间站环绕着恒星，其作用类似于我们用于在恒星系宣称领地建立的哨站。我们还截获了海量的通讯交通，但是目前尚未找到准确的翻译手段。
descriptions.en: It has quickly become apparent that the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! are in fact part of a major §Hspacefaring civilization§!. Our probes in the §H[known_system.GetName]§! system have detected starships flitting between a number of space stations across the system, and there is a larger military station near the system's star that seems to act much like the outpost we build in the systems we claim. We have been able to intercept considerable volumes of communication traffic, but so far accurate translations have proven elusive.

descriptions.zh: 我们近期在§H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!的侦察已经确认其是一个属于§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的主要星系，以[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]为中心出现了大量的活动信号，这似乎是一个重要的基地。这极有可能是某个星际文明的一部分，但为了解码他们的军事通讯，我们需要先翻译他们的语言。
descriptions.en: Our recent recon pass in §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§! has identified it as a major §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! system, with a lot of activity centered around [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that is likely a significant base. It is increasingly probable that these aliens are part of an interstellar civilization but in order to decode their military transmissions, we first need to translate their language.

descriptions.zh: 侦察飞行机在§H[known_system.GetName]§!星系中行进时回报了一个重要§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的存在，至少有一个主要军事设施在其周围的轨道上公转。虽然我们尚未发现任何行星居住点，但一系列初步的目标已被列出，以防外星人被确认为敌对势力。我们还截获了一些有趣的信息，这也许会提供给我们足够的信息来翻译其语言。
descriptions.en: Reconnaissance flights conducted in the §H[known_system.GetName]§! system have reported a significant §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! presence, which includes at least one major military installation in orbit around the primary. Although we have not identified any planetary settlements of note, a preliminary target list is being put together in the event that the aliens prove hostile. Several interesting transmissions have been intercepted, which may provide us with enough insights to translate their language.

descriptions.zh: 我们确定了在§H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!星系中§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!势力大范围存在的事实，尤其是其中的[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]，其地表上覆盖着几处大型居住点。我们正和一个此前未曾知晓的外星文明打交道的事实愈发清晰。我方应当极为注意避免在这片被认为是他们的星系里做出任何挑衅式的行动。我们必须尽一切努力来翻译他们的语言，这样就可以向对方表达我们和平的意图了。
descriptions.en: The §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§! system has a large §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! presence - most notably [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] which houses several large settlements on its surface. It is becoming increasingly clear that we are dealing with a previously unknown alien civilization. We should take great care to avoid any provocative actions if we find ourselves in space they consider theirs. Every effort must be made to translate their language, so that we can declare our peaceful intentions.

descriptions.zh: §H[known_system.GetName]§!星系似乎已经被我们命名为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的外星文明所宣称占据了。尽管在该星系中尚未探测到任何行星定居点，但在其中有一个巨大的恒星基地在围绕星系中心公转。我方船只已经被要求谨慎行事以避免做出任何可能被误解为敌对的行为。一旦他们的语言被破译，我们就有希望与之建立和平的外交关系。
descriptions.en: The §H[known_system.GetName]§! system appears to have been claimed by the aliens we have designated as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. Although no significant planetary settlements have been detected, there is a large starbase orbiting the system's primary. Our ships have been instructed to conduct themselves with care and to avoid any actions which could be interpreted as hostile. If their language is translated, we can hopefully establish a peaceful relationship with them.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现存在有人居住星球的§H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!星系被确定是属于一个名为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的国家。[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]上散布着大量大型居住点。我们不清楚这个星系对他们而言有什么样的精神象征，但是这似乎是他们星际文明的一部分。我们应该尽我们所能来破译他们的语言。
descriptions.en: The inhabited world we have discovered in the §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§! system clearly belongs to the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. It is [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] with many large surface settlements. We know not what spiritual significance this system holds for these beings, but they seem to be part of an interstellar civilization. We should do what we can to decipher their language.

descriptions.zh: 被我们称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的外星势力似乎已经宣称§H[known_system.GetName]§!星系属于他们，其中至少有一个大型恒星基地围绕着中央恒星公转。在星系中尚未发现任何堡垒星球存在的证据，同时尚不清楚他们究竟是追随圣灵的步伐还是堕落为恶灵的奴仆。我们应当尽我们所能破译他们的语言。
descriptions.en: The aliens we refer to as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! seem to have laid claim to the §H[known_system.GetName]§! system, with at least one large starbase in orbit around the primary star. We have not seen any evidence of planetary bastions, and do not yet know whether these beings are favored by the spirits or depraved servants of darkness. We should do what we can to decipher their language.

descriptions.zh: §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!中有了一些有趣的发现，在那里一些神秘的交通信号引导我们找到了[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]，上面分布着数个大型外星定居点。我们确信这个星球属于名为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的国家，很可能是一个与我们一样的星际国家。他们的科技样本尚未被采集，但其科技水平似乎并没有比我方高多少。对他们语言的翻译工作仍在进行当中。
descriptions.en: An intriguing discovery has been made in §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!, where mysterious signal traffic led us to [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that is home to several large alien settlements. We are confident that this world belongs to the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, which is very likely a spacefaring civilization much like our own. Samples of their technology have not yet been procured, but it does not appear to be radically more advanced than our own. The translation of their language is still ongoing.

descriptions.zh: 在§H[known_system.GetName]§!星系中获取的数据证实了此处被我们称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的政治实体宣称占据的假设。星系中央有一个恒星基地围绕中央恒星公转，其可能是作为星系中通信及基础建设的中心，而且似乎还是我们所截获的大部分通信的来源。我们需要尽力分析这些通信并翻译他们的语言。
descriptions.en: Data gathered in the §H[known_system.GetName]§! system supports the hypothesis that it has been claimed by the political entity that we have designated as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. A central starbase orbits the primary and likely serves as an in-system communications and infrastructure hub - it appears to be the source of most of the transmissions we have intercepted in the system. An effort should be made to analyze these transmissions and translate their language.

descriptions.zh: §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!星系中浮现了一个异种行星巢穴！[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]上的生物像蝗虫一样覆盖侵染着这片土地。现在可以确定这些异种，也就是§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!，是一个星际文明，不受限制地在许多星球上肆意散布。这不会是一个令人愉悦的任务，但我们还是应该翻译他们的语言，这样我们才能完全了解他们的腐朽程度。
descriptions.en: A xeno planetary lair has been revealed in the §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§! system! The infestation is centered around [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that may well have been tainted beyond recovery. It is clear now that these xenos - the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! - are a spacefaring civilization that is spreading unchecked throughout the stars. It will not be a pleasant task, but their language should be translated so we may learn the full extent of their corruption.

descriptions.zh: §H[known_system.GetName]§!星系显然是一个属于异种的由§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!控制的巢穴，其中还有一个大型空间站围绕中央恒星公转。我方船员已被要求忽略所有通讯并与一切异星船只或是空间站保持安全距离，不管对方要干什么，以免他们被这些生物接触并伤害。如果我们能成功破译从星系中的恒星基地发出的通讯的话，那么接下我们或许就能翻译他们物种中用于交流的语言了。
descriptions.en: The §H[known_system.GetName]§! system is evidently a xeno lair, judging by the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! presence which includes a large space station orbiting the primary star. Our crews have been instructed to ignore all transmissions while keeping a safe distance from any alien ships or stations, lest they are corrupted by the touch of these creatures, whatever they may be. If we manage to decipher the transmissions emanating from the system's starbase, then perhaps we can translate what passes for a language among their kind.

descriptions.zh: 被我们标记为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的殖民地，甚至有可能是母星，被宣布在§H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!星系中发现。数个大型居民居住点分布在[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]的表面，吸引着我们的注意力。这项令人兴奋的发现让我们对这个属于某星际文明且迷人的外星种族有了进一步的了解。想想成功翻译他们的语言后我们会发现什么吧！
descriptions.en: A colony or perhaps even the homeworld of the aliens we have designated as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! has been reported in the §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§! system. Several large settlements are present on the surface of [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that caught our attention. This exciting discovery has taught us even more about these fascinating aliens, who are clearly part of a spacefaring civilization. Think of what else we might find out once their language has been translated!

descriptions.zh: §H[known_system.GetName]§!星系似乎已经被一个我们称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的外星势力所占据，不过星系中没有发现作为人口居住地的星球。一个大型恒星基地围绕着恒星旋转，显然是星系的中心枢纽。尽管我们正处在被认为是他们的星系中，但对与这些迷人的生物仍知之甚少。我们应该尽力去深入了解对方。
descriptions.en: The §H[known_system.GetName]§! system appears to have been settled by the aliens we refer to as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, although no planetary population centers have been sighted. A large starbase orbits the primary, serving as the system's central hub. Despite our presence in what they clearly consider to be their space, we know very little about these fascinating beings. No effort should be spared to find out more!

descriptions.zh: 扫描结果显示§H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!星系中似乎存在一个有人口居住的星球，即[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]，被一个叫做§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的外星势力所宣称拥有。这些外星人极有可能是一个拥有超空间航行能力的星际文明的一部分。因此，[This.Owner.GetRulerTitle]已经决定要将关于该星系的信息限制在政府高层内部以避免内部发生动乱。
descriptions.en: Scans have detected what appears to be an inhabited world in the §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§! system. It is [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that has been claimed by the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. These aliens are likely part of a spacefaring civilization capable of hyperspace travel. In light of this, the [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle] has decided to restrict information about the system to the upper echelons of the government to avoid civil unrest.

descriptions.zh: §H[known_system.GetName]§!星系中存在一个§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的大型基地，其中包括一个围绕恒星公转的空间站。尽管对其进行了反复扫描，但是我们还是无法了解其语言和指挥系统的具体性质。只要[This.Owner.GetRulerTitle]一声令下，我们就会集中力量来翻译他们的语言。
descriptions.en: There is a large §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! presence in the §H[known_system.GetName]§! system, which includes a central space station in orbit around the primary star. Despite repeated scans, knowledge of both their language and the exact nature of their chain of command eludes us. Unless the [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle] objects, we should make a concerted effort to translate their language.

descriptions.zh: 对深空的调查使我们偶然在§H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!星系中发现了一个已被栖居的星球。这颗星球归属于§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!，现在被认为是一个此前未知的星际文明。这个殖民地或母星是[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]，它位于星周宜居带内。希望他们的社会是一个以自由和个人自由为基石的进步社会，但我们必须先破译他们的语言才能找到答案。
descriptions.en: Deep space survey efforts have stumbled upon an inhabited world in the §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§! system. It belongs to the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, who are now believed to be a previously unknown interplanetary civilization. This colony or homeworld is [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that lies well within the circumstellar habitable zone. Hopefully their society is a progressive one based on liberty and individual freedoms, but we will have to translate their language to find out.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经在§H[known_system.GetName]§!系探测到一个显著的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!存在的信号——尽管从目前掌握到的情况而言，那里没有有定居点的星球，但有一个大型的太空装置围绕着该星系的主恒星运行。发言人告知公众，我们很可能偶然发现了一个属于先前未知的星际文明的哨站。在我们和他们交流之前，我们需要翻译他们的语言。
descriptions.en: We have detected a significant §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! presence in the §H[known_system.GetName]§! system - although there are no inhabited planets as far as we can tell, a large space installation of some sort orbits the system's primary star. Our elected officials have informed the public that we have most likely stumbled upon an outpost belonging to a previously unknown interstellar civilization. Before we can communicate with them, we'll need to translate their language.

label.zh: 想法子抢几个外星人，进行更加细致的调查。
label.en: Let's nab some of them for closer investigation.

tooltips.zh: 我们已经定位到了它们的母星系，我们可以试图§H绑架§!一些标本。
tooltips.en: As we have located their home systems, we may try to §Habduct§! specimens from there.

descriptions.zh: 似乎所谓的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!属于一个此前未知的§H游牧文明§!。他们并不会像我们一样在星球上定居，而是乘坐着巨大的方舟在太空中旅行，在我们的探测范围内就能看到至少一艘这样的方舟。目前为止他们的传输信号尚未得到翻译。
descriptions.en: It appears that the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! are part of a previously unknown §Hnomadic civilization§!. Rather than settling on any world they, like us, travel through space aboard great Arkships, at least one of which is visible within our sensor range. So far their transmissions have resisted all attempts at translation.

descriptions.zh: 似乎所谓的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!属于一个此前未知的§H游牧文明§!。他们并不会像我们一样在星球上定居，而是乘坐着巨大的方舟在太空中旅行，在我们的探测范围内就能看到至少一艘这样的方舟。目前为止他们的传输信号尚未得到翻译。我们在努力建立通讯的同时又格外谨慎，避免泄露敏感信息。
descriptions.en: It appears that the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! are part of a previously unknown §Hnomadic civilization§!. Rather than settling on any world they, like us, travel through space aboard great Arkships, at least one of which is visible within our sensor range. So far their transmissions have resisted all attempts at translation. We are being careful to avoid revealing any sensitive information while we work to establish communication.

descriptions.zh: 似乎所谓的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!属于一个此前未知的§H游牧文明§!。他们并不会像我们一样在星球上定居，而是乘坐着巨大的方舟在太空中旅行，在我们的探测范围内就能看到至少一艘这样的方舟。目前为止他们的传输信号尚未得到翻译。他们的方舟舰处在我方传感器范围内，并伴有数艘小型支援舰艇。许多[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]认为我们应当趁机夺取其中一艘。
descriptions.en: It appears that the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! are part of a previously unknown §Hnomadic civilization§!. Rather than settling on any world they, like us, travel through space aboard great Arkships, at least one of which is visible within our sensor range. So far their transmissions have resisted all attempts at translation. Their Arkship is accompanied by smaller support vessels within our sensor range. Many [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] argue we should move to seize one of the escort vessels while the opportunity presents itself.

descriptions.zh: 似乎所谓的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!属于一个此前未知的§H游牧文明§!。他们并不会像我们一样在星球上定居，而是乘坐着巨大的方舟在太空中旅行，在我们的探测范围内就能看到至少一艘这样的方舟。目前为止他们的传输信号尚未得到翻译。他们的方舟舰处在我方传感器范围内，并伴有数艘小型支援舰艇。我方军事力量已严阵以待，可在护卫舰仍处于拦截距离内时将其截获。
descriptions.en: It appears that the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! are part of a previously unknown §Hnomadic civilization§!. Rather than settling on any world they, like us, travel through space aboard great Arkships, at least one of which is visible within our sensor range. So far their transmissions have resisted all attempts at translation. Their Arkship is accompanied by smaller support vessels within our sensor range. Our military assets stand ready to intercept and capture the escort craft while they remain within reach.

tooltips.zh: §R我们会试图瘫痪并夺取它们的舰船。它们会对我们的行径十分愤怒。§!
tooltips.en: §RWe will attempt to disable and seize their vessel. They will likely be outraged at this course of action.§!

descriptions.zh: 所谓的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!似乎隶属于一个此前未知的§H星际文明§!。不寻常的是，他们似乎没有固定的母星，而是完全生活并旅行于数艘巨型舰船之上——我们暂将其归类为§H方舟舰§!。至少有一艘此类舰船正处于我方传感器范围内。他们的通讯信号尚未被破译，但我方的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]正致力于改变这一状况。
descriptions.en: It appears that the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! are part of a previously unknown §Hspacefaring civilization§!. Unusually, they appear to have no fixed homeworld, instead living and traveling entirely aboard enormous vessels we have tentatively classified as §HArkships§!. At least one such vessel is visible within our sensor range. Their transmissions remain undeciphered, but our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are working to change that.

descriptions.zh: 所谓的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!似乎隶属于一个此前未知的§H星际文明§!。不寻常的是，他们似乎没有固定的母星，而是完全生活并旅行于数艘巨型舰船之上——我们暂将其归类为§H方舟舰§!。至少有一艘此类舰船正处于我方传感器范围内。他们的通讯信号尚未被破译，但我方的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]正致力于改变这一状况。我们正在采取一切预防措施，防止他们在我们努力建立通讯期间获取任何有关我方的敏感信息。
descriptions.en: It appears that the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! are part of a previously unknown §Hspacefaring civilization§!. Unusually, they appear to have no fixed homeworld, instead living and traveling entirely aboard enormous vessels we have tentatively classified as §HArkships§!. At least one such vessel is visible within our sensor range. Their transmissions remain undeciphered, but our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are working to change that. We are taking every precaution to prevent them from learning anything sensitive about us while we work to establish communication.

descriptions.zh: 所谓的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!似乎隶属于一个此前未知的§H星际文明§!。不寻常的是，他们似乎没有固定的母星，而是完全生活并旅行于数艘巨型舰船之上——我们暂将其归类为§H方舟舰§!。至少有一艘此类舰船正处于我方传感器范围内。他们的通讯信号尚未被破译，但我方的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]正致力于改变这一状况。他们的方舟舰处在我方传感器范围内，并伴有数艘小型支援舰艇。许多[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]认为我们应当趁机夺取其中一艘。
descriptions.en: It appears that the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! are part of a previously unknown §Hspacefaring civilization§!. Unusually, they appear to have no fixed homeworld, instead living and traveling entirely aboard enormous vessels we have tentatively classified as §HArkships§!. At least one such vessel is visible within our sensor range. Their transmissions remain undeciphered, but our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are working to change that. Their Arkship is accompanied by smaller support vessels within our sensor range. Many [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] argue we should move to seize one of the escort vessels while the opportunity presents itself.

descriptions.zh: 所谓的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!似乎隶属于一个此前未知的§H星际文明§!。不寻常的是，他们似乎没有固定的母星，而是完全生活并旅行于数艘巨型舰船之上——我们暂将其归类为§H方舟舰§!。至少有一艘此类舰船正处于我方传感器范围内。他们的通讯信号尚未被破译，但我方的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]正致力于改变这一状况。他们的方舟舰处在我方传感器范围内，并伴有数艘小型支援舰艇。我方军事力量已严阵以待，可在护卫舰仍处于拦截距离内时将其截获。
descriptions.en: It appears that the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! are part of a previously unknown §Hspacefaring civilization§!. Unusually, they appear to have no fixed homeworld, instead living and traveling entirely aboard enormous vessels we have tentatively classified as §HArkships§!. At least one such vessel is visible within our sensor range. Their transmissions remain undeciphered, but our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are working to change that. Their Arkship is accompanied by smaller support vessels within our sensor range. Our military assets stand ready to intercept and capture the escort craft while they remain within reach.

tooltips.zh: §R我们会试图瘫痪并夺取它们的舰船。它们会对我们的行径十分愤怒。§!
tooltips.en: §RWe will attempt to disable and seize their vessel. They will likely be outraged at this course of action.§!

descriptions.zh:
我们试图学习§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的知识，但截止到当前一切都是徒劳。我们很容易就发现了他们显然属于某个十分先进的外星文明，但是除此之外我们§H一无所知§!，看来他们花了很大的努力阻止我们或者其他窃听者截获来自他们的任何信号。

我们目前为止仅仅截获了他们语言的很小一片段。然而，根据我们手头的情报，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]很确信，如果能够获取更大规模的样本，§H破解§!对方的通讯不是问题。
descriptions.en:
Our attempts to learn more about the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! have so far been in vain. While we were easily able to ascertain that they clearly form part of a technologically advanced alien civilization, further facts have proven §Helusive§! as they seem to be going to considerable effort to prevent us and any other eavesdroppers from intercepting any signals from them.

We have therefore only managed to intercept small fragments of their language so far. However, from the glimpses we have gleaned, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are confident that they will be able to §Hdecipher§! their communications if we can just acquire a greater sample size.

descriptions.zh:
我们试图学习§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的知识，但截止到当前一切都是徒劳。我们很容易就发现了他们显然属于某个十分先进的外星文明，但是除此之外我们§H一无所知§!，看来他们花了很大的努力阻止我们或者其他窃听者截获来自他们的任何信号。

我们目前为止仅仅截获了他们语言的很小一片段。然而，根据我们手头的情报，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]很确信，如果能够获取更大规模的样本，§H破解§!对方的通讯不是问题。一份更加激进的信息收集——也就是说§H骇入§!——提案被提交了上来，要是被它们发现，肯定不会善罢甘休。
descriptions.en:
Our attempts to learn more about the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! have so far been in vain. While we were easily able to ascertain that they clearly form part of a technologically advanced alien civilization, further facts have proven §Helusive§! as they seem to be going to considerable effort to prevent us and any other eavesdroppers from intercepting any signals from them.

We have therefore only managed to intercept small fragments of their language so far. However, from the glimpses we have gleaned, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are confident that they will be able to §Hdecipher§! their communications if we can just acquire a greater sample size. A proposal has been drawn up for somewhat more aggressive information gathering - some may call it §Hhacking§! - but they will surely not take kindly to it should they detect it.

label.en: They are wise to be cautious.
They are wise to be cautious.
We must find out their secrets.

tooltips.zh: §R我们会试图骇进它们的数据库来寻找有关它们的更多情报。如果它们发现了我们的行径，它们肯定不会就此善罢甘休。§!
tooltips.en: §RWe will attempt to hack into their databanks to find out more about them. If they detect our attempts, they will likely be angered by this course of action.§!

descriptions.zh:
§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!显然非常希望与我们建立通讯，对方向我们发送了体量庞大的视听§H通讯数据§!，显然是来提供翻译他们语言的关键。

我们的专家坚信要不了多久我们就能和对方交流了。当然，我们得相信他们提供的翻译足够精准，不至于造成误解……那之后，我们才能够依据广泛迥异的经验性上下文对信息进行可靠的翻译。
descriptions.en:
The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! appear eager to establish communications with us, having sent a large audio and visual §Htransmission§! that appears to offer the key to translating their language.

Our experts are confident that we will be able to use this to learn to communicate with them soon. Of course, we will have to trust them that their offered translations are not misleading... and that we will be able to reliably interpret information presented from a surely vastly different experiential context.

descriptions.zh:
§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!显然非常希望与我们建立通讯，对方向我们发送了体量庞大的视听§H通讯数据§!，显然是来提供翻译他们语言的关键。

只要能把这些数据传递给我们的语言子个体，要不了多久我们就能和对方交流了。当然，我们得相信他们提供的翻译足够精准，我们能够准确地理解。
descriptions.en:
The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! appear eager to establish communications with us, having sent a large audio and visual §Htransmission§! that appears to offer the key to translating their language.

We will surely be able to communicate with them soon by feeding this data to our linguistic drones. Of course, we will have to trust them that their offered translations are sufficiently precise for us to accurately comprehend.

descriptions.zh:
§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!显然非常希望与我们建立通讯。对方向我们传输了海量的数据，这份数据似乎一部分包含一条（尚未解析）的§H信息§!，另一部分是包含大量视听§H讯息§!的秘匙——用于帮助我们翻译这条消息。

因为我们已经掌握了各种他们用于交流思想的旋律和和弦的框架，因此与这些生命形式沟通就更有可能了。现在破译他们想要的东西的重任就落到了我们身上。
descriptions.en:
The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! appear eager to establish communications with us. They have transmitted us large amounts of data that seem to be laid out partly as a (yet-undecipherable) §Hmessage§! and partly as a large body of §Hinformation§! with an audio and visual key that - presumably - is meant to help us translate it.

§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!显然非常希望与我们建立通讯，对方向我们发送了体量庞大的视听§H通讯数据§!，显然是来提供翻译他们语言的关键。

The likelihood of communicating with these lifeforms is high, as the harmonies displayed within their message seem to resonate with our own consciousness. Something about them still feels profoundly alien, however. The burden is on us to ensure we do not misread this apparent chorus of thought.

descriptions.zh:
§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!显然非常希望与我们建立通讯。对方向我们传输了海量的数据，这份数据似乎一部分包含一条（尚未解析）的§H信息§!，另一部分是包含大量视听§H讯息§!的秘匙——用于帮助我们翻译这条消息。

可与这些生命形式交流的预期极高，因为其信息的一致特性对我们自身的意识而言相对熟悉。然而，关于这种智能的部分仍旧极端陌生。确保不误解他们表观思维合唱的重任就落到我们身上了。
descriptions.en:
The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! appear eager to establish communications with us. They have transmitted us large amounts of data that seem to be laid out partly as a (yet-undecipherable) §Hmessage§! and partly as a large body of §Hinformation§! with an audio and visual key that - presumably - is meant to help us translate it.

The prospect of communicating with these lifeforms is now much more likely, as the uniform nature of their message feels similar to our own consciousness. Something about this intelligence still feels profoundly alien, however. The burden is on us to ensure we do not misinterpret their apparent chorus of thought.

descriptions.zh: 我们破解截获自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!信号的努力有了回报，我们终于达成了一项突破。尽管对于他们语言的掌握还不够熟练，我们还是设法与这个文明成功地开放了外交通道，后者现在被正式称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!。
descriptions.en: Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! have paid off, and we have finally made a breakthrough. While our mastery of their language may not be complete, we have managed to successfully open diplomatic channels with the civilization we now know to be the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!.

descriptions.zh: 我们破解截获自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!信号的努力有了回报，我们终于达成了一项突破。尽管对于他们语言的掌握还不够熟练，我们还是设法将这个文明识别成为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!，并在有必要时同对方进行交流。
descriptions.en: Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! have paid off, and we have finally made a breakthrough. While our mastery of their language may not be complete, we have managed to identify them as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! and are now able to communicate with them, should we ever feel the need.

descriptions.zh: 当我们开始翻译这些所谓的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!进一步送达的通讯消息，我们惊讶地发现：他们讲的正是我们自己语言的一类方言！在惊讶消退之后，通讯极为迅速地建立了起来，他们现在被正式称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!。
descriptions.en: As we began to intercept further communications from the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, a startling discovery was made: they were speaking in a strange dialect of one of our own languages! Once the surprise of this encounter was overcome, communications were swiftly established, revealing them to be the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!.

descriptions.zh: 我们在准备攻击[This.ContactCountry.GetName]时有了一个了不得的发现：他们竟然是[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！当我们发现他们正在说着我们的一种陌生方言的时候，敌对行为立即被取消并且快速建立了联系，这表明了他们其实是§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!。
descriptions.en: As we stood poised to attack the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], a remarkable discovery was made: they are [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Once we realized that they were speaking a strange dialect of one of our own languages, hostilities were called off and communications were swiftly established, revealing them to be the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!.

label.zh: 兴奋——我们找到了自己失落的同族！
label.en: Rejoice - for we have found our lost kin!

label.zh: 希望我们之间的血缘纽带能够导向友谊。
label.en: Hopefully our kinly ties will lead to friendship.

label.zh: 也许我们应该继续攻击他们……
label.en: Perhaps we should still attack them...

label.zh: 亲情并不一定就意味着友情。保持警惕。
label.en: Kinship doesn't imply friendship. Stay vigilant.

descriptions.zh: 当我们将自己的处理器转为翻译从被记作§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的未知外星人截获的通讯信号时，我们惊讶地发现：他们同样也隶属于某个机械智能！尽管他们的程式和我们在各种方面都大不一样，其语言建立于大量不同的有机体语言基础之上，然而他们的语言和我们有着类似的语素假设。结果，我们只花了几瞬的功夫就解密了他们的用语程式，开始进行基础的交流，他们现在被正式称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!。
descriptions.en: As we turned our processors to interpreting the communications we have intercepted from the unknown aliens designated as §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, a startling discovery was made: they too belong to a machine intelligence! Although their programming varies considerably from our own, being based on a vastly different organic language, it is nevertheless built upon similar key assumptions. As a result, it was only a matter of time before we could decode their programming parlance sufficiently for rudimentary communications to be established, revealing them to be the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!.

descriptions.zh: -当我们将处理器切换为翻译来自未知外星人——被我们标记为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!——的通信时，我们发现了一个惊人的事实：他们也属于一种机械智能！他们的通信协议与我们的非常相似，软件兼容性使我们能够迅速建立通信。相似之处还延伸到其他领域，可以说我们的机械智能可以被视为他们代码库的一个分支。只有一个合理的解释。
descriptions.en: As we turned our processors to interpreting the communications we have intercepted from the unknown aliens designated as §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, a startling discovery was made: they too belong to a machine intelligence! Their communication protocols are remarkably similar to ours, and software compatibility allowed us to swiftly establish communications. The similarities extend to other areas, to the point our machine intelligence could be considered a fork of their codebase. There's only one plausible explanation.

descriptions.zh:
我们解码收集自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!信号的努力终见收获，我们终于能够和现在被称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!的文明打开外交通讯频道了。

值得注意的是，他们似乎完全不具有对于我们[This.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]物种而言自然而然的个体概念。事实上，单个[This.ContactCountry.GetAdj]“[This.ContactCountry.GetIndividualName]”没有自由意志和任何思想，他们不过是§H“[This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName]”§!的走卒罢了。他们是在如此严格的控制之下，我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]推测[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的进化依赖于集体智慧，没有了集体智慧他们便无法生存。
descriptions.en:
Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! have paid off, and we are finally able to open diplomatic channels with the civilization we now know to be the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!.

Remarkably, they appear to completely lack the concept of individuality that is inherent in the [This.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] species. Indeed, the individual [This.ContactCountry.GetAdj] "[This.ContactCountry.GetIndividualName]" has no free will or thought whatsoever and is a mere pawn of the §H"[This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName]"§!. Far from chafing under such tight control, our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] speculate that the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have evolved to depend on this collective intelligence and would not be able to survive without it.

label.zh: 我们应该研究他们——把从他们那学到的这套用在我们自己的工人上！
label.en: We should study them - and apply the findings to our own workers!

label.zh: 有意思的物种。我们必须进一步研究这样一个物种是怎样的。
label.en: A fascinating species. We must find out how such a phenomenon is possible.

label.zh: 我们会把他们清理干净。

descriptions.zh:
我们解码收集自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!信号的努力终见收获，我们终于能够和现在被称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!的文明打开外交通讯频道了。

值得注意的是，他们是由一个单一的、强大的人工智能所指挥的全自动机器人文明。我们不知道任何他们创造者的迹象。我们只能假设他们在[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]发生智械危机的时候被清理干净了。
descriptions.en:
Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! have paid off, and we are finally able to open diplomatic channels with the civilization we now know to be the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!.

Remarkably, it turns out that they are a fully-autonomous robotic civilization led by a single, formidable AI. We have seen no sign of their creators. We can only assume that they were wiped out in the cataclysm from which the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] emerged.

descriptions.zh:
我们解码收集自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!信号的努力终见收获，我们终于能够和现在被称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!的文明打开外交通讯频道了。

值得注意的是，这些生物似乎是围绕某个分布式机械智能形成的合成人文明的一部分。在基本层面上，它们的意识本质与我们的并没有太大的不同。
descriptions.en:
Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! have paid off, and we are finally able to open diplomatic channels with the civilization we now know to be the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!.

Remarkably, it appears these beings are part of a synthetic civilization which has formed around a distributed machine intelligence. At a fundamental level, the nature of their consciousness is not too dissimilar from our own.

descriptions.zh:
我们解码收集自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!信号的努力终见收获，我们终于能够和现在被称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!的文明打开外交通讯频道了。

值得注意的是，他们是由一个单一的、强大的人工智能所指挥的全自动机器人文明。似乎这些机械对于挽救他们创造者的生命非常尽责。事实上[secondary_species.GetNamePlural]现在正被宠溺地作为“活体陈设”生活着，他们居住在被特殊设计的“有机庇护所”之中，在那里他们显然只需要做爱做的事情就好……
descriptions.en:
Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! have paid off, and we are finally able to open diplomatic channels with the civilization we now know to be the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!.

Remarkably, it turns out that they are a fully-autonomous robotic civilization led by a single, formidable AI. It appears that, though the machines are very much in charge, they have spared the lives of their creators. Indeed, the [secondary_species.GetNamePlural] now live their lives as pampered "Bio-Trophies" in specially designated "Organic Sanctuaries", where their only job is, apparently, to be themselves...

descriptions.zh:
我们解码收集自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!信号的努力终见收获，我们终于能够和现在被称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!的文明打开外交通讯频道了。

值得注意的是，他们是由一个单一的、强大的人工智能所指挥的全自动机器人文明。和我们最大的不同在于它们保留了有机物种[secondary_species.GetNamePlural]，并将其圈养在特有的庇护所之中。这些生物似乎是他们的创造者的后裔，出于某种我们无法理解的原因被娇惯保护着。
descriptions.en:
Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! have paid off, and we are finally able to open diplomatic channels with the civilization we now know to be the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!.

Remarkably, it turns out that they are a fully-autonomous robotic civilization led by a single, formidable AI. Where they differ most from us is in keeping an organic species, the [secondary_species.GetNamePlural], isolated in special sanctuaries. These beings appear to be descendants of the machines' creators, now coddled and preserved for reasons beyond our understanding.

descriptions.zh:
我们解码收集自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!信号的努力终见收获，我们终于能够和现在被称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!的文明打开外交通讯频道了。

值得注意的是，他们是由一个单一的、强大的人工智能所指挥的全自动机器人文明。似乎这些机械并不希望浪费他们创造者的潜能，即[secondary_species.GetNamePlural]。相反地，他们通过对创造者植入义体元件以将他们同化进自己的集体之中。令人不安的是，我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]找不到任何理由相信这种植入体对我们的物种会不起作用……
descriptions.en:
Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! have paid off, and we are finally able to open diplomatic channels with the civilization we now know to be the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!.

Remarkably, it turns out that they are a fully-autonomous robotic civilization led by a single, formidable AI. It appears that the machines did not wish to waste the potential of their creators, the [secondary_species.GetNamePlural]. Instead, they found a way to assimilate them into their collective by implanting them with cybernetics. Disturbingly, our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] see no reason to believe that such implants would not work on our own population...

descriptions.zh:
我们解码收集自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!信号的努力终见收获，我们终于能够和现在被称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!的文明打开外交通讯频道了。

值得注意的是，他们是由一个单一的、强大的人工智能所指挥的全自动机器人文明。似乎这些机械并不希望浪费他们创造者的潜能，即[secondary_species.GetNamePlural]。相反地，他们通过对创造者植入义体元件以将他们同化进自己的集体之中。幸运的是，我们认为我们的子个体并不会脆弱到被这种植入体所控制。
descriptions.en:
Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! have paid off, and we are finally able to open diplomatic channels with the civilization we now know to be the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!.

Remarkably, it turns out that they are a fully-autonomous robotic civilization led by a single, formidable AI. It appears that the machines did not wish to waste the potential of their creators, the [secondary_species.GetNamePlural]. Instead, they found a way to assimilate them into their collective by implanting them with cybernetics. Fortunately, we believe that our own drones possess no such vulnerability and would instead be rendered inoperative by the implants.

descriptions.zh:
我们解码收集自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!信号的努力终见收获，我们终于能够和现在被称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!的文明打开外交通讯频道了。

值得注意的是，他们是由一个单一的、强大的人工智能所指挥的全自动机器人文明。然而，他们找到了某种在自身结构中保留部分有机成分的理由：[secondary_species.GetNamePlural]，他们的固有意识似乎被机器思维所包容。

尽管它会对大多数有机物种构成威胁，但我们怀疑，如果这个义体人帝国试图同化我们，他们会发现我们的共生体不足以成为子个体。
descriptions.en:
Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! have paid off, and we are finally able to open diplomatic channels with the civilization we now know to be the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!.

Remarkably, it turns out that they are a fully-autonomous robotic civilization led by a single, formidable AI. They have, however, found means of retaining some organic elements to their structure: the [secondary_species.GetNamePlural], whose inherent consciousness appears subsumed by the machine mind.

Despite the threat this would pose to most organic species, we suspect our symbionts would prove to be inadequate drones if this cyborg empire ever attempted to assimilate us.

label.zh: 我们应该研究他们——或许我们自己的自动化系统可以得到升级！
label.en: We should study them - perhaps our own automation could be upgraded!

label.zh: 恐怖。我们必须找到拆除它们的办法！
label.en: Terrifying. We must find out how to dismantle them!

descriptions.zh: 我们对从§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!截获的信号进行的破译工作已取得成效，最终实现了重大突破。这一进程因一项关键发现而大幅推进——对方与我们类似，也是以集体智慧的形式组织起来的。尽管其生物特征及[this.ContactCountry.GetHiveAuthority]的意识形态与我们有显著差异，但其[this.ContactCountry.GetIndividualNamePlural]的思维结构很可能与我们的兼容，并可整合至[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]体系之中。
descriptions.en: Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! have paid off, and we have finally made a breakthrough. The process was helped considerably by the revelation that they, like us, are organized as a form of collective intelligence. Whilst their biology - and the opinions of their [this.ContactCountry.GetHiveAuthority] - are somewhat different to ours, it seems likely that their [this.ContactCountry.GetIndividualNamePlural] are, in fact, compatible with our own thought structures and could be integrated into the [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName].

label.zh: 或许到时候他们会考虑融合入我们。
label.en: Perhaps, in time, they will come to think as one with us.

options.script:
name = first_contact.105.A
finish_first_contact_effect = yes
first_contact_inform_intel = yes

descriptions.zh: 我们成功骇进了§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的网络系统，并获取了他们数据库的权限一段时间。尽管我们利用权限进行操作没有持续多久，我们依然对大批量的数据进行了拷贝并且希望——它不仅能帮助我们迅速破解对方的语言，也能评估对方的科技水准。
descriptions.en: We were successfully able to hack into the network systems of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! and gained access to their databanks for a time. Although our period of access was brief, we were able to make copies of a considerable body of data that should - hopefully - help us not only swiftly translate their language but also assess their technological level.

options.script:
name = EXCELLENT
set_first_contact_stage = default_end_stage_hacking

descriptions.zh: 我们成功骇进了§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的网络系统，并获取了他们数据库的权限一段时间。然后我们的权限就突然§H中断了§!——显然，我们的骇客行为被发现了。尽管我们利用权限进行操作没有持续多久，我们依然对大批量的数据进行了拷贝并且希望——它不仅能帮助我们迅速破解对方的语言，也能评估对方的科技水准。我们只能希望不要因为玩了这个小把戏，对方就把我们当作危险的敌人。
descriptions.en: We were successfully able to hack into the network systems of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! and gained access to their databanks for a time, before our access was abruptly §Hcut off§! - evidently, our presence did not go undetected. Although our period of access was brief, we were able to make copies of a considerable body of data that should - hopefully - help us not only swiftly translate their language but also assess their technological level. We can only hope that we haven't made ourselves dangerous enemies with this ploy...

options.script:
name = first_contact.205.A
custom_tooltip = first_contact.215.A.tooltip
set_first_contact_stage = default_end_stage_hacking

tooltips.zh: §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!对我们的第一印象很差。
tooltips.en: The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! have gained a poor first impression of us.

descriptions.zh: 我们负责研究§H[From.Owner.GetName]§!的团队报告了令人警觉的消息：他们试图骇入我们的电脑系统，但是被发现了！不幸的是，在我们切断他们权限之前，他们已经获得权限接触了体量相当庞大的敏感信息。这一不友好的行为让相当多位于[Root.Owner.GetName]的人表示了担忧，认为[From.Owner.GetName]可能会造成威胁。
descriptions.en: Our team in charge of researching the §H[From.Owner.GetName]§! report alarming news: an attempt by them to hack into our computer systems has been detected! Unfortunately, it seems that they gained access to a considerable amount of sensitive information before we were able to shut off their access. This unfriendly act has left many within the [Root.Owner.GetName] deeply worried at the threat the [From.Owner.GetName] may pose.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { is_gestalt = no } }

descriptions.zh: 我们负责研究§H[From.Owner.GetName]§!的子个体报告了令人警觉的消息：他们试图骇入我们的电脑系统，但是被发现了！不幸的是，在我们切断他们权限之前，他们已经获得权限，接触了体量相当庞大的敏感信息。我们会紧盯着他们，他们在未来做出任何对[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]有损的事情，我们都能在第一时间注意到。
descriptions.en: Our drones in charge of researching the §H[From.Owner.GetName]§! report alarming news: an attempt by them to hack into our computer systems has been detected! Unfortunately, it seems that they gained access to a considerable amount of sensitive information before we were able to shut off their access. We should be watchful of them, and be wary of any future moves they may make that could be detrimental to the [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName].
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { is_hive_empire = yes } }

descriptions.zh: 我们负责研究§H[From.Owner.GetName]§!的无人机报告了令人警觉的消息：他们试图骇入我们的电脑系统，但是被发现了！不幸的是，在我们切断他们权限之前，他们已经获得权限接触了体量相当庞大的敏感信息。这一偶然事件督促我们应当尽快更新防御协议和机动系统防火墙——同时也不要忘了上调[From.Owner.GetName]的威胁等级。
descriptions.en: Our drones in charge of researching the §H[From.Owner.GetName]§! report alarming news: an attempt by them to hack into our systems has been detected! Unfortunately, it seems that they gained access to a considerable amount of sensitive information before we were able to shut off their access. This occurrence has prompted us to update our defense protocols and mobile systems' firmware - and to upgrade our threat rating of the [From.Owner.GetName].
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { is_machine_empire = yes } }

label.zh: 我们要小心点盯着他们。
label.en: We will have to be watchful of them.

options.script: name = first_contact.206.A

descriptions.zh: 我们试图潜入§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的网络系统找出有关他们的更多信息，这一尝试没有成功。[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]以及[This.Leader.GetHerHis]的科研团队迅速认识到，他们与之对抗的系统过于先进——抑或是他们的监视者太警觉——根本没法用现有的方式找出漏洞。幸运的是，[This.Leader.GetSheHe][This.Leader.GetWasWere]在被对方探查到之前就及时§H终止§!了骇客任务。
descriptions.en: Our attempts to covertly delve into the network systems of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! to find out more about them have been unsuccessful. [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] and [This.Leader.GetHerHis] science team quickly realized that the systems they were up against were simply too advanced - or their overseers too vigilant - to be caught out in this manner. Fortunately, [This.Leader.GetSheHe] [This.Leader.GetWasWere] able to §Habort§! their hacking attempt before it was detected.

label.zh: 那么，我们就需要动用强硬手段了。
label.en: We will have to do this the hard way, then.

descriptions.zh: 看来，我们试图潜入§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!网络系统的行为被§H发现了§!。目前暂且不知道哪一步出了差错，但是[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]宣称他们面对的系统实在是太先进了——抑或是他们的监视者太警觉了——他们根本无法通过现有的手段找出漏洞。不幸的是，等他们认识到这一点的时候，一切都太晚了。我们只能希望，我们不会因为这点小把戏就被当成危险的敌人……
descriptions.en: It appears that our attempts to covertly delve into the network systems of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! were §Hdetected§!. It is not clear exactly what went wrong, but [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] claims that the systems they were up against were simply too advanced - or their overseers too vigilant - to be caught out in this manner. Unfortunately, by the time this became clear, it was too late. We can only hope that we haven't made ourselves dangerous enemies with this ploy...

偷偷潜入他们的网络系统为我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]获取了足够多的信息，可以用来翻译§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!使用的语言。尽管对于他们语言的掌握还不够熟练，我们还是设法与这个文明成功地开放了外交通道，后者现在被正式称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!。

我们还对从他们那拷贝的科技信息进行了分析，并且获得了一些此前我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]尚未设想的对物理学问题的新发现。
descriptions.en:
Thanks to our efforts in furtively delving into their network systems, we were able to secure enough data for our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] to translate the language used by the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. While our mastery of their language may not be complete, we have managed to successfully open diplomatic channels with the civilization we now know to be the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!.

We were also able to analyze the technical data we copied over from them, and found out some novel new approaches to physics problems that had not occurred to our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] before now.

descriptions.zh: 短暂的冲突之后，我方付出了数人伤亡的极小代价，§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!探索船的船员们——我们现在知道他们是[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass]§H[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass]§!物种——向我们的接舷小队投降。我们现在同时扣押了它们的舰船，以及船员作为人质，可以进行§H审问§!工作并学习它们的科技。
descriptions.en: After a brief struggle in which we sustained minimal casualties, the crew of the exploratory vessel of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! - who we now know to be [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass] §H[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass]§! species - surrendered to our boarding party. We now hold both their ship and a large portion of their crew hostage, and can set to work §Hinterrogating§! them and studying their technology.

descriptions.zh: 经过短暂的交锋，我们保持了伤亡最小化，来自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的探索船只的船员向我们的登船部队投降。在船上有多种不同的外星物种，但是最主要的似乎是§H[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClassPlural]§!。我们现在人船俱获，现在可以开始§H审讯§!他们以及期待获得他们的科技。
descriptions.en: After a brief struggle in which we sustained minimal casualties, the crew of the exploratory vessel from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! surrendered to our boarding party. There were multiple different alien species onboard, but the majority of them seem to have been §H[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClassPlural]§!. We now hold both their ship and a large portion of their crew hostage, and can set to work §Hinterrogating§! them and their technology.

descriptions.zh:
当我们登陆上§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的探索船上时，眼前的景象始料未及——船员居然都是机械体无人机，而且看上去被一个§H失控的人工智能§!管制！在短暂的交火之后，我们成功无力化了足够数量的无人机，仅剩些许残余仍在抵抗。令人惊讶的是，它们并没有启动自毁程序——我们只能假设自己的运气很好，在它们的管制人工智能下达自毁命令之前，成功切断了信号。

我们现在同时扣押了它们的舰船，以及船员作为§H人质§!，我们可以展开研究它们科技的工作，也可以查看这些无人机是否携带任何有用的信息。
descriptions.en:
As we boarded the exploratory vessel of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, we were greeted by a surprising revelation - the crew was made up of mechanical drones seemingly piloted by a §Hrogue AI!§! After a brief struggle, we were able to disable enough of them that the rest ceased to resist. Surprisingly, they did not manage to initiate self-destruct sequences - we can only assume that we were fortunate enough to cut off the signal to their guiding AI before the order was given.

Now that we hold both their ship and what remains of their crew §Hhostage§!, we can set to work studying their technology, and see whether the drones will yield any useful information.

descriptions.zh:
短暂的冲突之后，我方付出了数人伤亡的极小代价，我们对§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!探索船的船员进行了压制，并迫使它们投降。§H[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass]§!外星人在战斗中表现出了极强的协同性——就好像受同一思维指挥一样——直到其中一个个体被击毙，它们全员停止了抵抗。自那以后，它们表现出了明显的无目的性和迷惑性。我们只能猜测它们是某个蜂巢主脑控制的子个体们。

我们现在同时扣押了它们的舰船，以及船员作为§H人质§!，我们可以研究它们的科技，也可以试试动用审讯手段是否能够查出什么情报出来。
descriptions.en:
After a brief struggle in which we sustained minimal casualties, we overwhelmed the crew of the exploratory vessel of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! and forced them to surrender. The §H[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass]§! aliens fought with remarkable coordination - almost as if guided by a single mind - until as one, they suddenly ceased to resist. Since then, they have appeared aimless and confused. We can only posit that they were drones of some sort of hive mind.

Now that we hold both their ship and what remains of their crew §Hhostage§!, we can set to work studying their technology, and see any interrogative methods may yield any useful information.

descriptions.zh:
经过短暂交火，我方仅付出轻微伤亡便成功压制了§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!探索舰的船员并迫使其投降。起初这群§H[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass]§!外星生物展现出远超预期的协同作战能力——宛如共用同一个意识——直到他们突然停止了抵抗。彼时每个船员都丧失了组织性，退化出野蛮的原始行为模式。

我们只能推测这些已近乎丧失智慧的生物曾以某种群体意识形态运作。如今既已将其船员与舰船§H扣为人质§!，便可着手审讯这支诡异舰队，并研究其独特科技。
descriptions.en:
After a brief struggle in which we sustained minimal casualties, we overwhelmed the crew of the exploratory vessel from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! and forced them to surrender. At first the §H[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass]§! aliens fought with a far greater sense of coordination than we had anticipated - acting as though with one mind - until suddenly, they ceased to resist. At that point each crew member lost all cohesion, instead reverting to brutish, primal behaviors.

We can only posit that these now barely-sapient creatures were operating as some form of gestalt. Now that we hold both them and their ship §Hhostage§!, we can set to work interrogating this bizarre crew, and studying their unique technology.

descriptions.zh:
我们的探险家们知道第一次接触是一项很危险的事情，但谁也没想到事态会发展到这个地步。在这次暴力袭击中，[From.Owner.GetName]扣押了我们的舰船，我们还没来得及发动紧急超光速跃迁就被搜查小队登船了。尽管我们的船员做出了英勇的反抗，但袭击者——[From.Owner.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass][From.Owner.Species.GetClass]，他们还是干烂了我们的防御。

在所有信号切断前，我们收到的最后一条视频显示，敌人活捉了大部分船员，并打算盘问他们，他们可能打算进一步了解我们，为下一步敌对行动做准备……
descriptions.en:
Our explorers knew first contact to be a dangerous affair, but none could have predicted just how true this would be. In a violent assault, the [From.Owner.GetName] seized our vessel, landing a boarding party before emergency FTL could be engaged. Despite our crew's valiant efforts, the attackers - [From.Owner.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass] [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] alien species - were able to overwhelm our defenses.

The last visual feeds we received before all signals cut off suggested that the enemy had captured much of the crew alive and were intent on interrogating them, probably with the intention of finding out more about us in preparation for further hostilities...

descriptions.zh:
风险决策部分从一开始就知道第一次接触外星文明是一项很危险的事情。[From.Owner.GetName]的行动证明了他们是对的。我们的舰船被扣押了，还没来得及发动紧急超光速跃迁就被搜查小队登船了。

这群针对我们的袭击者，[From.Owner.Species.GetClass]的外星人，成功捕获了许多我们的低级子个体；然而，如果不给他们一些必要的指导，他们也不会获得太多——尽管他们能够从被俘的飞船上了解到我们的技术。他们的威胁等级已经被调高了。
descriptions.en:
The part of us that considers threat assessments was sure from the start that encountering alien civilizations would be risky. This has proven correct with the case of one of our exploratory vessels, which was assaulted and boarded by the [From.Owner.GetName] before emergency FTL could be engaged.

Our assailants, a group of [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] aliens, managed to capture many of our menial drones; however, without us to give them direction, they will probably not give away much of value - though they will be able to find out much about our technologies from the captured ship. Our evaluation of the danger posed by them has accordingly increased.

descriptions.zh:
我们长久以来一直怀疑，如果星系其他地方存在生命，它们可能会对我们构成威胁，其危险程度不亚于游荡的奇点或恒星辐射。如今，这一怀疑已被证实。我们的一艘探索舰遭到[from.owner.GetName]的袭击并登舰——对方在飞船上的共生体尚未撤离时就发动了进攻。

袭击我们的是一群[from.owner.species.GetClass]外星人，他们俘获了许多滞留在飞船上的[root.GetSpeciesAdj]共生体。既然这些共生体已脱离我们的群体意识，我们怀疑捕获者难以从中获取战略价值。然而它们的离去仍削弱了我们的力量。我们完全有理由感到被冒犯，但同样可以欣慰的是，在这片神秘虚空中，我们又揭露并确认了一个新的威胁。
descriptions.en:
We had long suspected that if life existed elsewhere in the galaxy it may pose a threat to us, every bit as wild and lethal as rogue singularities or stellar radiation. Now though, our suspicions have proven true. One of our exploratory vessels has been assaulted and boarded by the [from.owner.GetName]; they pressed their attack before our ship-bound symbionts could make their escape.

Our assailants, a group of [from.owner.species.GetClass] aliens, captured many of our now-stranded [root.GetSpeciesAdj] elements on board. As these symbionts are no longer part of our chorus, we doubt their captors will extract much of strategic value. However, by their loss we are still diminished. We would be justified in feeling insulted, but so too might we take heart in having exposed and identified a new threat out in this otherwise enigmatic void.

tooltips.zh: 为了保证安全，我方其他位于他们领土中的舰队也发动了紧急超光速跃迁。
tooltips.en: Our other fleets in what appears to be their territory have sought safety by engaging emergency FTL.

我们船上的视觉信号现在已经切断了，但他们已经向我们展示了这些外星人是如何“善待”俘虏和人质的。他们直接活切了人质并取出他们的内脏做研究！我们必须假定，当面对一个以这种方式行事的文明时，我们必须采取强有力的敌对行动。

Despite our crew's valiant efforts, the attackers - [From.Owner.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass] [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] alien species - were able to overwhelm our defenses.

Our visual feeds from within the ship have now cut off, but not before showing us the unspeakable atrocities the aliens are committing against the hostages, cutting them open and studying their insides even while they are still alive! We must assume that hostilities are inevitable when faced with a civilization that would act in such a manner.

This, together with their capture of our ship and all the technologies deployed there, has caused us to significantly increase our evaluation of the danger posed by them.

我们的探险家们知道第一次接触是一项很危险的事情，但谁也没想到事态会发展到这个地步。在这次暴力袭击中，[From.Owner.GetName]扣押了我们的舰船，我们还没来得及发动紧急超光速跃迁就被搜查小队登船了。尽管我们的船员做出了英勇的反抗，但袭击者——一群被一个无赖AI管理的战斗无人机，他们还是干烂了我们的防御。

我们船上的视觉信号现在已经切断了，但他们已经向我们展示了这些外星人是如何“善待”俘虏和人质的。他们直接活切了人质并取出他们的内脏做研究！我们必须假定，当面对一个以这种方式行事的文明时，我们必须采取强有力的敌对行动。
descriptions.en:
Our explorers knew first contact to be a dangerous affair, but none could have predicted just how true this would be. In a violent assault, the [From.Owner.GetName] seized our vessel, landing a boarding party before emergency FTL could be engaged. Despite our crew's valiant efforts, the attackers - mechanical drones seemingly piloted by a rogue AI - were able to overwhelm our defenses.

Our visual feeds from within the ship have now cut off, but not before showing us the unspeakable atrocities the aliens are committing against the hostages, cutting them open and studying their insides even while they are still alive! We must assume that hostilities are inevitable when faced with a civilization that would act in such a manner.

descriptions.zh:
风险决策部分从一开始就知道第一次接触外星文明是一项很危险的事情。[From.Owner.GetName]的行动证明了他们是对的。我们的舰船被扣押了，还没来得及发动紧急超光速跃迁就被搜查小队登船了。

这群针对我们的袭击者，一群被一个无赖AI管理的战斗无人机，设法捕获了我们的许多低级子个体，并且已经开始不顾可能产生的损耗而将它们从生理上拆分开来，显然是在寻找一种方法来让这些子个体对付我们自己。这样的行为，加上他们捕获的我们的舰船和在船上使用的所有技术，他们的威胁等级需要提升到非常高的程度。
descriptions.en:
The part of us that considers threat assessments was sure from the start that encountering alien civilizations would be risky. This has proven correct with the case of one of our exploratory vessels, which was assaulted and boarded by the [From.Owner.GetName] before emergency FTL could be engaged.

Our assailants, a group of mechanical drones seemingly piloted by a rogue AI, managed to capture many of our menial drones and have begun cutting them apart with no regard for the waste of resources, apparently seeking to find a way to turn our own biology against us. This, together with their capture of our ship and all the technologies deployed there, has caused us to significantly increase our evaluation of the danger posed by them.

我们的处理单元们知道第一次接触外星文明是一项很危险的事情。这种对危险的预测在我们的一艘舰船上成真了，[From.Owner.GetName]扣押了我们的舰船，我们还没来得及发动紧急超光速跃迁就被搜查小队登船了。

我们的攻击者——一群和我们非常相似的机械无人机——设法捕获了我们的许多无人机，并已开始分解它们以查看我们的设备如何组合在一起——很明显是在查找它们的软件和硬件方面都存在哪些缺陷以用来对付我们。这样的行为，加上他们捕获的我们的舰船和在船上使用的所有技术，他们的威胁等级需要提升到非常高的程度。

Our assailants - a group of mechanical drones much like our own - managed to capture many of our drones and have begun dissembling them to see how our units are put together - apparently scanning them for weaknesses in both their software and their hardware. This, along with their capture of our ship and all the technologies deployed there, has caused us to significantly increase our assessment of the danger posed by them.

descriptions.zh:
我们长久以来一直怀疑，如果星系其他地方存在生命，它们可能会对我们构成威胁，其危险程度不亚于游荡的奇点或恒星辐射。如今，这一怀疑已被证实。我们的一艘探索舰遭到[from.owner.GetName]的袭击并登舰——对方在飞船上的共生体尚未撤离时就发动了进攻。

袭击我们的是一群[from.owner.species.GetClass]外星生物，它们正着手解剖并肢解飞船上被其识别为生命体的部分。我们当中那些非机动型宏观共生体似乎遭遇了较为仁慈的命运，仅被清除或消灭。船内再无成员存续于我们的意识共鸣中，但它们的消逝仍令我们通体震颤。

我们遭受了酷刑般的折磨，但至少明确了一点：此刻我们更清楚地认知到这片深空中潜藏的威胁形态。
descriptions.en:
We had long suspected that if life existed elsewhere in the galaxy it may pose a threat to us, every bit as wild and lethal as rogue singularities or stellar radiation. Now though, our suspicions have proven true. One of our exploratory vessels has been assaulted and boarded by the [from.owner.GetName]; they pressed their attack before our ship-bound symbionts could make their escape.

Our assailants, a group of [from.owner.species.GetClass] aliens, have set about dissecting and butchering those parts of us they recognize as lifeforms on board the ship. Those among us who weren't ambulatory macro-symbionts seem to have met kinder fates, having merely been exterminated or expunged. None aboard remain within our chorus, though we felt their loss throughout.

An act of torture has been inflicted upon us, but even if nothing else: we now know more about the kinds of threats we face out here.

tooltips.zh: 为了保证安全，我方其他位于他们领土中的舰队也发动了紧急超光速跃迁。
tooltips.en: Our other fleets in what appears to be their territory have sought safety by engaging emergency FTL.

Many among us who weren't ambulatory macro-symbionts were also caught up in the extermination, but regardless: all aboard have now been torn away from our chorus. We felt their loss throughout.

An act of mindless brutality has been committed upon us, but now at least we do know more about the kinds of threats we face elsewhere in this galaxy.

tooltips.en: Our other fleets in what appears to be their territory have sought safety by engaging emergency FTL.

descriptions.zh:
我们试图将§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的探索船无力化，然而这一行动酿成了一场血战，甚至在我们登船之后惨烈的战斗仍未停息。冲突十分激烈，没有船员幸存——似乎所有受伤的战斗人员都宁愿§H自杀§!，也不允许自己被俘。

尽管它们在最后的时间里急匆匆地抹除了电脑系统，并试图让舰船自爆，它们的舰船还是完好无损地落入了我们的手中。我方的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]正开始工作，试图从中发掘出有用的信息。
descriptions.en:
We were able to disable the exploratory vessel of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, but only after a bloody firefight that continued even as we boarded their ship. So ferocious was the struggle that no living survivors remained - it seems that wounded combatants committed §Hsuicide§! rather than permit themselves to be captured.

Despite their hasty last-minute efforts to wipe their computer systems and rig the ship to explode, their vessel is still very much intact, and our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are poised to see what they can find out from it.

descriptions.zh:

Despite their hasty last-minute efforts to wipe their computer systems and rig the ship to explode, their vessel is still very much intact, and our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are poised to see what they can find out from it.
