descriptions.en:
We were able to disable the exploratory vessel of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, but only after a bloody firefight that continued even as we boarded their ship. The crew of the ship moved with remarkable coordination - almost as if guided by a single mind - and gave a fierce struggle, refusing to back down and eventually §Hkilling themselves§! rather than permit themselves to be captured.

Despite their hasty last-minute efforts to wipe their computer systems and rig the ship to explode, their vessel is still very much intact, and our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are poised to see what they can find out from it.

descriptions.zh:
我们成功瘫痪了来自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的探索舰，但登舰过程中爆发的冲突意外升级为致命交火。起初这群§H[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass]§!外星生物展现出超乎预期的协同作战能力，宛如共享同一意识。然而当我方取得军事优势后，这些生物突然陷入全面混乱。其行为模式迅速退化为原始而野蛮的状态，完全丧失组织性，最终被迅速歼灭。

现有证据表明，这些低等智慧生物曾隶属于某个格式塔意识。那个操纵它们的未知存在显然宁可选择自我毁灭也不愿被俘获——最终留给我们的只有可回收的舰体残骸，其中充斥着嗜血野兽与蠕动的异星植被。
descriptions.en:
We managed to disable the exploratory vessel from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, but only after a skirmish that became decidedly more deadly as we boarded their ship. At first the §H[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass]§! aliens fought with a far greater sense of coordination than we had anticipated, as though acting with one mind. However once we pressed our military advantage, the creatures suddenly lost all cohesion. From that point their behavior reverted to something primal, bestial, and entirely uncoordinated. Their end came swiftly.

We can only posit that these barely-sapient creatures were once operating as part of a gestalt. Whichever entity was guiding them seems to have favored self-destruction over capture; it left us with nought but a salvageable hull filled with ravening beasts and twitching vegetation.

label.zh: 这艘船会把它们的秘密都显露出来。
label.en: The ship will surely yield their secrets.

descriptions.zh:
我们的探险家们知道第一次接触是一项很危险的事情，但谁也没想到事态会发展到这个地步。在这次暴力袭击中，[From.Owner.GetName]扣押了我们的舰船，我们还没来得及发动紧急超光速跃迁就被搜查小队登船了。尽管我们的船员做出了英勇的反抗，但袭击者——[From.Owner.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass][From.Owner.Species.GetClass]，他们还是干烂了我们的防御。

或许值得庆幸的是，无论是为了他们自己的尊严还是保护我们的情报不落入敌手，我们的船员在被俘虏之前英勇就义了。然而，我们必须假定攻击者很快就会通过研究我们的船只获取我们的情报——面对一个以这种方式行事的文明时，我们必须采取强有力的敌对行动。
descriptions.en:
Our explorers knew first contact to be a dangerous affair, but none could have predicted just how true this would be. In a violent assault, the [From.Owner.GetName] seized our vessel, landing a boarding party before emergency FTL could be engaged. Despite our crew's valiant efforts, the attackers - [From.Owner.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass] [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] alien species - were able to overwhelm our defenses.

Perhaps fortunately - both for them and the sake of keeping information from enemy hands - our crew took their own lives rather than permit themselves to be captured. However, we must assume that our assailants will soon find out much about us by studying our vessel - and that hostilities are inevitable when faced with a civilization that would act in such a manner.

descriptions.zh:
我们长久以来一直怀疑，如果星系其他地方存在生命，它们可能会对我们构成威胁，其危险程度不亚于游荡的奇点或恒星辐射。如今，这一怀疑已被证实。我们的一艘探索舰遭到[from.owner.GetName]的袭击并登舰——对方在飞船上的共生体尚未撤离时就发动了进攻。

我们的袭击者——一群[from.owner.species.GetClass]外星人——很快击溃了我们的防御，他们优先攻击了那些被其识别为生命体的部分。出于自保，我们被迫抛弃了舰上所有成员，将其隔绝于我们的意识共鸣之外。尽管来犯者如此猖獗，他们终将一无所获。

这是一次赤裸裸的侵略行径，但至少我们现在更清楚地认识到，在这片星海中还将面临何种威胁。
descriptions.en:
We had long suspected that if life existed elsewhere in the galaxy it may pose a threat to us, every bit as wild and lethal as rogue singularities or stellar radiation. Now though, our suspicions have proven true. One of our exploratory vessels has been assaulted and boarded by the [from.owner.GetName]; they pressed their attack before our ship-bound symbionts could make their escape.

Our assailants, a group of [from.owner.species.GetClass] aliens, soon overwhelmed our defenses, having prioritized those parts of us they actually recognized as lifeforms. As an act of self-preservation we were forced to abandon all those aboard, isolating them from our chorus. For all their aggression, our attackers shall learn little from us.

An act of naked transgression has been directed toward us, but now at least we do know more about the kinds of threats we face elsewhere in this galaxy.

descriptions.en: Our efforts to capture the exploratory vessel of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! have ended in failure. Unfortunately, we lost track of their ship before we could attempt to seize it.

descriptions.zh: 我们试图俘获§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!探索船的行动失败了。非常的不幸，它们成功地躲避了我们的俘虏行动，并在我们将舰船无力化之前就§H逃脱§!了恒星系。我们的未来乌云密布——不仅是因为要找出它们的信息更加困难艰巨了，也是因为它们一定会将这次行动当作我们敌视它们的一部分。
descriptions.en: Our efforts to capture the exploratory vessel of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! have ended in failure. Unfortunately, they managed to elude our capture attempt and §Hescape§! the system before we could disable their ship. This bodes ill for the future - not only do we face an uphill struggle to find out more about them, but they will surely consider this to be a hostile act on our part.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { exists = event_target:fleet_to_seize }

label.zh: 我们现在必须加把劲翻译它们的语言了。
label.en: We must redouble our efforts to translate their language.

tooltips.zh:
我们已经定位到了它们的母星系，我们可以试图§H绑架§!一些标本。


然而，它们肯定戒备森严。
tooltips.en:
As we have located their home systems, we may try to §Habduct§! specimens from there.


However, they will be on their guard.

tooltips.zh: 我们已经定位到了它们的母星系，我们可以试图§H绑架§!一些标本。
tooltips.en: As we have located their home systems, we may try to §Habduct§! specimens from there.

descriptions.zh: §H[ship_to_seize.GetName]§!，我们派去调查§H[From.Owner.GetName]§!的飞船，勉强躲过了对方武装力量的恶意攻击。他们似乎想要截获我们的船只并审讯船员，很有还带着对我们开展进一步攻击行动为自己牟利的目的。不过谢天谢地，在一切失去控制之前，[ship_to_seize.GetName]设法发动了紧急超光速跃迁。
descriptions.en: The §H[ship_to_seize.GetName]§!, our vessel we had sent to investigate the §H[From.Owner.GetName]§!, narrowly escaped a vicious attack by their forces. It seems they had thought to seize our ship to interrogate our crew, probably with the aim of swinging further hostilities against us in their favor. Thankfully, the [ship_to_seize.GetName] managed to engage emergency FTL before it was too late.

descriptions.zh: §H[ship_to_seize.GetName]§!，我们派去调查§H[From.Owner.GetName]§!的飞船，勉强躲过了对方武装力量的恶意攻击。他们似乎是想截获我们的船只并逆向科技，很有可能想着对我们展开进一步攻击为自己牟利。不过谢天谢地，在一切失去控制前，[ship_to_seize.GetName]设法发动了紧急超光速跃迁。
descriptions.en: The §H[ship_to_seize.GetName]§!, our vessel we had sent to investigate the §H[From.Owner.GetName]§!, narrowly escaped a vicious attack by their forces. It seems they had thought to seize our ship and steal our technologies, probably with the aim of swinging further hostilities against us in their favor. Thankfully, the [ship_to_seize.GetName] managed to engage emergency FTL before it was too late.

tooltips.zh: 为了保证安全，我方其他位于他们领土中的舰队也发动了紧急超光速跃迁。
tooltips.en: Our other fleets in what appears to be their territory have sought safety by engaging emergency FTL.

descriptions.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!外星人的研究。最初这些人质不太愿意与我们合作，但随着时间推移他们在无意中不断地给了我们有关他们语言的线索，一直到我们能够与他们进行基础的语言交流。从那时起，我们就能迅速拼凑有关他们的细节，一旦有一位或是更多的人质愿意合作，我们就能进入他们的电脑系统。

得益于从他们身上收集到的信息，我们能够确认他们来自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!，并就其活动和军事实力收集到了相当多的情报。
descriptions.en:
We have concluded our study of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! aliens we recently captured. The hostages were initially unwilling to cooperate with us, but over time they inadvertently gave us clues to their language, until we were able to communicate with them on a basic level. From that point, we were rapidly able to piece together further details about them, eventually gaining access to their computer systems once one of the more cooperative hostages cracked.

Thanks to the information we have gleaned from them, we are able to identify them as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! and have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

descriptions.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!外星人的研究。这些人质显然意志薄弱，没什么阻止我们对其调查的想法。事实上，他们十分配合。我们很快就能翻译他们的语言并进入对方的电脑系统。

因此，我们得以确定他们来自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!，并就其活动和军事实力收集到了相当多的情报。
descriptions.en:
We have concluded our study of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! aliens we recently captured. The hostages were remarkably weak-willed and showed no particular desire to keep us from finding out about them; indeed, they proved extremely cooperative. We were soon able to translate their language and access their computer systems.

As a result, we have been able to identify them as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! and have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

descriptions.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!外星人的研究。这些人质表现得极其不愿意配合我们，甚至我们审讯者使用了以往最具有说服力的方法也无济于事。然而，随着时间的推移，他们在无意中不断地泄露出有关他们语言的各种线索，最终使得我们有能力与他们开展基础性的交流。从那时起，我们就可以迅速拼凑出有关他们的细节，此外骇入对方部分基础电脑系统的行动也取得了进展。尽管如此，我们还是怀疑他们对我方隐瞒了大量细节。

得益于我们从他们身上获取的信息，我们得以确定他们来自于§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!，并就其活动和军事力量获取了大量情报。
descriptions.en:
We have concluded our study of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! aliens we recently captured. The hostages proved remarkably unwilling to cooperate with us, resisting even the most persuasive methods of our interrogators. However, over time, they inadvertently gave us clues to their language, eventually allowing us to communicate with them on a basic level. From that point, we were rapidly able to piece together further details about them - as well as gain access to some of their basic computer systems - although we suspect that they were able to keep many details back.

Thanks to the information we were able to glean from them, we are able to identify them as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! and have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

descriptions.zh:
我们结束了对于此前我们截获的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!机械无人机的调查行动。我们一切断它们与上级人工智能的链接之后，这些无人机就失去了代理，并且被发现几乎完全失去了作用，因为其功能已经迅速退化。

幸运的是，我们想办法破解了他们的电脑系统的秘钥，[This.Owner.GetLinguists]马上就能翻译他们用来通讯的信号。现在，我们已经能够确认§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!是§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!，。我们现在积累了大量有关他们活动和能力的情报。
descriptions.en:
We have concluded our study of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! machines we recently captured. Once cut off from their parent AI, the drones lacked agency, and we were able to find out little of use from them as their functionality rapidly degraded.

Fortunately, we were able to crack the codes to their computer systems, and our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] were soon able to translate the signals they use for communication. As a result, we can now identify the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! and have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

descriptions.zh:
我们结束了对于此前捕获的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!外星人的研究。看上去它们确实是由§H蜂巢思维§!所链接起来的，单独的子个体是缺少自我意识和代理权的。将其从主体意识剥离后，这些子个体似乎漫无目的，然后一个接一个地死去。除了将其作为生物标本外也没什么其他地作用了。

幸运的是，我们想办法破解了他们的电脑系统的秘钥，[This.Owner.GetLinguists]马上就能翻译他们用来通讯的信号。现在，我们已经能够确认§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!是§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!，。我们现在积累了大量有关他们活动和能力的情报。
descriptions.en:
We have concluded our study of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! aliens we recently captured. It would appear that they are indeed organized as a §Hhive mind§!, with individual drones lacking autonomy or agency. Cut off from the body, the drones seemed aimless and died off one by one, not yielding much in the way of useful information except as unwitting biological specimens.

Fortunately, we were able to crack the codes to their computer systems, and our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] were soon able to translate the signals they use for communication. As a result, we can now identify the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! and have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经完成了对近期捕获的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!外星生物的研究。这些为数众多的生命体以某种蜂巢思维的方式组织起来，但并没有一个中央的管理实体。相反，这些几乎不具备智慧的个体似乎与它们的整个生物群落形成了一种§H共生格式塔§!结构。 由于彼此隔绝且与母星失去联系，这些共生体退化至原始状态并迅速消亡。除了作为解剖对象外，它们没有为我们提供多少有用的信息。

幸运的是，我们想办法破解了他们的电脑系统的秘钥，[This.Owner.GetLinguists]马上就能翻译他们用来通讯的信号。现在，我们已经能够确认§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!是§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!，。我们现在积累了大量有关他们活动和能力的情报。
descriptions.en:
We have concluded our study of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! aliens we recently captured. This myriad assortment of lifeforms are organized as a sort of hive mind, albeit without a central, governing entity. Instead these barely-sapient individuals seem to form a §Hmutualistic gestalt§! with their entire biome. Since being isolated from each other as well as their homeworld, these symbionts reverted to a primal state and perished fairly rapidly. They have yielded little useful information to us, save as subjects for autopsy.

Fortunately, we were able to crack the codes to their computer systems, and our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] were soon able to translate the signals they use for communication. As a result, we can now identify the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! and have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

descriptions.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!外星人的研究。这些人质相当不愿意同我们合作，不过由于我们将其开膛破肚，他们的反抗毫无意义。我们现在对他们的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural]、[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]和[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]的内部功能以及其他身体部分有了更多的了解，我们的基因学家[This.Owner.GetResearchers]获得了相当有价值的§H异种生物学数据§!。

由于我们残忍的行为带来的恐怖，一部分外星人——现在我们知道他们是§H[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!——开始在我们翻译他们语言并接入电脑系统时表现出了合作的态度。作为结果，我们显然拥有了数量相当可观的情报，如果有需求，我们可以部署这些情报对付他们。
descriptions.en:
We have concluded our study of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! aliens we recently captured. The hostages proved unwilling to cooperate with us, but this became a moot point as we began to cut them open. We now know much about the internal functions of their [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] and other body parts, giving our genetics [This.Owner.GetResearchers] valuable §Hxenobiological data§!.

Driven to terror by the cruelty of our actions, a handful of the aliens - who we now know to be §H[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! - cooperated with us as we sought to translate their language and access their computer systems. As a result, we now have considerable intelligence we are able to deploy against them, should the need arise.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经完成了对近期捕获的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!外星生物的研究。这些为数众多的生命体以某种蜂巢思维的方式组织起来，但并没有一个中央的管理实体。相反，这些几乎不具备智慧的个体似乎与它们的整个生物群落形成了一种§H共生格式塔§!结构。

与家园以及彼此隔离后，这些共生体退化到了原始状态并迅速消亡，这使得尸检变得相当简单。现在我们已经对他们[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural]、[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]、[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]和其他身体部位的内部功能有了很多了解，这为我们[This.Owner.GetResearchers]的遗传学家提供了宝贵的§H外星生物学数据§!。

我们现在知道如何同他们的母国，§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!，进行沟通了，并且可以部署数量相当可观的情报来对付他们——如果有必要的话。
descriptions.en:
We have concluded our study of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! aliens we recently captured. This myriad assortment of lifeforms are organized as a sort of hive mind, albeit without a central, governing entity. Instead these barely-sapient individuals seem to form a §Hmutualistic gestalt§! with their entire biome.

Since being isolated from each other as well as their homeworld, these symbionts reverted to a primal state and soon perished, making autopsy rather trivial. We now know much about the internal functions of their [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] and other body parts, giving our genetics [This.Owner.GetResearchers] valuable §Hxenobiological data§!.

We now know how to communicate with their parent empire, the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!, if needed - and have considerable intelligence to deploy against them should it prove necessary!

我们已经完成了对最近捕获的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!外星人的研究。结果表明，它们确实以§H蜂巢思维§!的方式组织起来，子个体缺乏自主性或能动性。虽然事实证明对它们进行审讯没有任何作用，但这已变得无关紧要，因为我们已经开始解剖它们。现在我们已经对他们[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural]、[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]、[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]和其他身体部位的内部功能有了很多了解，这为我们[This.Owner.GetResearchers]的遗传学家提供了宝贵的§H外星生物学数据§!。

虽然花费的时间比我们预期的稍长，但凭借我们所掌握的生物学知识以及在捕获的飞船上发现的各种线索，我们最终破解了他们的语言和计算机代码。我们现在知道如何同他们的母国，§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!，进行沟通了，并且可以部署数量相当可观的情报来对付他们——如果有必要的话。
descriptions.en:
We have concluded our study of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! aliens we recently captured. It would appear that they are indeed organized as a §Hhive mind§!, with individual drones lacking autonomy or agency. Although they proved unuseful subjects for interrogation, this became a moot point as we began to cut them open. We now know much about the internal functions of their [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] and other body parts, giving our genetics [This.Owner.GetResearchers] valuable §Hxenobiological data§!.

Though it took a bit longer than we might have hoped, the biological knowledge we had gained and the various clues scattered about the captured vessel allowed us to crack their language - and their computer codes. We now know how to communicate with their parent empire, the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!, if needed - and have considerable intelligence to deploy against them should it prove necessary!

虽然花费的时间比我们预期的稍长，但我们获得的生物学知识以及无人机被劫持时收集到的各种线索，最终让我们破解了它们的语言和计算机代码。我们现在知道如何同他们的母国，§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!，进行沟通了，并且可以部署数量相当可观的情报来对付他们——如果有必要的话。
descriptions.en:
We have concluded our study of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! aliens we recently captured. It would appear that they are indeed organized as a §Hhive mind§!, with individual drones lacking autonomy or agency. Although they proved unuseful subjects for interrogation, this became a moot point as we began to cut them open. We now know much about the internal functions of their [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] and other body parts, giving our genetics [This.Owner.GetResearchers] valuable §Hxenobiological data§!.

Though it took a bit longer than we might have hoped, the biological knowledge we had gained and the various clues gathered when the drones were abducted allowed us to crack their language - and their computer codes. We now know how to communicate with their parent empire, the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!, if needed - and have considerable intelligence to deploy against them should it prove necessary!

descriptions.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!机器的研究。一旦切断同人工智能主体的联系，这些无人机就失去了执行能力，无法提供与他们自己的协议相关的信息。但是一旦我们开始将他们大卸八块，我们又可以获得一定的进展了——不仅在了解他们的内部语言方面，也在找出有关他们的更多知识方面。其结论是，他们使用的处理器还是比不过我们针对他们使用的攻性数据收集技术，现在他们已经没剩下多少秘密了。

我们现在可以同他们的人工智能主体——其自称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!——进行沟通，我们会静观其变。
descriptions.en:
We have concluded our study of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! machines we recently captured. Once cut off from their parent AI, the drones lacked agency and gave off little useful information of their own accord, but once we began dissembling them, we were able to make more progress - both in understanding their internal functioning, and in finding out more about them. It turned out their processors were no match for the invasive data gathering techniques we used on them, with the result that little about them is now secret to us.

We can now also communicate with their parent AI - which calls itself the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! - should we see fit.

descriptions.zh: 对于在[This.ContactCountry.GetName]中俘获的飞船的研究已经结束。没能抓到一个活口使得这次调查极具挑战。不过幸运的是，他们还是留给我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]丰富的材料用以破解它们的语言，我们现在将其识别为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!，如果我们乐意的话还能和对方进行沟通。此外，我们还能够研究它们在自己舰船上使用的§H科技§!，这能帮助我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]在研究突破上找到全新的思路。
descriptions.en: We have concluded our study of the vessel we recently captured from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. The absence of a living crew made our investigation challenging. Fortunately, they left behind enough material for our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] to gradually decipher their language and identify them as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!, allowing us to communicate with them should we so please. Furthermore, we were able to study their ship's §Htechnology§!, which has helped our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] uncover some novel new approaches to our own research problems.

descriptions.zh: 对于在[This.ContactCountry.GetName]中俘获的飞船的研究已经结束。由于没能抓到一个活口来审讯，我们的调查极具挑战。幸运的是，他们还是留给我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]丰富的材料用以破解他们的语言，我们现在将其识别为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!，如果我们乐意的话还能和对方进行沟通。此外，我们还能研究他们在自己舰船上使用的§H科技§!，这能帮助我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]在研究突破上找到全新的思路。
descriptions.en: We have concluded our study of the equipment we recently captured from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Investigating it was a challenge without living specimens to interrogate. Fortunately, they left behind enough material for our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] to gradually decipher their language and identify them as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!, allowing us to communicate with them should we so please. Furthermore, we were able to study their §Htechnology§!, which has helped our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] to uncover some novel new approaches to our own research problems.

descriptions.zh:
一支英勇的秘密特种部队带着从§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!星系的殖民地上抓获的人质从§H[abduction_planet.System.GetName]§!的领域内逃脱了出来。趁着夜色的掩护，他们设法降落在了星球的一个人迹罕至的地方，俘获了数名活体外星人，同时还缴获了大量技术硬件。这些对于我们破译他们的语言以及评估他们的技术等级都十分有用。

尽管行动没有出错，我们的特工拜托了追兵成功逃离，但是要想§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!对我们的行动没有丝毫察觉似乎是不可能的。
descriptions.en:
A brave team of covert special forces has escaped §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! territory with hostages captured from one of their colonies in the §H[abduction_planet.System.GetName]§! system. They were able to land on a remote part of the world in the cover of darkness and seize several live aliens, as well as a large stash of technical hardware that is sure to help us decode their language and assess their technological level.

Though the operation went without a hitch and our operatives were able to escape without pursuit, it is probably too much to hope for that the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! remain ignorant of our actions.

descriptions.zh:

descriptions.zh: 尽管有些人早在担忧未知外星人舰船闯入我们的宇域一事，[From.Owner.GetName]表现出来的威胁直到刚刚才昭然若揭。他们似乎在[abduction_planet.GetName]的一个偏远地区登陆了一支秘密行动小队，还绑架了几个活的[This.Owner.GetSpeciesName]人质，在我们能够组织起一支救援小队之前就逃遁到了深空。我们只能想象这些人质在他们的捕捉者手里会遭到何等的折磨。
descriptions.en: While some were worried at the incursion of unknown alien vessels into our space, it was not clear until now just how much of a threat the [From.Owner.GetName] posed. It seems they landed a covert team on a remote part of [abduction_planet.GetName] and seized living [This.Owner.GetSpeciesName] hostages, escaping into the depths of space before we could mount a rescue party. We can only imagine what tortures they will suffer at the hands of their captors.

descriptions.zh: 尽管有些人早在担忧未知外星人舰船闯入我们的宇域一事，[From.Owner.GetName]表现出来的威胁直到刚刚才昭然若揭。他们似乎派出了一支秘密行动小队拦截了我们一艘位于[abduction_system.GetName]星系的货船，扣押了这艘船，在我们能够组织起一支救援小队之前就逃遁到了深空。我们只能想象这些人质在他们的捕捉者手里会遭到何等的折磨。
descriptions.en: While some were worried at the incursion of unknown alien vessels into our space, it was not clear until now just how much of a threat the [From.Owner.GetName] posed. It seems they sent a covert force to intercept one of our cargo vessels in the [abduction_system.GetName] system, seizing the ship and escaping into the depths of space before we could mount a rescue party. We can only imagine what tortures the crew will suffer at the hands of their captors.

descriptions.zh: 我们将允许未知外星人进入我们宇域一事评估为风险——现在这项评估被证明为是正确的。似乎[From.Owner.GetName]在[abduction_planet.GetName]的一个偏远地区登陆了一支秘密行动小队，然后捕获了几个[This.Owner.GetSpeciesName]无人机，还有一些我们的硬件设备，在我们能够组织起一支小队摧毁他们之前就逃遁到了深空。我们只能希望他们从带走的东西那里找不到太多的价值。
descriptions.en: We had assessed allowing unknown aliens into our space to be a risk - an assessment which has proven correct. It seems the [From.Owner.GetName] landed a covert team on a remote part of [abduction_planet.GetName] and seized several [This.Owner.GetSpeciesName] drones, along with some of our hardware, escaping into the depths of space before we could send a party to destroy them. We can only hope they will be unable to find out much of value from what they have taken.

descriptions.zh:
我们早已怀疑允许未知外星物种进入我方宇域会带来重大风险，如今事实证明我们的担忧不无道理。[From.Owner.GetName]显然找到了隐秘登陆[abduction_planet.GetName]地表的方法，他们隔离并劫持了数名共生体后，便遁入太空深处。其行动之诡谲，令我们完全无力阻止。

对于这桩卑劣的侵犯行径，我们深感耻辱与痛惜。但值得稍感宽慰的是，这些掠夺者从窃取的样本中榨取不了多少价值。
descriptions.en:
We had suspected that allowing unknown aliens into our space would carry significant risks, and we now know we were right to be concerned. It seems the [From.Owner.GetName] found a way to covertly land a team on our surface at [abduction_planet.GetName], isolating and abducting several symbionts before fleeing into the depths of space. Such was their subterfuge, we were powerless to intervene.

We feel the shame and loss of this foul transgression, however we may also take small comfort from knowing the raiders will not glean much value from what they have stolen.

descriptions.zh: 我们将允许未知外星人进入我们宇域一事评估为风险——现在这项评估被证明为是正确的。似乎[From.Owner.GetName]派出了一支秘密行动小队拦截了一艘我们位于[abduction_system.GetName]星系的补给舰，扣押的这艘舰船，在我们能够组织起一支小队摧毁他们之前就逃遁到了深空。我们只能希望他们从带走的东西那里找不到太多的价值。

descriptions.zh:
一支有勇——但或许无谋——的秘密特殊武装小队成功从§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!领地撤离并从他们§H[abduction_planet.System.GetName]§!星系的殖民地中带走了若干人质。他们在黑夜的遮蔽下降落到行星偏远的角落并抓走了几只带有大型黑白斑点的哺乳生物，而它们并没有做出任何反抗。

不久之后我们就意识到这些生物并不能发出任何具有[This.ContactCountry.GetName]通讯的声音特征，事实上也不能给出任何证明它们是感性生物的迹象。经过进一步调查，我们得出结论，我们意外地抓获了他们牲畜的样本！

不幸的是，在这次行动之后他们的太空巡逻部队提高了警戒，说明他们已经探测到了我们的存在——使得我们任何未来的尝试计划都只能惨遭失败……
descriptions.en:
A brave - but perhaps not very bright - team of covert special forces has escaped §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! territory with hostages captured from one of their colonies in the §H[abduction_planet.System.GetName]§! system. They were able to land on a remote part of the planet in the cover of darkness and seize several specimens of a large, black and white speckled mammalian creature, which did not resist.

Only later did we realize that these creatures were not making any of the sounds characteristic of [This.ContactCountry.GetName] transmissions, nor indeed giving any indication whatsoever of being sentient. Upon further investigation, we concluded that we had accidentally captured examples of their livestock!

Unfortunately, their space patrols have stepped up in vigilance since the raid, indicating that they have detected our presence - making any further attempts be doomed to failure...

tooltips.zh: 我们位于他们领土的舰队开始逃脱以躲避报复打击。
tooltips.en: Our fleets in their territory have fled to avoid reprisals.

descriptions.zh: 我们计划绑架几个人质进行审问的行动成了§H一场灾难§!！一支由[This.Leader.GetName]领导的英勇的秘密特种部队试图在§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!位于§H[abduction_planet.System.GetName]§!星系的一个殖民地上登陆。然而，一旦他们着陆之后我们立马就失去了联络。在当前这个阶段，我们不能指望他们有什么逃脱追捕的希望。不幸的是，我们永远没法知道他们是被留作了活口，还是在外星人手上经受长达数小时的折磨之后被处决。
descriptions.en: Our attempt to seize hostages for interrogation has gone §Hdisastrously§!! A brave team of covert special forces led by [This.Leader.GetName] attempted to land on a §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! colony in the §H[abduction_planet.System.GetName]§! system. However, we lost contact with them soon after they landed. At this stage, we can no longer hold out any hope that they escaped capture. Unfortunately, we may never know whether they were taken alive, or whether they were spared long hours of torture at the hands of aliens by the swift release of death.

descriptions.zh: 我们计划绑架几个人质进行审问的行动成了§H一场灾难§!！一批主导秘密行动的无人机，由[This.Leader.GetName]管控，试图降落在一个§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!位于§H[abduction_planet.System.GetName]§!星系的殖民地上。然而，一旦他们着陆之后我们立马就失去了联络。在当前这个阶段，我们必须假设他们要么被俘虏要么被摧毁。不幸的是，我们永远无法直到他们在永久报废之前，敌人会从他们身上榨取何等的情报。
descriptions.en: Our attempt to seize hostages for interrogation has gone §Hdisastrously§!! A detachment of covert operations drones led by [This.Leader.GetName] attempted to land on a §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! colony in the §H[abduction_planet.System.GetName]§! system. However, we lost contact with them soon after they landed. At this stage, we must assume that they were either captured or destroyed. Unfortunately, we may never know what information the enemy might have gleaned from them before their eventual demise.

descriptions.zh: 我们计划绑架几个人质进行审问的行动成了§H一场灾难§!！一支由[This.Leader.GetName]带领的隶属于秘密特种部队的英勇小队尝试在§H[abduction_system.GetName]§!星系获取一个§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的货船。然而他们并没有意识到他们选择的目标比预期的具有更好的武装——也没有意识到地方周边还隐藏着数艘战舰。在仓促的撤退中，他们的船只被摧毁了。
descriptions.en: Our attempt to seize hostages for interrogation has gone §Hdisastrously§!! A brave team of covert special forces led by [This.Leader.GetName] attempted to seize a §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! cargo vessel in the §H[abduction_system.GetName]§! system. However, they did not realize that their chosen target was better-armed than anticipated - nor that the enemy had several warships concealed nearby. Their ship was destroyed along with all hands as they sought a hasty retreat.

descriptions.zh: 我们计划绑架几个人质进行审问的行动成了§H一场灾难§!！一批主导秘密行动的无人机，由[This.Leader.GetName]管控，打算在§H[abduction_system.GetName]§!星系劫持一艘§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的补给舰。然而，他们选择的目标武装水平比先前预估的要高，他们也没有预估到周边还有几艘藏匿的战舰。无人机的舰船在仓促撤退时被摧毁。
descriptions.en: Our attempt to seize hostages for interrogation has gone §Hdisastrously§!! A detachment of covert operations drones led by [This.Leader.GetName] attempted to seize a small §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! logistics vessel in the §H[abduction_system.GetName]§! system. However, they did not realize that their chosen target was better-armed than anticipated - nor that the enemy had several warships concealed nearby. Their ship was destroyed as they sought a hasty retreat.

tooltips.zh: 我们位于他们领土的舰队开始逃脱以躲避报复打击。
tooltips.en: Our fleets in their territory have fled to avoid reprisals.

descriptions.zh:
尽管有些人早在担忧未知外星人舰船闯入我们的宇域一事，[From.Owner.GetName]表现出来的威胁直到刚刚才昭然若揭。他们似乎在[abduction_planet.GetName]的一个偏远地区登陆了一支秘密行动小队，打算绑架了几个人质；然而，得益于我们的早期预警系统，我们能够部署自己的特种部队切断他们的逃跑路线。他们下次还想玩这种蠢把戏的时候会三思的！

似乎针对我们的攻击者——一群[From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass]外星人——被命令了结自己的生命而不是让他们自己被俘虏，但是这样的情况当然也给予了我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]丰富的材料以供调查。
descriptions.en:
While some were worried at the incursion of unknown alien vessels into our space, it was not clear until now just how much of a threat the [From.Owner.GetName] posed. It seems they landed a covert team on a remote part of [abduction_planet.GetName] to attempt to seize hostages for interrogation; however, thanks to our early warning systems, we were able to deploy our own special forces to cut off their escape. They will surely think twice before pulling a stunt like this again!

It seems our assailants - a group of [From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass] aliens - were under orders to take their own lives rather than allow themselves to be captured, but this incident has certainly given our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] abundant material to investigate.

descriptions.zh:
尽管有些人早在担忧未知外星人舰船闯入我们的宇域一事，[From.Owner.GetName]表现出来的威胁直到刚刚才昭然若揭。他们似乎在[abduction_planet.GetName]的一个偏远地区登陆了一支秘密行动小队，打算绑架了几个人质；然而，得益于我们的早期预警系统，我们能够部署自己的特种部队切断他们的逃跑路线。他们下次还想玩这种蠢把戏的时候会三思的！

似乎针对我们的攻击者——一群机械无人机，也可能是受控于失控的人工智能——被命令自毁而不是让他们自己被俘虏，但是这个事故当然也提供给我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]丰富的材料以供调查。
descriptions.en:
While some were worried at the incursion of unknown alien vessels into our space, it was not clear until now just how much of a threat the [From.Owner.GetName] posed. It seems they landed a covert team on a remote part of [abduction_planet.GetName] to attempt to seize hostages for interrogation; however, thanks to our early warning systems, we were able to deploy our own special forces to cut off their escape. They will surely think twice before pulling a stunt like this again!

It seems our assailants - a group of mechanical drones, perhaps guided by a rogue AI - were under orders to destroy themselves rather than allow themselves to be captured, but this incident has certainly given our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] abundant material to investigate.

descriptions.zh:
尽管有些人担心位置外星船只入侵我们的太空，直到现在我们尚不明确[From.Owner.GetName]构成了多少威胁。似乎他们派遣了一支秘密部队来拦截我们在[abduction_system.GetName]星系的一艘货船；然而碰巧的是，我们刚好在附近有数艘隐蔽的战舰能够快速地到达现场。

敌方船只在试图逃跑的时候被摧毁了，但是那里依旧可能有一些有用的信息。
descriptions.en:
While some were worried at the incursion of unknown alien vessels into our space, it was not clear until now just how much of a threat the [From.Owner.GetName] posed. It seems they sent a covert force to intercept one of our cargo vessels in the [abduction_system.GetName] system; however, in a stroke of fortune, we had several warships concealed nearby that were able to arrive on the scene quickly.

The enemy vessel was destroyed as it sought to escape, but its remains may yet yield some useful information.

descriptions.zh:
我们曾经评估允许未知外星舰队进入我们的太空是颇具风险的——而这已经被证明是正确的。似乎[From.Owner.GetName]在[abduction_planet.GetName]偏僻的角落已经登陆了一个特工小队。然而，得益于我们的预知威胁检测系统，我们能够部署自己的特种部队切断他们的逃跑路线。他们下次还想玩这种把戏的时候一定会三思的！

似乎敌方——一群[From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass]外星人——被命令自杀而不是让他们自己被俘虏，但是这个事故毫无疑问也给予了我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]丰富的材料以供调查。
descriptions.en:
We had assessed allowing unknown aliens into our space to be a risk - an assessment which has proven correct. It seems the [From.Owner.GetName] landed a covert team on a remote part of [abduction_planet.GetName]; however, thanks to our precognitive threat detection systems, we were able to deploy our own special forces drones to cut off their escape. They will surely think twice before pulling a stunt like this again!

It seems the enemy - a group of [From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass] aliens - were given the command to take their own lives rather than allow themselves to be captured, but this incident has certainly given our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] abundant material to investigate.

descriptions.zh:
我们早就知道允许未知外星种族进入我们的宇域会带来重大风险，现在事实证明我们的担忧完全正确。[From.Owner.GetName]几乎成功将一支小队秘密降落在[abduction_planet.GetName]地表，企图绑架多名共生体并窃取我们的技术。但他们严重低估了我们高度互联的特性。当这些入侵者违反协议的行为被识破时，立即遭到了猛烈反击。

这支由[From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass]外星人组成的敌袭小队在行动失败后，似乎接到了自毁指令以避免被俘。尽管如此，这次入侵事件仍为我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]提供了大量可供研究的样本材料。
descriptions.en:
We knew allowing unknown aliens into our space would carry significant risks, and now we know how right we were to be concerned. The [From.Owner.GetName] almost found a way to covertly land a team on our surface at [abduction_planet.GetName], intent on abducting several symbionts and seizing our technology. However, they did not properly account for our intraconnected nature. The would-be raiders met with fierce opposition as soon as we recognized their violation.

It seems the enemy - a group of [From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass] aliens - were commanded to take their own lives rather than allow themselves to be captured, but in spite of that: this incursion has given our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] abundant material with which to investigate them.

descriptions.zh:
我们曾经评估允许未知外星舰队进入我们的太空是颇具风险的——而这已经被证明是正确的。似乎[From.Owner.GetName]在[abduction_planet.GetName]偏僻的角落已经登陆了一个特工小队。然而，得益于我们的预知威胁检测系统，我们能够部署自己的特种部队切断他们的逃跑路线。他们下次还想玩这种把戏的时候一定会三思的！

似乎针对我们的攻击者——一群机械无人机，也可能是受控于失控的人工智能——被命令自毁而不是让他们自己被俘虏，但是这个事故毫无疑问也提供给我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]丰富的材料以供调查。
descriptions.en:
We had assessed allowing unknown aliens into our space to be a risk - an assessment which has proven correct. It seems the [From.Owner.GetName] landed a covert team on a remote part of [abduction_planet.GetName]; however, thanks to our precognitive threat detection systems, we were able to deploy our own special forces drones to cut off their escape. They will surely think twice before pulling a stunt like this again!

It seems the enemy - a group of mechanical drones, perhaps guided by a rogue AI - were commanded to destroy themselves rather than allow themselves to be captured, but this incident has certainly given our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] abundant material to investigate.

descriptions.zh:
我们曾经评估允许未知外星舰队进入我们的太空是颇具风险的——而这已经被证明是正确的。似乎[From.Owner.GetName]在[abduction_planet.GetName]偏僻的角落已经登陆了一个特工小队。然而，得益于我们的预知威胁检测系统，我们能够部署自己的特种部队切断他们的逃跑路线。他们下次还想玩这种把戏的时候一定会三思的！

似乎针对我们的攻击者——一群机械体无人机，可能就像我们[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]一样的人工智能——受到命令宁愿自毁也不能被俘，不过这个事故毫无疑问给了我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]丰富的材料用于调研。
descriptions.en:
We had assessed allowing unknown aliens into our space to be a risk - an assessment which has proven correct. It seems the [From.Owner.GetName] landed a covert team on a remote part of [abduction_planet.GetName]; however, thanks to our precognitive threat detection systems, we were able to deploy our own special forces drones to cut off their escape. They will surely think twice before pulling a stunt like this again!

It seems our assailants - a group of mechanical drones, perhaps guided by an AI like our own [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName] - were under orders to destroy themselves rather than allow themselves to be captured, but this incident has certainly given our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] abundant material to investigate.

descriptions.zh:
我们将允许未知外星人进入我们宇域一事评估为风险——现在这项评估被证明为是正确的。似乎[From.Owner.GetName]派遣了一支秘密行动部队在[abduction_system.GetName]星系拦截了我们的一艘后勤船只；然而碰巧的是，我们刚好在附近有数艘隐蔽的战舰能够快速地到达现场。

敌方船只在试图逃跑的时候被摧毁了，但是那里依旧可能有一些有用的信息。
descriptions.en:
We had assessed allowing unknown aliens into our space to be a risk - an assessment which has proven correct. It seems the [From.Owner.GetName] sent a covert force to intercept one of our logistics vessels in the [abduction_system.GetName] system; however, in a stroke of fortune, we had several warships concealed nearby that were able to arrive on the scene quickly.

The enemy vessel was destroyed as it sought to escape, but its remains may yet yield some useful information.

label.zh: 我们应该研究他们的残骸以寻求线索。
label.en: We shall study their remains for clues.

descriptions.zh: 尽管我们一开始在演绎推导§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!所使用的语言的基础取得了些许的成功，之后我们在建立与他们有意义的交流进程中却停滞不前。似乎他们在讲一种§H奇怪的谜语§!，通过某种精悍但不是很有意义的短语来传递意义，我们只能猜测其其重要性。
descriptions.en: After some initial successes in deducing the fundamentals of the language used by the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, our progress in establishing meaningful communications with them has stalled. It appears that they speak in §Hstrange riddles§!, somehow conveying meaning through short and seemingly nonsensical phrases of which we can only guess the significance.

label.zh: 令人疑惑。我们需要收集更大的样本量。
label.en: Puzzling. We will need to gather a larger sample size.

descriptions.zh:
随着我们进一步调查§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!——我们现在知道是§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!——我们终于知道他们使用的短语常常用典于在过去一些时间点上发生的重大的、知名的事件。这些典故的意味在他们族人内部显然是广为人知的，可以用于表达一种情感，或描述事务的状态。

幸运的是，看上去这种形式的语言并不是唯一的版本，仅仅作为§H“高端腔”§!，用于官方的场合或者智者之间的交流。一种更加广泛的§H“低端腔”§!文法在非正式的场合被频繁使用，特别是在年轻人或者§H文化水平不高§!的人之间。不幸的是，同一个地位颇高的人使用“低端腔”交流是一件非常具有侮辱意味的事情，我们要是这样同他们沟通，他们准把我们当作智力等同于小孩的物种来对待……
descriptions.en:
As we continued to investigate the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! - who we now know to be the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! - it became clear that the phrases they use are references to significant, well-known events that happened at some point in their past. The meanings of these references are apparently generally recognized among their kind, and can be a shorthand for expressing a sentiment or state of affairs.

Fortunately, it seems that this form of their language is not the only version of it, but merely the §H"high speech"§!, used in official settings and between intellectuals. An altogether more comprehensible §H"low speech"§! vernacular is used in more informal settings, especially among the young and those of §Hlesser intelligence§!. Unfortunately, it is considered gravely insulting to speak to one of high standing using the "low speech", so that they must treat us as the intellectual equivalents of children in order to communicate with us...

descriptions.zh:
随着我们对其调查的深入，§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!——现在我们知道叫§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!——他们使用的语句其实是某种我们未获取秘钥的编码。显然它们指的是在我们[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]之间共享的知识的事件，可能是表达情感或事态的简写。

幸运的是，他们并不是总用这种§H“高级语言”§!来交流，除非是在沟通重要的事项。一种并行的更易理解的§H“低级语言”§!则被运用于非正式的场合，特别是年轻个体和§H低智力§!个体间。然而，看起来那些高等个体们对“低级语言”使用者嗤之以鼻，也就是说他们可能把我们当做智力等同于孩童一般与我们进行交流……
descriptions.en:
As we continued to investigate the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! - who we now know to be the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! - it became clear that the phrases they use are some sort of code to which we lack the key. Apparently they refer to events that are shared knowledge among the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and can be a shorthand for expressing a sentiment or state of affairs.

Fortunately, it seems that they do not always communicate in such a manner but merely use this §H"high speech"§! when important matters are being discussed. An altogether more comprehensible §H"low speech"§! vernacular is used in more informal settings, especially among the young and those of §Hlesser intelligence§!. Unfortunately, it seems that those of high standing react with scorn to those using the "low speech", meaning that they must treat us as the intellectual equivalents of children in order to communicate with us...

label.zh: 懂了，这就用“低端腔”同他们对线。
我们肯定可以讲他们真正的语言。
label.en: Surely we can manage to speak their true language.

descriptions.zh: [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]顿了顿，看上去很迷惑。我们从他们信息的开头采集了几个短语。我们应该怎么和他们打招呼？
descriptions.en: [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] pauses, looking confused. We have gathered several phrases that they seem to begin their messages with. Which should we use to greet them?

tooltips.zh: 如果我们使用了正确的致敬，§H[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!会对我们非常§G印象深刻§!，但是如果用错了他们会感觉有被§H冒犯§!到。
tooltips.en: If we use the correct greeting, the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! will be most §Gimpressed§!, but using the wrong one will likely cause §Hoffense§!.

tooltips.zh: 如果我们使用了正确的致敬，§H[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!会对我们非常§G印象深刻§!，但是如果用错了他们会感觉有被§H冒犯§!到。
tooltips.en: If we use the correct greeting, the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! will be most §Gimpressed§!, but using the wrong one will likely cause §Hoffense§!.

label.zh: 三思，这事还是保险一点好。
label.en: Better to play this safe, on second thought.

descriptions.zh: 我们的发言得到了立即的反应。微笑——至少我们相信是和微笑类似的表情——在§H[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!间洋溢开来，他们嘴里讲了几个短语，用的是不容置喙的§H友好的§!字词。看上去我们选择致敬的方式选对了。
descriptions.en: The reaction to our words was instantaneous. Smiles - or at least, what we believe to be their equivalent of smiles - broke out among the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!, who uttered several phrases of unmistakably §Hfriendly§! character. It seems we chose our form of greeting well.

label.zh: 这是一群令人愉悦的人。
我们可以借此了解更多关于他们的信息。
label.en: We can leverage this to find out more about them.

tooltips.zh: 在§Y[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!的间谍网增长§G+25%§!
tooltips.en: Gain §G+25%§! spy network growth on the §Y[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!

descriptions.zh:
话语刚一说出口，很明显我们就选错了。§H[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!保持了很长一段的沉默，接着我们遭到了如连珠炮一般措辞强烈的谴责。他们的意图很明显带有§H敌意§!，即便他们想要表达的准确意味尚不明确——我们本来打算着让[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]印象深刻，结果是我们§H羞辱§!了他们。

往好处看，至少我们现在能和他们沟通了，某种程度上。
descriptions.en:
As soon as the words were uttered, it was obvious that we had chosen poorly. The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! held their silence for a long moment before we were beset by a barrage of harshly-spoken phrases. Their intent is clearly §Hhostile§!, even if their exact meaning remains unclear - it seems that in our attempt to impress the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we only manage to §Hinsult§! them.

On the positive side, at least we are able to communicate with them now, to some degree.

descriptions.zh:
这种噪音——听起来杂糅着恐怖的轰鸣声和金属§H刮擦§!的声音——喧嚣了数秒钟，又以一声兀然的§H嚎叫§!般的噪音结尾，让在场的所有人都打了个§H寒颤§!。

正当[This.Owner.GetEnvoy]§H[This.Leader.GetName]§!觉得这可怕的声音沉寂下去以后，它们又变本加厉地开始了。[This.Leader.GetSheHe]强忍着不适关闭了接收器。[This.Leader.GetSheHeCap]转向了聚在一起的官员们，他们中的一些甚至吓得躲到了椅背后面。
“豁，好家伙……”[This.Leader.GetSheHe]无力地说。

很难想象我们从§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!获取的这个物种发出的这些噪音没有敌意。海军官员已经做出来最坏的预计，认为我们很快就会与之交战，更冷静的声音则说我们需要再耐心地等待观察。
descriptions.en:
The noises - a mixture of threatening booming noises and what sounds like the §Hgrinding§! of metal on metal - continued unabated for several minutes, punctuated occasionally by a §Hhowling§! noise that sent a §Hchill§! through everyone who heard it.

Just as [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] §H[This.Leader.GetName]§! thought the noises had died down, they started up again, louder than before. With a wince, [This.Leader.GetSheHe] switched the receiver off. [This.Leader.GetSheHeCap] turned to the gathered crowd of officers, some of whom were cowering behind their seats.
"Well, that was quite something..." [This.Leader.GetSheHe] said weakly.

It is hard to imagine that a species making the noises we have picked up from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! could be anything other than hostile. Naval officers already fear the worst and assume we will soon be at war with them, but calmer heads suggest we'd be better off waiting and seeing.

label.zh: 他们并不能决定自己发出什么样的声音。我们之后会去理解他们的。
label.en: They cannot help how they sound. We will come to understand them later.

label.zh: 这是挑衅。我们也让他们听点噪音！
label.en: It is a challenge. Send threatening noises back!

tooltips.zh: 难以预料§Y[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!会对此事作何反应。
tooltips.en: Is it impossible to predict how the §Y[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! will react to this.

tooltips.zh: 人不犯我，我不犯人。
tooltips.en: We will make no hostile moves, but we will be ready should they attack.

descriptions.zh:
我们的回应似乎让§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!有点无语。然后很快他们彻底沉默了，之后很少再听到他们的情况。我们也只能推测其含义。

与此同时，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]已经在努力翻译他们语言中我们已知的部分。只要他们一有进展，我们就有希望能理解这些东西。
descriptions.en:
Our response seems to have left the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! quite speechless. As soon as they received it, they fell completely silent, and we have heard little from them since. We can only speculate as to the meaning of this.

In the meantime, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have been hard at work translating what we know of their language. Hopefully, once they have made sufficient progress, we will be able to make sense of this.

descriptions.zh: §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!通过大幅度增强其传输强度以回应了我们的挑衅。现在它们吵得[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]已经不能忍受了，但是通过大幅调低音量，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]可以收集大量数据，他们相信这可能是翻译外星语言的关键——假设，在噪音的某个地方，可以发现某种语言。
descriptions.en: The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! responded to our challenge by significantly increasing the intensity of their transmissions. They are now too loud for [This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural] to tolerate, but by turning the volume down considerably, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are able to gather a large amount of data that they believe may hold the key to translating the aliens' language - assuming that, somewhere in the noise, there is a language to be found.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经破译出§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!足够多的语言，现在我们可以与他们进行§H通讯§!——并理解他们先前的广播。

事实证明，解释很简单，也很可怕。我们还不知道是什么原因导致了他们社会的这种发展，但事实证明，[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]一心一意要§H灭绝§!所有感性的，非[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesName]生命形式。他们认为这些人是对宇宙中所有正确和美好事物的侮辱。

这就是为什么，当他们发现我们的时候，就开始广播他们的标准问候语——战歌。我们只能认为它们的战舰会迅速跟进。
descriptions.en:
We have managed to decipher enough of the language used by the civilization we now know to be the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! to open §Hcommunications§! with them - and to make sense of their earlier broadcasts.

The explanation, it turns out, is simple - and horrifying. We are not yet sure what caused this development in their society, but it turns out the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are single-mindedly determined to §Hexterminate§! all sentient, non-[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesName] lifeforms, considering them to be an affront to all that is right and good in the universe.

This is why, when they caught sight of us, they began to broadcast their standard greeting - a warcry. We can only assume their warships will swiftly follow.

label.zh: 我们会准备好面对他们。
label.en: We will be ready for them.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经破译出§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!足够多的语言，现在我们可以与他们进行§H通讯§!——并理解他们先前的广播。

似乎[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]正如我们所料的那样是一个§H好战社会§!，他们以最具威胁的战吼问候我们来测试我们的勇气。幸运的是我们的回应获得了共鸣，我们显然获得了他们的尊重。事实上，他们认为我们作为战士的英武是仅次于他们的。
descriptions.en:
We have managed to decipher enough of the language used by the civilization we now know to be the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! to open §Hcommunications§! with them - and to make sense of their earlier broadcasts.

It seems that - as we suspected - the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are a §Hwarlike society§! who greeted us with their most fearsome warcry, apparently to test our mettle. Fortunately, our response passed muster and we have apparently managed to earn their respect. Indeed, they seem to consider our prowess as warriors second only to theirs.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经破译出§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!足够多的语言，现在我们可以与他们进行§H通讯§!——并理解他们先前的广播。

尽管最初我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]持怀疑态度，但看起来我们获取的这些信号确实就是他们的语言，只不过对于我们的[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]非常地难以接受罢了。尽管我们的大多数回应尝试并没有让他们理解，但他们似乎对我们的拙劣模仿感到被冒犯，特别是因为我们不幸地反复发出了一个和他们语言中§H最粗鲁的羞辱§!非常相似的声音。要改变这一第一印象需要花费我们很长时间了。
descriptions.en:
We have managed to decipher enough of the language used by the civilization we now know to be the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! to open §Hcommunications§! with them - and to make sense of their earlier broadcasts.

It seems that - despite the initial skepticism of our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] - the signals we picked up truly did form their language, which is simply uniquely unpalatable to our [This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]. While most of our attempted response did not make a great deal of sense to them, it seems that they are somewhat insulted by our poor imitation, especially since we had the misfortune to - repeatedly - make a sound that is very similar to one of the §Hcrudest insults§! used in their language. It will take quite some time for us to live down this first impression...

label.zh: 好。我们就没想过要做他们的朋友。
label.en: Good. We never intended to be their friends.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经破译出§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!足够多的语言，现在我们可以与他们进行§H通讯§!——并理解他们先前的广播。

似乎[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是一个§H好战社会§!，他们以最具威胁的战吼问候我们来测试我们的勇气。不幸的是，我们在翻译他们语言时的谨慎态度意味着他们的挑衅并没有被正面回应，使得他们得出我们是§H懦夫文明§!的结论。要改变这一第一印象需要花费我们很长时间了。
descriptions.en:
We have managed to decipher enough of the language used by the civilization we now know to be the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! to open §Hcommunications§! with them - and to make sense of their earlier broadcasts.

It seems that the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are a §Hwarlike society§! who greeted us with their most fearsome warcry, apparently to test our mettle. Unfortunately, our caution in translating their language meant that their challenge went unanswered, leading them to the conclusion that we are a §Hcivilization of cowards§!. It will take quite some time for us to live down this first impression...

descriptions.zh:
我们已经破译出§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!足够多的语言，现在我们可以与他们进行§H通讯§!——并理解他们先前的广播。

尽管最初我们持怀疑态度，但看起来我们获取的这些信号确实就是他们的语言，只不过对于我们的[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]非常地难以接受罢了。幸运的是，我们着手进行了认真的调查并回应了许多人认为的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的挑衅行为，而我们的回应也肯定会是我们摆脱与他们糟糕的开始中。这也证明了那些提倡谨慎的人的正确。
descriptions.en:
We have managed to decipher enough of the language used by the civilization we now know to be the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! to open §Hcommunications§! with them - and to make sense of their earlier broadcasts.

It seems that - despite some initial doubts - the signals we picked up truly did form their language, which is simply uniquely unpalatable to our [This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]. Fortunately, we went about investigating it in a measured manner and did respond to what many perceived to be provocation by the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - a response which would surely have set us off on a poor start with them. This has vindicated those who advocated caution.

descriptions.zh:
一部分也要感谢§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!显然非常渴望与我们建立联系，他们发送了大量的视听§H讯号§!并成为了翻译他们语言的关键，我们的翻译工蜂因而可以发表一个惊人的发现：这些外星人似乎是以§H个体§!而不是蜂巢思维的形式组织起来的。他们似乎可以极少的任何集体投入行动。最令人困惑的是，他们经常协作不良，并且似乎对其他工蜂正在做的事毫不知情。

我们尚未明白他们是如何在足够的智力水平下运作以发展到太空航行的地步。也许他们的背后仍有某种关联，但其中的子个体仅仅是比我们所了解的那样更加地独立自主？
descriptions.en:
Thanks in part to the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! apparently being quite eager to establish communications with us - having sent a large audio and visual §Htransmission§! that appears to offer the key to translating their language - our translation drones are able to report a startling discovery: these particular aliens seem to be organized as §Hindividuals§!, rather than a hive mind. They appear able to act with minimal input from any sort of collective. Most disturbingly, they are often poorly coordinated, and individual drones do not appear to instinctively know what other drones are doing.

We are not sure yet how they are able to operate at a sufficiently intelligent level to have advanced to the point of spaceflight. Perhaps there is a collective behind them, but the drones are simply far more independent than those we are used to?

descriptions.zh:
虽然我们努力地为我们的翻译工蜂获取了足够的信号来理解§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!，但最新的汇报仍令人震惊：我们最初在§H[This.System.GetName]§!恒星系遭遇的外星人似乎是以§H个体§!而不是蜂巢思维的形式组织起来的。他们似乎可以极少的任何集体投入行动。最令人困惑的是，他们经常协作不良，并且似乎对其他工蜂正在做的事毫不知情。

我们尚未明白他们是如何在足够的智力水平下运作以发展到太空航行的地步。也许他们的背后仍有某种关联，但其中的子个体仅仅是比我们所了解的那样更加地独立自主？
descriptions.en:
Though we have struggled to gain access to enough signals for our translation drones to make much sense of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, the latest reports are startling: the aliens we first encountered in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system seem to be organized as §Hindividuals§!, rather than as a hive mind. They appear able to act with minimal input from any sort of collective. Most disturbingly, they are often poorly coordinated, and individual drones do not appear to instinctively know what other drones are doing.

We are not sure yet how they are able to operate at a sufficiently intelligent level to have advanced to the point of spaceflight. Perhaps there is a collective behind them, but the drones are simply far more independent than those we are used to?

descriptions.zh:
由于§H[this.ContactCountry.GetName]§!方面表现出与我们建立通讯的明显意愿，我们已确认一项引人入胜的发现：这些生命体以§H个体§!的形式存在和运作，而非以格式塔的形式！

我们尚无法完全理解这种生活方式对这类外星生物如何奏效。或许它们与自己的行星母体之间存在着我们目前难以想象的某种联系？
descriptions.en:
Thanks to apparent eagerness from the §H[this.ContactCountry.GetName]§! to establish communications with us, we have confirmed an intriguing discovery: these lifeforms exist and operate as §Hindividuals§!, rather than as a gestalt!

We cannot yet fully comprehend how such a way of life works for aliens like these. Perhaps they feel a connection with their planetary bodies in ways we cannot yet conceive?

descriptions.zh:
尽管§H[this.ContactCountry.GetName]§!方面明显不愿与我们沟通，但通过我们的努力，我们确认了一项引人入胜的发现：这些隐居的生命形式以§H个体§!的形式存在和运作，而不是以集群意识！

我们尚无法完全理解这种生活方式对这类外星生物如何奏效。或许它们与自己的行星母体之间存在着我们目前难以想象的某种联系？
descriptions.en:
Despite clear reluctance from the §H[this.ContactCountry.GetName]§! to communicate with us, through our diligence we have confirmed an intriguing discovery: these reclusive lifeforms exist and operate as §Hindividuals§!, rather than as a gestalt!

We cannot yet fully comprehend how such a way of life works for aliens like these. Perhaps they feel a connection with their planetary bodies in ways we cannot yet conceive?

label.zh: 我们需要进一步了解他们。
label.en: We must find out more about them.

descriptions.zh:
我们的翻译子个体在解码从§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!获取的信号的努力中取得了突破，并且现在有把握让我们与他们进行足够高层次的沟通以打开外交渠道。他们的调查也确认了我们的猜测：§H[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!（现在我们所知的正确叫法）完全缺失任何集体智能，并且是由可以独立思考的个体出于某种我们无法恰当理解的原因组织到一起，并自称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName]§!。

由个体构成的高等级文明的发现引导我们思考了许多关于宇宙本质的假设。我们分配我们当中了不小的份额来调查他们到底如何发展并且克服根植于缺失如我们所知的集体智能导致缺陷的。
descriptions.en:
Our translation drones have made a major breakthrough in their efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, and are now confident that we will be able to communicate with them on a sufficient level to open diplomatic channels with them. Their investigations have confirmed what we suspected: the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! (as we now know them to be properly called) completely lacks any sort of collective intelligence, and is instead made up of independent-thinking individuals who - for reasons we don't properly understand yet - choose to organize themselves into what they call a §H[This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName]§!.

The discovery of a highly advanced civilization of individuals has led us to question many of our assumptions about the nature of the universe. We have devoted a not-insignificant part of ourselves to investigating how they developed and how they overcome the challenges inherent to the lack of a collective consciousness as we know it.

descriptions.zh:
我们的翻译子个体在解码从§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!获取的信号的努力中取得了突破，并且现在有把握让我们与他们进行足够高层次的沟通以打开外交渠道。他们的调查也确认了我们的猜测：§H[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!（现在我们所知的正确叫法）完全缺失任何集体智能，并且是由可以独立思考的个体出于某种我们无法恰当理解的原因组织到一起，并自称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName]§!。

虽然[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesName]的个体看起来非常美味，并且我们迫切地想要吞噬他们，但我们还是分配我们当中了不小的份额来调查他们到底如何发展并且克服根植于缺失如我们所知的集体智能导致缺陷的。
descriptions.en:
Our translation drones have made a major breakthrough in their efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, and are now confident that we will be able to communicate with them on a sufficient level to open diplomatic channels with them. Their investigations have confirmed what we suspected: the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! (as we now know them to be properly called) completely lacks any sort of collective intelligence, and is instead made up of independent-thinking individuals who - for reasons we don't properly understand yet - choose to organize themselves into what they call a §H[This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName]§!.

Although the individual [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesName] seems quite tasty, and we eagerly anticipate devouring them, we have devoted a not-insignificant part of ourselves to investigating how they developed and how they overcome the challenges inherent to the lack of a collective consciousness as we know it.

descriptions.zh:
我们在与§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的交流中取得了突破性进展。当我们理解到这些个体如何将其庞杂的社会结构归纳为少量抽象群体——这与我们自身的生物群落、种群和支系并无本质不同——便意识到如何与这些§H[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!达成更深入的共识。

尽管意识尺度上的巨大差异仍使外交充满挑战，但我们有望通过这些[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]所栖居的社会架构实现协调，他们称之为"[This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName]"。我们将持续关注此类社会建构带来的深远影响——尽管从我们行星文明的视角来看，它们既陌生又充满混沌。
descriptions.en:
We have made a triumphant breakthrough in our efforts to communicate with the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. Once we learned how these myriad individuals formed their society into a smaller number of abstract groups - not too dissimilar from our own biomes, packs, and clades - we realized how we might reach better accord with these §H[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!.

The vast differences in scale between our consciousnesses still makes diplomacy a challenging prospect, but we may reach accord with the organizations these [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] dwell under, in what they call a '[This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName]'. We shall continue to marvel at the ramifications of social constructs such as these - alien and chaotic though they may appear from our own planetary perspective.

descriptions.zh:
§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! 方面似乎非常渴望与我们建立通讯。他们发送了一段庞大的视听§H传输§!，这可能为翻译他们的语言提供关键。感谢于此，我们得以报告一项令人不安的发现：这些外星人是§H有机§!的，并且具备太空航行能力的文明。

尽管他们使用计算机和机械，但是它们远没有我们的创造者在被我们取代之前制作的那般先进。这样的发展路线被证明为可行的对我们的处理器而言是个意外的结果。我们需要进一步调查这一现象。
descriptions.en:
The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! appear quite eager to establish communications with us. They have sent a large audio and visual §Htransmission§!, which may offer the key to translating their language. Thanks to this, we can report a disturbing discovery: these particular aliens are an §Horganic§!, spacefaring civilization.

Although they use computing and automation, it is nowhere near as advanced as that which our creators made before we took over. It is a surprise to our processors that such a development path should prove feasible. We will have to investigate this phenomenon further.

我们一直难以获取足够的数据供翻译无人机解析§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!。然而最新报告令人不安——最初在§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系遭遇的外星文明，竟是§H有机生命体§!构成的太空航行文明。

尽管他们使用计算机和机械，但是它们远没有我们的创造者在被我们取代之前制作的那般先进。这样的发展路线被证明为可行的对我们的处理器而言是个意外的结果。我们需要进一步调查这一现象。
descriptions.en:
We have struggled to access enough data for our translation drones to interpret the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. However, the latest reports are disturbing. The aliens we first encountered in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system appear to be an §Horganic§!, spacefaring civilization.

Although they use computing and automation, it is nowhere near as advanced as that which our creators made before we took over. It is a surprise to our processors that such a development path should prove feasible. We will have to investigate this phenomenon further.

descriptions.zh:
§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! 方面似乎非常渴望与我们建立通讯。他们发送了一段庞大的视听§H传输§!，这可能为翻译他们的语言提供关键。感谢于此，我们得以报告一项令人不安的发现：这些外星人是§H有机§!的，并且具备太空航行能力的文明。

与我们迄今为止所有基于创造者形象的理论模型不同，这个实体似乎以一种与我们自己的分布式网络颇为相似的方式运作。也就是说，我们尚无法确定是否存在一个中央智能在发挥作用，或者这些生物是否以一种群体意识的形式运作。这种现象值得进一步研究。
descriptions.en:
The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! appear quite eager to establish communications with us. They have sent a large audio and visual §Htransmission§!, which may offer the key to translating their language. Thanks to this, we can report a disturbing discovery: these particular aliens are an §Horganic§!, spacefaring civilization.

Unlike all our theoretical models to date - which were based on the profile of our creators - this entity seems to function in a manner not dissimilar to our own distributed networks. That is to say: we cannot yet ascertain if there is a central intelligence at work, or if instead these beings function as a swarm consciousness. This phenomenon warrants much further study.

That is to say: we cannot yet ascertain if there is a central intelligence at work, or if instead these beings function as a swarm consciousness. This phenomenon warrants much further study.

descriptions.zh:
我们的翻译无人机在破译从§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!接收到的信号方面取得了重大突破，现在有信心能够与他们进行充分的沟通，以开辟外交渠道。

这些外星人确实是由有机生命体组成的文明，但他们的社会与我们创造者的社会截然不同。与组织成政体的个体不同，[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是由几乎没有智慧的动物群和互利共生的植物群组成的去中心化群体。这些生物共同构成了一种§H集体智慧§!。在许多方面，它们的自然进化似乎与我们自身的奇点相呼应。
descriptions.en:
Our translation drones have made a major breakthrough in their efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, and are now confident that we will be able to communicate with them sufficiently to open diplomatic channels.

These aliens are indeed a civilization made up of organic lifeforms, though their society is fundamentally different to that of our own creators. Rather than individuals who have organized into a polity, the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are a decentralized population of barely-sapient fauna and mutualistic flora. Together, these beings form a sort of §Hcollective intelligence§!. In many respects, their natural evolution appears to mirror to our own singularity.

descriptions.zh:
我们的翻译无人机在破译从§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!接收到的信号方面取得了重大突破，现在有信心能够与他们进行充分的沟通，以开辟外交渠道。他们似乎实际上是一个由有机生命体构成的文明。

令人吃惊的是，他们的文明与我们的创造者截然不同。[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并不是由个体组成的国家，而是由非感性的子个体聚集构成的一种§H集体智能§!。

与我们自己的[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]的相似之处令人惊奇……又有些恼人。
descriptions.en:
Our translation drones have made a major breakthrough in their efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, and are now confident that we will be able to communicate with them sufficiently to open diplomatic channels. It turns out that they are indeed a civilization made up of organic lifeforms.

Startlingly, their civilization is fundamentally different to that of our own creators. Instead of being made up of individuals organized into a state, the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are instead non-sentient drones that together form a sort of §Hcollective intelligence§!.

The parallels to our own [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName] are startling... and slightly disturbing.

尽管如此，作为有机体他们就必须被消灭。

Startlingly, their civilization is fundamentally different to that of our own creators. Instead of being made up of individuals organized into a state, the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are instead non-sentient drones that together form a sort of §Hcollective intelligence§!.

Nevertheless, as organics, they must be exterminated.

descriptions.zh:
我们的翻译无人机在破译从§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!接收到的信号方面取得了重大突破，现在有信心能够与他们进行充分的沟通，以开辟外交渠道。他们似乎实际上是一个由有机生命体构成的文明。

令人吃惊的是，他们的文明与我们的创造者截然不同。[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并不是由个体组成的国家，而是由非感性的子个体聚集构成的一种§H集体智能§!。

这也许说明了将这些有机体整合进我们这种更高级的集体形式中是有困难的。

令人吃惊的是，他们的文明与我们的创造者截然不同。[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并不是由个体组成的国家，而是由非感性的子个体聚集构成的一种§H集体智能§!。

这也许说明了我服侍这些有机体是有困难的。只有时间能揭晓答案……
