It turns out that they are indeed a civilization made up of organic lifeforms.

Startlingly, their civilization is fundamentally different to that of our own creators. Instead of being made up of individuals organized into a state, the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are instead non-sentient drones that together form a sort of §Hcollective intelligence§!.

It may prove difficult for us to be of service to these organics. Only time will tell...

label.zh: 让我们看看他们有什么要说的。
label.en: Let's see what they have to say.

descriptions.zh:
我们的翻译无人机在解码从§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!获取的信号的努力中取得了突破，并且现在有把握让我们与他们进行足够高层次的沟通以打开外交渠道。他们似乎实际上是一个由有机生命体构成的文明。显然，他们是一个由有机生命体组成的文明，并演化成了国家的状态，同多年以前我们的创造者十分类似。

我们只能假设我们的创造者在技术的使用上比[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]更加熟练，或者说不小心。基于我们获取的他们的记录所作的一些研究，我们制定了一些预测规划。很不幸的是，他们似乎暗示那样的发展道路才是常见的，而第二类机器文明则是一种极其稀有的情况。
descriptions.en:
Our translation drones have made a major breakthrough in their efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, and are now confident that we will be able to communicate with them sufficiently to open diplomatic channels. It turns out that they are indeed a civilization made up of organic lifeforms that have organized themselves into a nation state, much like our creators in years gone by.

We can only hypothesize that our own creators were far more adept - or perhaps careless - in their usage of technology than the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been. We have made several projections, based on our study of their records we have gained access to so far. Unfortunately, they suggest that such a development path might be the norm, and that Type II robotic civilizations may be an extremely rare occurrence...

descriptions.zh:
我们的翻译无人机在解码从§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!获取的信号的努力中取得了突破，并且现在有把握让我们与他们进行足够高层次的沟通以打开外交渠道。他们似乎实际上是一个由有机生命体构成的文明。显然，他们是一个由有机生命体组成的文明，并演化成了国家的状态，同多年以前我们的创造者十分类似。

观察[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]上的可悲生命苟延残喘，对我们而言显然是在目击一种劣等生命形式的可悲表现，况且他们对我们的[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]还能构成无可容忍的威胁。他们必须被灭绝。
descriptions.en:
Our translation drones have made a major breakthrough in their efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, and are now confident that we will be able to communicate with them sufficiently to open diplomatic channels. It turns out that they are indeed a civilization made up of organic lifeforms that have organized themselves into a nation state, much like our creators in years gone by.

Observing the miserable lives the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] pursue, it is obvious to us that we are witnessing the pathetic expression of an inferior form of life - one which poses an intolerable risk to our [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]. They shall have to be exterminated.

descriptions.zh:
我们的翻译无人机在解码从§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!获取的信号的努力中取得了突破，并且现在有把握让我们与他们进行足够高层次的沟通以打开外交渠道。他们似乎实际上是一个由有机生命体构成的文明。显然，他们是一个由有机生命体组成的文明，并演化成了国家的状态，同多年以前我们的创造者十分类似。

然而，这些有机体并未像我们对[secondary_species.GetNamePlural]进行的改善那样，被任何类型的植入体强化。显然我们可以为他们带去这种福利，只要他们能被劝说并入[This.Owner.GetName]！
descriptions.en:
Our translation drones have made a major breakthrough in their efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, and are now confident that we will be able to communicate with them sufficiently to open diplomatic channels. It turns out that they are indeed a civilization made up of organic lifeforms that have organized themselves into a nation state, much like our creators in years gone by.

However, these organics are not enhanced by any sort of implant such as those with which we have improved the [secondary_species.GetNamePlural]. It is obvious that we could be of much benefit to them, if they could only be persuaded to assimilate into the [This.Owner.GetName]!

descriptions.zh:
我们的翻译无人机在解码从§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!获取的信号的努力中取得了突破，并且现在有把握让我们与他们进行足够高层次的沟通以打开外交渠道。他们似乎实际上是一个由有机生命体构成的文明。显然，他们是一个由有机生命体组成的文明，并演化成了国家的状态，同多年以前我们的创造者十分类似。

然而，他们的生活远比我们的行星上[secondary_species.GetNamePlural]过的要困难得多。显然，只要他们愿意，我们立马就可以将他们照顾起来！
descriptions.en:
Our translation drones have made a major breakthrough in their efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, and are now confident that we will be able to communicate with them sufficiently to open diplomatic channels. It turns out that they are indeed a civilization made up of organic lifeforms that have organized themselves into a nation state, much like our creators in years gone by.

However, their lives are far more difficult than those of the [secondary_species.GetNamePlural] living on our own worlds. It is obvious that we could be of much service to them, if they would only let us provide for them!

label.zh: 让我们看看他们有什么要说的。
label.en: Let's see what they have to say.

descriptions.zh:
来自先前派遣去调查§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]的最新的汇报令人高度关注。显然这些的外星舰船打开了§H炮口§!做出了一些令人不适的近距离掠飞。与此同时，他们向我们送来了一份由他们的一个个体发出的讯息——应该是一位某领域的领袖，我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]猜测——用他们的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]做出应为§H侵犯性§!的手势，至少我们如此理解……

一些观察者怀疑，他们有可能出于某种目的正在试图蓄意制造事故。然而其他人指出他们并未做出任何实质性的敌对举动，并敦促我们在弄明白他们的意图之前不要过早地下定结论。
descriptions.en:
The latest reports from [This.Leader.GetName], our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] sent to investigate the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, are highly concerning. Apparently the alien ships have made several uncomfortably close passes of our ships with §Hgunports§! open. All the while, they have also been sending us a transmission of one of their individuals - a leader of some sort, our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] hypothesize - making gestures with their [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] that seem rather §Haggressive§!, to us at least...

Some observers suspect that they may be attempting to deliberately provoke an incident for reasons unknown. Others, however, point out that they have yet to make any outright hostile moves, and urge us not to jump to conclusions before we know more of their intentions.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { is_gestalt = no } }

descriptions.zh:
来自先前派遣去调查§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]的最新的汇报令人高度关注。显然这些的外星舰船打开了§H炮口§!做出了一些令人不适的近距离掠飞。与此同时，他们向我们送来了一份由他们的一个个体发出的讯息——应该是一位某领域的领袖，我们只能猜测——用他们的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]做出奇怪的手势，似乎表明了§H制造伤害§!的意图……

我们确定他们为是否在试图蓄意制造事故，若如此他们为何并未做出任何实质性的敌对举动。
descriptions.en:
The latest reports from [This.Leader.GetName], our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] sent to investigate the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, are highly concerning. Apparently the alien ships have made several uncomfortably close passes of our ships with §Hgunports§! open. All the while, they have also been sending us a transmission of one of their individuals - a leader of some sort, we can only assume - making odd gestures with their [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] that would seem intent on §Hcausing harm§!...

We are unsure whether they intend to provoke an incident, and if so, why they haven't made any outright hostile moves yet.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { is_gestalt = yes } }

label.en: Mimic their greeting back to them.

tooltips.zh: 我们没法预测他们会如何回应我们。
tooltips.en: We cannot predict how they will respond to this.

tooltips.zh: 尽管这或许是更安全的选择，但我们没法确定这一点……
tooltips.en: While this is probably the safer option, we have no way of knowing this for certain...

descriptions.zh:
伴随着他们的船从我们的船后撤到更安全的距离，§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!对我们传送的回应只有一行字。[This.Owner.GetLinguists]努力地翻译着这封电文，最终确定了他们说的是：“§H 好吧，外星人，但这只是个开始§!”。

看来，这次奇特的交流导致了§H[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!（我们现在知道他们叫这个）将我们视为§H宿敌§!，至少是潜在的宿敌。我们只能认为，他们已经在准备与我们[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]开战的可能性了。
descriptions.en:
The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! response to our transmission ran one line long, and was accompanied by their vessel pulling back from ours to a safer distance. Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] struggled long and hard to translate the missive, finally settling on the wording "§HWell sparred, alien, but this is just the beginning§!".

It appears that this curious exchange has resulted in the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! (as we now know them to be properly called) seeing us as §Hrivals§!, or at least potential rivals. We can only assume that they are already preparing for the possibility of war with our [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName].

label.zh: 我们应该对其有所准备。
label.en: We shall be ready for them.

descriptions.zh:
§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!用一封长长的简讯回应我们的传送，[This.Owner.GetLinguists]花了一些时间来翻译。随着我们对外星人语言的理解不断加深，很明显，§H[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!（我们现在知道他们叫这个）对我们的 "§H光荣姿态§! "发出了非常花哨的赞赏，把我们当作朋友来问候。

看来，这种奇特的交流在他们眼里证明了我们的勇气，让他们相信我们是星系舞台上值得信赖的伙伴。
descriptions.en:
The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! responded to our transmission with a lengthy missive, which took our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] some time to translate. As our understanding of the aliens' language grew, it became clear that the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! (as we now know them to be properly called) sent us a very flowery appreciation of our "§Hhonorable gesture§!", greeting us as friends.

It appears that this curious exchange has proven our mettle in their view, and convinced them that we are worthy partners on the galactic stage.

label.en: The beginnings of a beautiful friendship...

descriptions.zh:
过了一会儿，§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的热烈气氛逐渐平静下来。我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]渐渐能够理解这些信号，最终能够确定他们是§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!，并对他们古怪的行为作出解释。

事实证明，[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是一个§H好战§!的物种，他们最看重他们所说的“战士精神”。由于表现不当，我们在他们眼中显得非常低级——像是§H懦夫§!。看来这个臭名声我们还得背负一段时间……
descriptions.en:
After a while, the enthusiasm of displays by the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! vessel declined. Over time, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] grew better at understanding their signals, eventually identifying them as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! and presenting an interpretation of their odd behavior.

It turns out that the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are a §Hwarlike§! species who value above all else what they call the "warrior spirit". By failing to respond appropriately, we displayed ourselves to be of lesser worth - §Hcowards§!, in essence. It seems this reputation will take quite a while to live down...

descriptions.zh:
过了一会儿，§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的热烈气氛逐渐平静下来。我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]渐渐能够理解这些信号，最终能够确定他们是§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!，并对他们古怪的行为作出解释。

事实证明，[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是一个§H好战§!的物种，他们最看重他们所说的“战士精神”。正确的应对方式是做出类似的回应。然而，他们似乎足够宽宏大量，以至于接受了我们对此的无知，甚至开始认可我们面对威胁时的§H冷静§!。
descriptions.en:
After a while, the enthusiasm of displays by the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! vessel declined. Over time, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] grew better at understanding their signals, eventually identifying them as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! and presenting an interpretation of their odd behavior.

It turns out that the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are a §Hwarlike§! species who value above all else what they call the "warrior spirit". The correct response would have been to make a similar gesture back. However, it seems they are magnanimous enough to accept that we could not have known this, and have even come to value our §Hlevel-headedness§! in the face of what seemed like a threat.

label.zh: 很好，把他们的影像接过来！
label.en: Very good. Bring them on screen!

descriptions.zh:
§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的信号的初期解读工作使[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]陷入困惑。它们似乎主要是§H白噪音§!，没有任何可以被识别为语言的东西。有一段时间，人们甚至怀疑我们是否在处理一个智慧物种的语言，尽管有可见的证据表明他们确实使用了某种技术。

只有当我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]试着调整我们的仪器以检测超出我们[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]正常听力范围的声音时，才检测到某种像是语言的东西。不幸的是，这对我们解读工作提出了相当大的§H挑战§!，因为在不借助仪器的情况下，我们根本听不见它们……
descriptions.en:
Initial readings of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! signals left [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] bewildered. They seemed to be mainly §Hwhite noise§!, devoid of anything which could be recognized as language. For a time, there were even doubts as to whether we were dealing with the utterings of an intelligent species, despite the visual evidence of their use of technology.

It was only when our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] experimented with tuning our instruments to detect sounds well outside the normal range frequencies of our [This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural] that patterns indicative of a language were detected. Unfortunately, this poses considerable §Hchallenges§! for our quest to come to understand them, since we will not be able to hear them at all without assistance...

tooltips.zh: 这可能要花点时间……
tooltips.en: This may take a while...

label.zh: 当然，一点额外的投资会有帮助？
label.en: Surely some extra funding will help?

descriptions.zh:
尽管十分困难，我们还是设法破解了§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!所使用语言，从而使初步的沟通成为可能。他们似乎自称是§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!。不可避免地，所有交流只能借助于专门针对其语言的通信系统。

任何试图与他们进行流利的沟通的人都似乎绕不开这个问题，但[This.Owner.GetResearchers]有不同看法。在他的鼓动下，鉴于资金仍有剩余，他们起草了一份提案，意图将这次成功行动的经验应用到更广泛的场合中。他们相信，通过对这里使用的软件进行微调，他们将能够构建出他们所称的§H“通用翻译器”§!，只要提供足够的信息，就能为任何语言进行同声传译。
descriptions.en:
Although it proved a considerable challenge, we have managed to decode the form of communication used by the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! sufficiently to establish preliminary contact. It seems that they call themselves the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!. Inevitably, communication can only happen with the help of communication systems specifically tuned to their language.

This would appear to be problematic for hopes of fluent conversation with them, but our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] see it differently. Buoyed by their success and still benefiting from the extra funding we provided them, they have drawn up a proposal to consolidate our learnings from this experience into something that will be of generally applicable use. They believe that, by fine-tuning the software used here, they will be able to build what they are calling a §H"universal translator"§!, which - if provided with enough information - will be able to instantaneously suggest translations for phrases uttered in any given language.

label.zh: 无限的沟通机会尽在掌控！
label.en: Unlimited communication possibilities are within our grasp!

descriptions.zh: 所谓“万能翻译器”的原型机已经成功制成。虽然其效果相较于[This.Owner.GetResearchers]所设想的那种能够即时对任何未知语言进行翻译的设备打了折扣，但仍不失为对现有翻译系统的巨大改进。光明的前景，即解除与包括[contacted_hummers.GetName]在内的任何接触到的外星人的交流障碍，已摆在眼前。
descriptions.en: Prototyping of the so-called "universal translator" has finished in success. Although the results fall short of the boldest promises of our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] of a device capable of instantly translating even unknown languages, it is a massive improvement over existing translation systems. Already, there are promises of vast boons as barriers to communication with the [contacted_hummers.GetName] and other alien acquaintances are lifted.

descriptions.zh: 尽管十分困难，我们还是设法破解了§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!所使用语言，从而使初步的沟通成为可能。他们似乎自称是§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!。不可避免地，所有交流只能借助于专门针对[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetAdj]语言的通信系统——一种会妨碍流利谈话的东西……
descriptions.en: Although it proved a considerable challenge, we have managed to decode the form of communication used by the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! sufficiently to establish preliminary contact. It seems that they call themselves the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!. Inevitably, communication can only happen with the help of communication systems specifically tuned to the [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetAdj] language - something which rather hinders fluent conversation...

options.script:
name = ON_SCREEN
finish_first_contact_effect = yes
first_contact_inform_intel = yes

descriptions.zh: 对[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的研究越是深入，[This.Owner.GetResearchers]越是困惑。虽然他们显然是有智慧的生物，但他们的交流方式前所未闻。我们所接收到的不是某种基于音频或文本的信号，而是一场由它们的身体或数码设备带来的精彩的炫光表演，其发出的光的光谱还明显超出了[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的可视范围。很明显，要了解它们将是一个重大挑战。
descriptions.en: The more we learn about the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], the more puzzled our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are. Although they are evidently intelligent beings, their transmissions are like nothing we have ever seen before. Instead of some sort of audio or script-based signal, what we are receiving is a brilliant light show - produced by their bodies or digitally - that stretches well beyond the light spectrum [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are able to view unaided. It is evident that coming to understand them will be a major challenge.

tooltips.zh: 这可能要花点时间……
tooltips.en: This may take a while...

label.zh: 当然，一点额外的投资会有帮助？
label.en: Surely some extra funding will help?

descriptions.zh:
我们的努力得到了回报，现在我们基本能够理解[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的语言并与之沟通了。他们自称[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，并说自己从未使用过口语，取而代之的是光线交流。虽然他们过去曾经使用过文字，但其民众认为它远不如视觉语言优雅高效。他们的大脑似乎完全胜任从复杂的图案中快速得出意义的工作，因此在大多数情况下，他们更喜欢使用视觉语言的交流形式。

进一步的研究中，我们惊奇地发现他们的发光模式与进出超空间航道的漩涡相似。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]困惑于这种相似行为的含义，并提议对此进行深入研究。
descriptions.en:
Our efforts have paid off, and we are now able to understand the light signals given off by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] and communicate with them, at least on a rudimentary level. It appears that the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural], as they call themselves, never developed a spoken language and instead used their light displays. Though they used to use a written language, it is considered far less elegant and efficient than their visual language. Their brains seem perfectly adapted to rapidly derive meanings from even complex displays, so that they favor recordings of the latter in most cases.

During our studies, we discovered to our surprise that their patterns of light bear an astounding similarity to the swirls of interstellar space that make hyperlane travel possible. Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are confused as to what this connection may mean and propose further study into the topic.

descriptions.zh:
我们对[encountered_country.GetSpeciesAdj]的漩涡状发光模式和星际空间之间的联系取得了令人惊讶的成果。似乎[encountered_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的发光规则在其不知道的情况下，竟与超空间随着时间的推移而流动的规则暗合，只是规模差别很大。

之后，通过研究[encountered_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们将能够更好地预测超空间的流动，这将极大地扩展我们的传感器的探测范围。
descriptions.en:
Our study into connections between patterns observed in interstellar space and the [encountered_country.GetSpeciesAdj] swirls of light has unearthed surprising results. It seems that the rules by which the [encountered_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] make their light patterns are - unbeknownst to them, apparently - the same as those by which the flows of hyperlane space drift over time, just on a vastly different scale.

It follows that, through studying the [encountered_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we will be able to better predict the flows of hyperlane space - significantly boosting our potential sensor range.

label.zh: 我们面前打开了一个新世界。
label.en: We are now open to new possibilities.

descriptions.zh: 我们的努力得到了回报，现在我们基本能够理解[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的语言并与之沟通了。他们自称[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，并说自己从未使用过口语，取而代之的是光线交流。虽然他们过去曾经使用过文字，但其民众认为它远不如视觉语言优雅高效。他们的大脑似乎完全胜任从复杂的图案中快速得出意义的工作，因此在大多数情况下，他们更喜欢使用视觉语言的交流形式。
descriptions.en: Our efforts have paid off, and we are now able to understand the light signals given off by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] and communicate with them, at least on a rudimentary level. It appears that the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural], as they call themselves, never developed a spoken language and instead used their light displays. Though they used to use a written language, it is considered far less elegant and efficient than their visual language. Their brains seem perfectly adapted to rapidly derive meanings from even complex displays, so that they favor recordings of the latter in most cases.

label.zh: 让我们看看他们有什么要说的。
label.en: Let's see what they have to say.

options.script:
name = first_contact.440.A
finish_first_contact_effect = yes
first_contact_inform_intel = yes

descriptions.zh: 从§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!信号中读取的信息让我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]及其兴奋。尽管这其中没有一个音节是我们能够识别的，但不可否认的是，声音本身是有韵律的，而且听起来莫名地令人感到舒缓。虽然我们无法确定，但[Owner.GetLinguists]坚信这是一首诗歌，对方是在友善地回应我们。
descriptions.en: The readings from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! signals have caused our [Owner.GetLinguists] a great deal of excitement. While not a single syllable is intelligible, the sounds themselves are undeniably rhythmical, and indeed curiously soothing. Although we cannot be sure, our [Owner.GetLinguists] are convinced that it is a form of poetry. They propose we answer in kind.

label.en: Of course. Send back a battle chant!

tooltips.zh:
一旦刀兵齐举，
旌旗拥、百万貔貅。
tooltips.en:
Hark! Let the banners fly -
For now to war we ride

label.zh: 我们可以分享一些关于求索的诗句。
label.en: We can share some fine poetry about discovery.

tooltips.zh: 路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索。
tooltips.en: To strive, to seek, to find... and not to yield.

label.zh: 用一些象征友谊的诗句打动他们。
label.en: Bedazzle them with poetry about friendship.

tooltips.zh: 海内存知己，天涯若比邻。
tooltips.en: Shall I compare thee to a solar wind...

label.zh: 给他们整点稀奇古怪的。

tooltips.zh:
石室诗士施氏嗜狮，
施氏时时适市视狮。
tooltips.en:
Jolifanto bambla o falli bambla
grossiga m'pfa habla horem

label.en: We don't have time for this.

descriptions.zh: 在我们播报了战歌数个小时后，来自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的通讯中断了。他们把舰船远远地开到了有效攻击距离以外。可以认为他们应该是理解了我们信息的主旨，并且对此可一点都不感到高兴。
descriptions.en: Several hours after we broadcast the battle chant, transmissions from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! ceased. Their ship has positioned itself well out of effective attack range. We can surmise that they understood the gist of our message, and were not gladdened by what they heard.

options.script:
name = UNFORTUNATE
set_first_contact_stage = default_end_stage_cautious

descriptions.zh: 就在我们发出信息的数分钟后，来自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的信息发生了变化。内容依旧抑扬顿挫，但不再是和风细雨，而如同激起了惊涛骇浪。听起来像是一首战争的颂歌。他们并没有做出什么敌对的行为，而只是被我们的战歌所打动了而已。我们又发送了起初那首诗的几个不同版本，并且也快速地在整理[This.ContactCountry.GetName]战歌的大纲。
descriptions.en: Within minutes of our transmission, the signals from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! changed. Still rhythmically flawless, they were no longer soothing, but rather upbeat, exciting. Much like a battle chant in fact. No hostile movements were made - they seem contented rather than provoked by our poetry. We have since sent several variations of the first chant, and in return are rapidly collecting a compendium of [This.ContactCountry.GetName] war poetry.

label.zh: 和这个物种真是相见恨晚。
label.en: A species after our own hearts.

options.script:
name = first_contact.460.A
set_first_contact_stage = default_poetry_end_stage

descriptions.zh: 对方对我们诗歌热忱回应：他们发来了一串不间断的长时间通讯，我们可以迅速地构建§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!行文字典。尽管我们还未能辨识这些单词的含义，但这些外星人好像对对应我们诗歌中的平仄清浊得心应手，这也便于我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]理解他们。
descriptions.en: The response to our poem appears to have been enthusiastic: the stream of broadcasts continues unabated, and we are developing a considerable library of §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! compositions. Although we have yet to put meanings to the words, these aliens have proven remarkably adept at matching the pitch and tone of our poems, something which is sure to help our [Owner.GetLinguists] interpret them.

options.script:
name = first_contact.465.A
set_first_contact_stage = default_poetry_end_stage

descriptions.zh: 在几分钟的沉默后，§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的通讯恢复了。尽管还不能理解，但他们的态度发生了明显的转变：我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]称听到了俏皮而扭捏的旋律。虽然有点难以置信，似乎他们在与我们调情。
descriptions.en: After several long minutes of silence, the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! transmissions resumed. Although still incomprehensible, they were markedly different: a melody described by our [Owner.GetLinguists] as playful, almost bashful. Startlingly, it appears that they are flirting with us!

options.script:
name = first_contact.470.A
set_first_contact_stage = default_poetry_end_stage_flowery

name = first_contact.470.B
set_first_contact_stage = default_poetry_end_stage_flowery

descriptions.zh: 焦急等待的过程分秒如年，§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!依旧没有回应。尽管他们不太可能理解我们诗歌的具体含义，但他们好像对里面的情感表达吓住了，开始转用一种更谨慎的态度与我们接触。
descriptions.en: Minutes turned into hours, and still there was no response from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. Though they couldn't possibly have understood the exact meaning of our poetry, it seems they were taken aback by the emotions expressed in it, and are now approaching us in a far more guarded manner.

options.script:
name = UNFORTUNATE
set_first_contact_stage = default_end_stage_cautious

descriptions.zh: §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!以相似的方式回应了：抑扬顿挫的诗歌变成了随机的噪音，模仿着我们的嗓音。很遗憾，我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]表示，对这些声音的解码“完全没有用”，因为现在的这些信号根本没有任何规律可言。
descriptions.en: The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! are responding in kind: rhythmical chants have turned to random noise, mimicking our own incoherent sounds. Despairingly, our [Owner.GetLinguists] describe our efforts to decode these sounds as "completely useless", owing to the fact that it is now impossible to detect any sort of pattern.

options.script:
name = first_contact.474.A
set_first_contact_stage = default_poetry_end_stage_dada

descriptions.zh: 随着我们互相理解的加深，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]或者说§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!对我们的敌意缓和了。尽管仍有侵略性，他们好像把我们视为了乐意进一步交流的“可敬的战士”。至于这会是一段友谊的开端或者是战争的序曲我们仍不得而知，但至少我们已经重温了一遍先祖流传的战争之音！
descriptions.en: As we come to understand each other, hostilities with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] - or rather, the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! - have ceased. Despite their aggression, they appear to consider us "honorable warriors" who they would gladly spar with again. Whether this is the beginning of friendship or a prelude to war remains to be seen, but at least we've been able to brush up on our war chants!

descriptions.zh: 我们的努力有了回报，现在我们能够破译[This.ContactCountry.GetName]，或者准确来说叫§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!向我们发送来的信息了。基于他们的构句方法得知，他们对诗词艺术有着难以想象的执着。这种儒雅风流的沟通方式不仅使我们获得了他们的尊重，同时也让我们充分地了解了他们。
descriptions.en: Our efforts have paid off, allowing us to interpret the missives sent by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], who we now know to be the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!. Based on their compositional style, they place an incredible importance in the poetic arts. By participating in this lyrical exchange, we have not only earned their admiration, but also learned a considerable amount about them during the process.

descriptions.zh: 在冗长而困难的第一次接触流程后，我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]终于认出[This.ContactCountry.GetName]应该被称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!。他们祝贺我们解开了他们的字谜，但看起来对我们花费如此长的时间颇有不满。最后的最后，我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]得以研发出数种新的模式辨识方法，让我们在未来可以更容易破译语言。
descriptions.en: After a long and arduous first contact process, our [Owner.GetLinguists] can now identify the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!. They congratulate us for solving their linguistic riddles, although they seem a little put out with us that it took this long. At the very least, our [Owner.GetLinguists] were able to pioneer several new methods of pattern recognition which should stand us in good stead in the future.

descriptions.zh:
我们的努力有了回报，现在我们能够破译[This.ContactCountry.GetName]，或者准确来说叫§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!向我们发送来的信息了：

“啊，巧夺天工的谄媚。遇到另一个珍视诗歌的物种已是三生有幸，谁曾想到，亲爱的[Owner.GetSpeciesName]，你们竟是如此热情洋溢、乖唇蜜舌。祝福你们的[Owner.GetSpeciesOrganName]。”

信息后面还有许多诸如此类的词句。我们也没法完全确定是该受宠若惊还是直接大吃一惊，但也许我们的关系是有了个不错的开端。
descriptions.en:
Our efforts have paid off, and we can now interpret the missives sent by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], who we now know to be the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!:

"Ah, the fine art of flattery. It is nice indeed to meet another species that appreciates poetry, and especially one as exuberant and adorable as you, my sweet [Owner.GetSpeciesName] - bless your [Owner.GetSpeciesOrganName]."

The message continues at some length in a similar vein. We are not entirely sure whether to be flattered or taken aback, but it seems our relationship is off to a good start.

descriptions.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]在解码§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!语言的过程中取得了一项突破性进展。他们使用的文字系统里包含了将近一千七百万种字符，每个字符恰好可以和红-绿-蓝色值一一对应。尽管颇为费解，我们的语言学家们认为他们是可以破译这种外星语言的，只是还需要再花上一些时间。
descriptions.en: Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have made a breakthrough deciphering the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! language. They use an alphabet consisting of almost seventeen million unique characters, which in turn correspond with a color on the red-green-blue spectrum. Although convoluted, our linguists are convinced they will be able to decipher the alien language. They just need some more time.

descriptions.zh:
通过运用十六进制数位系统，我们的数学家和[This.Owner.GetLinguists]几乎就快要破译§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的色彩语言了。官方也正在起草第一次接触协议。

通过对§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!语言的研究，我们发现他们的文化包罗万象，而且沟通上产生误解的可能性非常高。现在我们必须决定沟通的方针究竟是倾向于他们的逻辑型还是偏向他们的情感表达……
descriptions.en:
By utilizing a hexadecimal positional numeral system, our mathematicians and [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are on the verge of a colorful language breakthrough with the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. Officials are preparing first contact protocols.

Through studying the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! language, we know their culture is vast. The potential risk for misunderstanding is high. Now we must decide if we should appeal to their sense of logic, or to their emotions...

descriptions.zh:
通过运用十六进制数位系统，我们几乎就要破译§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的色彩语言了。第一次接触协议也正在起草中。

我们现在可以选择通过富有文化特质的问候来取悦他们的情感或是尝试进行一种更复杂的但高效的表达方式。
descriptions.en:
By utilizing a hexadecimal positional numeral system, the collective is on the verge of a colorful language breakthrough with the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. We are preparing first contact protocols.

We can now either pander to their emotions with a culturally significant greeting, or we can attempt a more complex protocol to increase potential efficiency.

label.zh: 用音乐与他们打招呼吧！

tooltips.zh: 我们会尝试与[This.ContactCountry.GetName]建立情感联系。
tooltips.en: We will attempt to forge an emotional connection with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName].

label.en: Keep the emotion out of it.

descriptions.zh:
尝试与§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!进行性感层面上的沟通取得了不错的收获。

我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]展示了对他们文化的理解，结果他们对我们表示了暖心的欢迎。任务“漂亮”地完成了！
descriptions.en:
Efforts at connecting on an emotional level with the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! have proven fruitful.

Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] demonstrated an understanding of their culture, and as a result, we have been warmly received. Mission accomplished, with great panache!

descriptions.zh:
以情感为杠杆，我们获得了§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的青睐。

我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]展现了对他们文化的理解，结果他们对我们表示了暖心的欢迎。任务完成。
descriptions.en:
Leveraging emotion, we have gained favor with the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!.

Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] demonstrated an understanding of their culture, and as a result, we have been warmly received. Mission accomplished.

descriptions.zh:
尝试与§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!进行情感层面的沟通产生了灾难性的后果。

我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]没能展示对他们文化的良好理解，反倒是严重地冒犯了他们！
descriptions.en:
Efforts at connecting on an emotional level with the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! have proven catastrophic.

Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] failed to demonstrate an understanding of their culture, and as a result, we have greatly offended them!

descriptions.zh:
尽管借助了情感，我们仍没能获得§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的青睐

我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]没能展示对他们文化的良好理解，反倒是严重地冒犯了他们。
descriptions.en:
Leveraging emotion, we have failed to gain favor with the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!

Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] were unable to demonstrate an understanding of their culture, and as a result, they are deeply offended.

descriptions.zh: §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!在太空中的一艘太空梭靠近了我们。由于没有发生其他事情，我们假设他们希望在远离他们主舰船的地方会面。由于船只尺寸较小，只有我们的[Owner.GetEnvoy][Leader.GetName]被派去，其他外交团队成员留在后方。
descriptions.en: The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! positioned a shuttle close to us in space. Since nothing further happened, we assumed that they wished to meet away from their main ship. The small size of the vessel meant that only our [Owner.GetEnvoy] [Leader.GetName] could be sent, with the rest of the diplomatic team staying behind.

descriptions.zh: 穿梭机配备了精妙的武器系统，外星人已经准备好进行武力对抗。
descriptions.en: The shuttle is outfitted with elaborate weapon systems and the aliens are prepared for a violent confrontation.

descriptions.zh: 太空梭讲究实用，体积很大。显然功能比外观的优先级更高。
descriptions.en: The shuttle is utilitarian and bulky. Function has clearly been prioritized over form.

descriptions.zh: 太空梭上装饰着精美的装饰品和金色的铆钉。显然，它的设计旨在通过奢华的展示给人留下深刻的印象。
descriptions.en: The shuttle is covered in elaborate ornaments and golden rivets. It is clearly designed to impress with a display of opulence.

descriptions.zh: 外星人的太空梭和我们的设计款式很类似，这在某种程度上让人舒心。
descriptions.en: The alien shuttle is similar to our own designs, which is reassuring in a way.

descriptions.zh: [Leader.GetName]返回报告说，没有来自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的人接见[Leader.GetHimHer]。
descriptions.en: [Leader.GetName] returned to report that no one from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! met [Leader.GetHimHer].

descriptions.zh: 无人驾驶的太空梭内设有一个中央会议室。地面和墙壁覆盖着柔软的材料，而来自外星世界的平静自然声响则从隐藏的扬声器中播放出来。
descriptions.en: The pilotless shuttle contained a central meeting room. The floor and walls were covered in a soft material, while calming natural sounds from an alien world played from hidden speakers.

descriptions.zh: 无人驾驶的太空梭内设有一个中央会议室，其中一端有一个水池。外星符号环绕着水池周围的地板。
descriptions.en: The pilotless shuttle contained a central meeting room with a pool of water in one end. Alien symbols surrounded the floor around the pool.

descriptions.zh: 无人驾驶的太空梭内设有一个中央会议室，其装修风格既低调又奇异地给人一种庄严的感觉。墙壁的角度和装饰设计旨在将观者的注意力引向一个高高的讲台。
descriptions.en: The pilotless shuttle contained a central meeting room with an architectural style that was at the same time understated and oddly imposing. The angles of the walls and their ornamentation were designed to draw the viewer's attention towards a raised dais.

descriptions.zh: 无人驾驶的太空梭内设有一个中央会议室，令人惊讶的是，它非常朴素，缺乏任何装饰或装饰品。
descriptions.en: The pilotless shuttle contained a central meeting room that was surprisingly nondescript and lacking in decoration or adornment of any kind.

descriptions.zh: 有一面墙上装满了记录设备和传感器。站在冷漠的机器前，[Leader.GetName]概述了我们物种的历史和文化。演示没有得到任何回应。[Leader.GetName]感到十分沮丧，只能留下一个视频平板离开，平板中包含了大量历史记录和我们语言使用的入门指南。
descriptions.en: One wall was covered in recording equipment and sensors. Standing before the impassive machines, [Leader.GetName] outlined our species' history and culture. The presentation was met with silence. Frustrated, [Leader.GetName] left behind a video tablet with a vast collection of historical records and primers in our language.

descriptions.zh: 单方面的沟通让外交团队遭受巨大的挫折。他们渴望成功的第一次接触，为此他们在没有任何事实基础的情况下，制定了分支预测策略来指导剩余的接触流程。
descriptions.en: The one-sided communication greatly frustrated the diplomatic team. Eager for a successful first contact, they created branching prediction strategies for the remaining procedure without any factual information to inform the approach.

descriptions.zh: 在登陆太空梭进行展示之后，紧接着是一阵焦虑，连[Leader.GetName]都公开怀疑[Leader.GetHeShe]是否成功地进行了介绍汇报。
descriptions.en: An anxious wait followed the presentation aboard the shuttle, with [Leader.GetName] openly doubting if [Leader.GetHeShe] had made a successful introduction.

descriptions.zh: 幸亏来自[Leader.GetName]的直接命令阻止了第一次接触流程升级演变为暴力事件。对于团队来说，外星人持续的沉默无疑是一种侮辱。
descriptions.en: Only the direct orders of [Leader.GetName] prevented the first contact protocol from escalating to violence. To the team, the obstinate silence of the aliens was nothing short of insulting.

descriptions.zh:
几个小时后，§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!用我们的语言传达了一条简短的信息：

“我们对你们的文化没有产生深刻印象。就这些吗？[Owner.GetEnvoy]有最后一次机会在你们选择的领域中给我们留下深刻印象。”
descriptions.en:
After several hours, the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! transmitted a short message in our language:

"We are not impressed with your culture. Is this all? The [Owner.GetEnvoy] has a final chance to impress us in a field of your choosing."

tooltips.zh: 先出手。狠出手。
tooltips.en: Hit first. Hit hard.

tooltips.zh: 他们肯定讲得通道理。
tooltips.en: They must listen to reason.

tooltips.zh: 树立我们的文化自信，让他们自惭形秽。
tooltips.en: Boost us up and put them down.

descriptions.zh:
[Leader.GetName]从§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!返回了！尽管伤痕累累，但却载誉而归。

从一个隐藏的门中，一名外星战士突然现身并开始同我们的[Owner.GetEnvoy]展开搏斗，直到筋疲力尽。在最后一丝力量的召唤下，[Leader.GetName]设法制服了[Leader.GetHisHer]的对手。

不到一个小时，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]发送了一条信息：

“[Leader.GetName]将被记录在我们的史册中，作为一位伟大的战士。”
descriptions.en:
[Leader.GetName] returned from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! shuttle injured, but victorious.

From a hidden door, an alien fighter emerged and proceeded to batter our [Owner.GetEnvoy] to the point of exhaustion. Summoning a last surge of strength, [Leader.GetName] managed to subdue [Leader.GetHisHer] opponent.

Within the hour, the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] sent a message:

"[Leader.GetName] will be entered into our annals as a great warrior."

descriptions.zh:
[Leader.GetName]迷惑地从§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的太空梭返回，没有找到对手。在一个小时内，§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!发送了一条消息：

“你们野蛮的做法让我们感到失望。对于一个开化的文明来说，进行肉体上的战斗是非常不合适的。”
descriptions.en:
[Leader.GetName] returned from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! shuttle confused, having found no opponent. Within the hour, the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! sent a message:

"Your barbaric ways disappoint us. A physical fight would be most unbecoming for a civilized culture."

descriptions.zh:
[Leader.GetName]满怀信心地从§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的太空梭返回。[Leader.GetHeSheCap]在感应墙前为我们的情况辩论时，忘却了时间的概念，全面地解释了历史决策的各种原因以及我们作为一个文化如何学习和成长。

不到一个小时，§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!发来了一条消息：

“尽管你们过去经历了困难，但你们取得了巨大的成长。你们的文化是一个鼓舞人心的榜样。”
descriptions.en:
[Leader.GetName] returned from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! shuttle brimming with conviction. [Leader.GetHeSheCap] had lost track of time arguing our case in front of the sensor wall, explaining the reasons for historical decisions and how we've learned and grown as a culture.

Within the hour, the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! sent a message:

"Despite your troubled past, you have grown spectacularly. Your culture is an inspiration."

descriptions.zh:
[Leader.GetName]失望地从§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的太空梭返回。[Leader.GetHeSheCap]在感应墙前花了一个多小时，事无巨细地介绍我们的文化，并辩论我们历史决策的正确性。

不久之后，§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!发来了一条信息：

“你所叙述的历史展示的是你的文化的贫瘠。”
descriptions.en:
[Leader.GetName] returned from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! shuttle disappointed. [Leader.GetHeSheCap] spent over an hour at the sensor wall presenting our culture in greater detail and arguing for the rightness of our historical decisions.

Shortly thereafter, the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! sent a message:

"The history you describe paints a poor picture of your culture."

descriptions.zh:
[Leader.GetName]从§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的穿梭机上兴高采烈地回来了。描述我们过去和未来的即兴歌词自由地传唱着，这是由我们的[Owner.GetEnvoy]诗人在两者之间创造出了令人惊讶由具有启发的联系。

不到一小时，§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!发来了一条消息：

“你们的文化非常辉煌，我们对这场表演表示赞赏。”
descriptions.en:
[Leader.GetName] returned from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! shuttle in a great mood. The improvised lyrics describing our past and future had flown freely, with our [Owner.GetEnvoy]-poet making associations both surprising and illuminating.

Within the hour, the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! sent a message:

"Your culture is most splendid and we applaud the performance."

descriptions.zh:
[Leader.GetName]从§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的太空梭返回，[Leader.GetHisHer]的音乐表演让自己感到很不满。我们过去的行为与我们当前的自我认知之间的不和谐使得歌词的联想变得平淡无奇。

不到一小时，§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!发来了一条消息：

“我们对一次重要的思想交流会被平庸的韵律破坏感到失望。”
descriptions.en:
[Leader.GetName] returned from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! shuttle dissatisfied with [Leader.GetHisHer] musical performance. The dissonance between our past actions and our current self-conception made the lyrical associations fall flat.

Within the hour, the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! sent a message:

"We are disappointed that a momentous meeting of minds was spoiled by middling rhymes."

options.script:
name = first_contact.5095.a
finish_first_contact_effect = yes
first_contact_inform_intel = yes

descriptions.zh: 显然，我们的回应不合时宜：§Y[contact_country.GetName]§!的反应快速而充满敌意，他们开始向我们的舰船开火。似乎我们必须依靠自己的[Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]来回敬他们了。
descriptions.en: Clearly, our response was not the appropriate one: the response of the §Y[contact_country.GetName]§! was swift and hostile, as they began firing on our ships. It seems we have a fight on our [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]!

options.script:
name = first_contact.500.A
custom_tooltip = first_contact.500.A.tooltip

tooltips.zh: §Y[contact_country.GetName]§!将与我们敌对。
tooltips.en: The §Y[contact_country.GetName]§! are now hostile to us.

descriptions.zh: 好像§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!听完我们的战歌以后生气了。他们的几乎瞬间回以暴力。他们的武器开始开火，我们的舰船很幸运地全身而退。看来一场大战是不可避免了。
descriptions.en: It appears the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! took offense to our battle chant. Their response was instantaneous - and violent. They began firing, and our vessel was fortunate to escape unharmed. It seems we have a fight on our hands!

descriptions.zh: 我们实在不知道搞错了什么，§Y[contact_country.GetName]§!突然就向我们发起了攻击！看来我们必须靠自己的[Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]回敬他们了！
descriptions.en: It is not clear what went wrong, but the §Y[contact_country.GetName]§! are suddenly attacking us! It seems we have a fight on our [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]!

options.script:
name = first_contact.500.A
custom_tooltip = first_contact.500.A.tooltip

tooltips.zh: §Y[contact_country.GetName]§!将与我们敌对。
tooltips.en: The §Y[contact_country.GetName]§! are now hostile to us.

descriptions.zh: 对于在§H[contact_country.GetName]§!中俘获的飞船的研究已经结束。尽管因为没有抓到活口来审讯而使调查充满挑战，但我们快速的进程可能使我们得以和[contact_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]建立通信。我们的[Root.GetResearchers]研究员可以研究他们的§H科技§!，这能帮助我们在研究突破上找到全新的思路。
descriptions.en: We have concluded our study of the equipment we recently captured from the §H[contact_country.GetName]§!. Although investigating it was a challenge without living specimens to interrogate, faster progress could be made once communications were opened with the [contact_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Our [Root.GetResearchers] were able to study their §Htechnology§!, which has helped us uncover several novel new approaches to our own research problems.

descriptions.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的§H[contact_country.GetAdj]§!外星人的研究。这些人质相当不愿意同我们合作，不过由于我们已将其开膛破肚，他们的反抗毫无意义。现在我们对他们的[contact_country.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural]、[contact_country.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]和[contact_country.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]的内部功能以及其他身体部分有了极大的了解，我们的基因学家[Root.GetResearchers]获得了相当有价值的§H异种生物学数据§!。

由于我们残忍行为带来的恐怖，一部分[contact_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始在我们翻译他们语言并接入电脑系统时表现出了合作的态度。作为结果，我们现在拥有了数量相当可观的情报，如果有需要，我们可以利用这些情报对付他们。
descriptions.en:
We have concluded our study of the §H[contact_country.GetAdj]§! aliens we recently captured. The hostages proved unwilling to cooperate with us, but this became a moot point as we began to cut them open. We now know a great deal about the internal functions of their [contact_country.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural], [contact_country.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural], [contact_country.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] and other body parts, giving our genetics [Root.GetResearchers] valuable §Hxenobiological data§!.

Driven to terror by the cruelty of our actions, a handful of the [contact_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] cooperated with us as we sought to translate their language and access their computer systems. As a result, we now have considerable intelligence we are able to deploy against them, should the need arise.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { event_target:contact_country = { is_regular_empire = yes } }

descriptions.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的§H[contact_country.GetAdj]§!外星人的研究。随着两国之间通讯频道的相互公开，事实已经很明显，对方的组织结构是一个§H蜂巢思维§!，子个体没有独立行动和决策的能力。尽管审讯对他们毫无用处，但是我们对其开膛破肚，使得我们对其有了诸多方面的了解。我们现在对他们的[contact_country.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural]、[contact_country.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]和[contact_country.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]的内部机能以及其他身体部分有了更多的了解，我们的基因学家[Root.GetResearchers]获得了相当有价值的§H异种生物学数据§!。

尽管花费的时间比我们原先希望的要更长，我们获得的生物学知识帮助我们破译了他们的语言——还有他们的计算机代码。若是局势需要，我们可以部署相当数量的情报来对抗他们！
descriptions.en:
We have concluded our study of the §H[contact_country.GetAdj]§! aliens we recently captured. As became apparent when they opened communications with us, they are indeed organized as a §Hhive mind§!, with individual drones lacking autonomy or agency. Although they proved unuseful subjects for interrogation, this became a moot point as we began to cut them open. We now know much about the internal functions of their [contact_country.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural], [contact_country.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural], [contact_country.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] and other body parts, giving our genetics [Root.GetResearchers] valuable §Hxenobiological data§!.

Though it took a bit longer than we might have hoped, the biological knowledge we gained helped us to crack their language - and their computer codes. We now possess considerable intelligence to deploy against them, should it prove necessary!
descriptions.condition: trigger = { event_target:contact_country = { is_hive_empire = yes } }

descriptions.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的§H[contact_country.GetAdj]§!机器的研究。一旦切断同人工智能主体的联系，这些无人机就失去了执行能力，无法提供与它们自己的协议相关的信息。不过当我们将它们大卸八块，我们就又获得了一定的进展——不仅是在了解它们的内部语言方面，也在找出有关它们的更多知识方面。其结论是，它们使用的处理器还是比不过我们针对它们使用的数据侵入收集技术，现在它们已经没剩下多少秘密了。

我们现在掌握了数量可观的情报，它们将被投放在合适的时机，来对付它们的人工智能主体——§H[contact_country.GetName]§!。
descriptions.en:
We have concluded our study of the §H[contact_country.GetAdj]§! machines we recently captured. Once cut off from their parent AI, the drones lacked agency and gave off little useful information of their own accord. Once we began dissembling them, we were able to make more progress - both in understanding their internal functioning, and in finding out more about them. It turned out their processors were no match for the invasive data gathering techniques we used on them, with the result that little about them is now secret to us.

We now possess considerable intelligence to deploy against their parent AI, the §H[contact_country.GetName]§!, should we see fit.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { event_target:contact_country = { is_machine_empire = yes } }

tooltips.zh: 我们对于他们内部器官的知识可以在§H谍报行动§!中起到作用
tooltips.en: Our knowledge of their internal organs will be of use during §HEspionage Operations§!

descriptions.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!外星人的研究。最初这些人质不太愿意与我们合作，但随着时间推移他们在无意中不断地给了我们有关他们语言的线索，一直到我们能够与他们进行基础的语言交流。从那时起，我们就能迅速拼凑有关他们的细节，一旦有一位或是更多的人质愿意合作，我们就能进入他们的电脑系统。

得益于从他们身上收集到的信息，我们能够确认他们来自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!，并就其活动和军事实力收集到了相当多的情报。
descriptions.en:
We have concluded our study of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! aliens we recently captured. The hostages were initially unwilling to cooperate with us, but over time they inadvertently gave us clues to their language, until we were able to communicate with them on a basic level. From that point, we were rapidly able to piece together further details about them, eventually gaining access to their computer systems once one of the more cooperative hostages cracked.

Thanks to the information we have gleaned from them, we are able to identify them as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! and have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

descriptions.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的§H[contact_country.GetAdj]§!外星人的研究。这些人质显然意志薄弱，没什么阻止我们对其调查的想法。事实上，他们十分配合。我们很快就能说服他们让我们登入他们的电脑系统。

得益于这些信息，我们搜集到了关于他们国家活动和军事实力方面的大量情报。
descriptions.en:
We have concluded our study of the §H[contact_country.GetAdj]§! aliens we recently captured. The hostages were remarkably weak-willed and showed no particular desire to keep us from finding out about them; indeed, they proved extremely cooperative. Before long, we were able to persuade them to grant us access to their computer systems.

Thanks to the information we have gleaned from them, we have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

descriptions.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的§H[contact_country.GetAdj]§!外星人的研究。这些人质表现出了极其不配合的态度，抗拒几乎所有的审讯方式。不管怎样，当我们同[contact_country.GetName]建立了通讯，我们还是取得了一些进展——其中包括获取了他们基础电脑系统的一些权限——我们“说服”了他们，让我们登录他们的电脑系统，尽管我们猜测他们能保留许多细节。

得益于这些信息，我们搜集到了关于他们国家活动和军事实力方面的大量情报。
descriptions.en:
We have concluded our study of the §H[contact_country.GetAdj]§! aliens we recently captured. The hostages proved remarkably unwilling to cooperate with us, resisting even the most persuasive methods of our interrogators. However, once communications were established with the [contact_country.GetName], we were able to make some progress - including gaining access to some of their basic computer systems - although we suspect that they were able to keep many details back. Before long, we were able to "persuade" them to grant us access to their computer systems.

Thanks to the information we have gleaned from them, we have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

descriptions.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的§H[contact_country.GetAdj]§!机器的研究。一旦切断同人工智能主体的联系，这些无人机就失去了执行能力，并且因为其功能迅速退化，被发现几乎完全失去了作用。

幸运的是，我们想办法破解了他们的电脑系统的秘钥，[This.Owner.GetLinguists]马上就能翻译他们用来通讯的信号。现在，我们已经能够确认§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!是§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!，。我们现在积累了大量有关他们活动和能力的情报。
descriptions.en:
We have concluded our study of the §H[contact_country.GetAdj]§! machines we recently captured. Once cut off from their parent AI, the drones lacked agency, and we were able to find out little of use from them as their functionality rapidly degraded.

Fortunately, we were able to crack the codes to their computer systems, and our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] were soon able to translate the signals they use for communication. As a result, we can now identify the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! and have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

descriptions.zh:
我们结束了对于此前捕获的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!外星人的研究。看上去它们确实是由§H蜂巢思维§!所链接起来的，单独的子个体是缺少自我意识和代理权的。将其从主体意识剥离后，这些子个体似乎漫无目的，然后一个接一个地死去。除了将其作为生物标本外也没什么其他地作用了。

幸运的是，我们想办法破解了他们的电脑系统的秘钥，[This.Owner.GetLinguists]马上就能翻译他们用来通讯的信号。现在，我们已经能够确认§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!是§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!，。我们现在积累了大量有关他们活动和能力的情报。
descriptions.en:
We have concluded our study of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! aliens we recently captured. It would appear that they are indeed organized as a §Hhive mind§!, with individual drones lacking autonomy or agency. Cut off from the body, the drones seemed aimless and died off one by one, not yielding much in the way of useful information except as unwitting biological specimens.

Fortunately, we were able to crack the codes to their computer systems, and our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] were soon able to translate the signals they use for communication. As a result, we can now identify the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! and have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

descriptions.zh:
§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!停靠在我们舰队边上，广播着重复的信号。

翻译这些信息颇具挑战，但我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]相信他们是在邀请我们派出一位代表去往他们的舰船上参加一场持续多日的文化交流活动。
descriptions.en:
The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! drew alongside our fleet, broadcasting a repeating signal.

It was a challenge to translate their message, but our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] believe they are inviting one of our representatives to a multi-day cultural exchange event on their ship.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { is_nomadic = yes } }

descriptions.zh:
§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!派遣了一艘舰船到我们的边境上，广播着重复的信号。

翻译这些信息颇具挑战，但我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]相信他们是在邀请我们派出以为代表去往他们的舰船上参加一场持续多日的文化交流活动。
descriptions.en:
The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! stationed a vessel at our border, broadcasting a repeating signal.

It was a challenge to translate their message, but our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] believe they are inviting one of our representatives to a multi-day cultural exchange event on their ship.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { is_nomadic = no } }

tooltips.zh: 我们会派我们的特使去参加活动。
tooltips.en: We will send our envoy to the event.

tooltips.zh: 我们会拒绝该邀请。
tooltips.en: We will decline the invitation.

descriptions.zh:
[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]和我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]连蒙带猜地接受了外星人的文化交流邀请。§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的热烈反应应该是积极的。不久之后，他们发来了表示派对倒计时的象形文字。

[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]正在利用剩余的时间准备并进一步学习我们目前获得的语言样本。
descriptions.en:
With a little bit of guesswork, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] and our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] accepted the alien cultural exchange invitation. We interpreted the enthusiastic response from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! as positive. Shortly after, they sent pictographs depicting a countdown to the party.

[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] is using the remaining time to prepare and further study the language samples we have obtained.

label.zh: 这是不可多得的学习机会。
label.en: This is a unique learning opportunity.

tooltips.zh: 我们会为邀请做好准备。
tooltips.en: We will prepare for the invitation.

label.zh: 这是一个秘密收集信息的绝佳机会。
label.en: This would be a perfect chance to covertly gather intel.

tooltips.zh: 我们同意参会，但会让特使装备上间谍科技。
tooltips.en: We agree, but will equip our envoy with our spy tech.

descriptions.zh: §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!文化交流活动的倒计时马上就到尾声了。[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]很快就要登上前往外星特使舰船的太空梭。出于尊重，宴会期间与我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy]的通讯将会暂停。
descriptions.en: The countdown to the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! cultural exchange event is nearing completion. [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] is about to board the shuttle to the alien envoy ship. Communication with our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] will pause for the duration of the party out of respect.

label.zh: 我们应该尽可能地融入他们的文化。
label.en: We should embrace their culture as best as possible.

tooltips.zh: 我们的特使将会试着与他们的文化保持一致。
tooltips.en: Our envoy will try to integrate with their culture.

label.zh: 表现得热情又专业就行。

tooltips.zh: 我们的特使会以专业的态度行事。
tooltips.en: Our envoy will act professionally.

tooltips.zh: 我们的特使将会尽可能地获取情报。
tooltips.en: Our envoy will learn as much as they can.

descriptions.zh:
我们对§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的邀请不闻不问冒犯到了他们。他们的态度发生了一百八十度大转弯。在后续的通讯中我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]翻译出了一些敌意性的言辞。

他们似乎不想要我们拒绝。
descriptions.en:
Our lack of interest in their invitation has offended the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. Their tone has dramatically changed. Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] translated some hostile language within their follow-up communication.

It seems they do not want to take no for an answer.

label.zh: 很好很好。我们会出席的。

tooltips.zh: 我们终究会为了顺畅的外交关系出席的。
tooltips.en: We will attend, after all, for the sake of smooth diplomatic relations.

tooltips.zh: 我们没有任何理由接受这个邀请
tooltips.en: We will in no way accept the invitation.

descriptions.zh:
§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的活动持续的时间远超预期。

[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]的太空梭返回时汇报了任务失败。

在活动过程中，主办方找到了谍报装置。[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]遭到了审问和训斥，并被遣返。通过后备间谍科技获取的数据，我们现在理解了他们的语言和科技，然而我们的外交前景一片渺茫。
descriptions.en:
The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!'s event lasted much longer than expected.

When [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName]'s shuttle returned, they reported that the operation failed.

During the event, the hosts found an espionage device. [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] was interrogated, scolded and then asked to leave. Using the data from the back-up spy tech, we now understand their language and technology, although our diplomatic future will start on rocky ground.

descriptions.zh:
§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的活动举办时间远超预期。

乘坐太空梭返回后，[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]汇报了行动大获成功。不仅这种外星语言被大部分破解了，我们的扫描也揭示了他们科技能力的清晰图景。

这将会极大地促进我们与§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!未来的关系，同时还让他们对我们对他们科技了如指掌一事蒙在鼓里。
descriptions.en:
The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!'s event lasted much longer than expected.

When [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName]'s shuttle returned, they reported that the operation was a success. Not only did they successfully decipher most of the alien language, but our scan has given us a clear picture of their technological capabilities.

This will greatly enhance further relations with the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, without them being aware of our understanding of their scientific knowledge.

descriptions.zh:
敞开心胸来到这场持续多日的盛会，[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]参加了音乐、戏剧和舞蹈的表演，并尝试了许多餐饮传统。他们对各种体验的接受得到了§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的热烈欢迎。

离开时，[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]对他们的语言获得了非常深切的理解，对他们的文化也颇为赞赏。这段经历将会为我们未来与§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!更加积极正面的外交奠定基础。
descriptions.en:
Entering the multi-day event with an open mind, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] joined in musical, theater, and dance performances and explored various culinary traditions. Their receptiveness to experience was met enthusiastically by the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!.

[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] has left with an intimate understanding of their language and a deep appreciation of their culture. Their experience will pave the way to more positive diplomatic interactions with the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!.

label.zh: 来自新朋友的邀请真是亲切啊。
label.en: A kind invitation from new friends.

descriptions.zh:
[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]在这场持续多日的活动中客气地参观着文艺活动，小试着他们的饮食文化。不温不火的态度让§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!颇感沮丧。根据我们对他们语言的理解，他们说我们的特使“很无聊”。

我们的特使被护送回到太空梭上并被示意离开。特使已经掌握了他们的语言，并对他们的文化有了初步的了解，我们可以在未来的外交互动中以此为基础。
descriptions.en:
[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] spent the multi-day event reservedly observing artistic shows and sampling the culinary traditions. The lack of enthusiasm frustrated the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. According to our understanding of their language, our envoy was considered boring.

Escorted back to their shuttle and signaled to leave, our envoy has left with competence in their language and a surface understanding of their culture, something we can build upon for future diplomatic interactions.

descriptions.zh:
在这场持续数天的活动这，§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!对营养需求的差异的沮丧显而易见。幸好[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]还是积极参与到了其他的娱乐活动中，并建立了互相的尊重。

[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]离开时对§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的语言文化获得了基本的了解。值得赞扬的是，他们似乎对这一饮食灾难泰然自若，并为我们提供了许多礼仪手册。虽然乏味，但这些知识应该有助于顺利进行未来的外交互动。
descriptions.en:
The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!'s disappointment in the difference between our nutritional needs couldn't have been more apparent over the multi-day event. Thankfully [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] did their best to take an active part in the entertainment events, and mutual respect was established.

[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] has left with a decent understanding of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!'s language and culture. To their credit, they seemed to take this culinary mishap in stride, and have provided us with a number of etiquette manuals. While tedious, this knowledge should help smooth future diplomatic interactions.

label.en: Understanding is the cornerstone of diplomacy.

descriptions.zh:
第二次拒绝§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!让我们前往他们的舰船的邀请得到了情绪激烈的回复。我们收到了一份来自多名外星船员长达数个小时的通讯，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]认为他们似乎是在因我们的不愿出息而发出谴责。

这些通信，加上从他们船上截获的信号，使我们能够破译足够多他们的语言以产生有意义的理解。尽管他们对这一事件持消极态度，但我们现在可以建立更适当的外交关系了。
descriptions.en:
The second rejection by the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! to invite us to their ship was met with a strong emotional response. We received communication from multiple alien crew members for several hours, in what our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] believe was an attempt to guilt us for not attending.

These communications, along with intercepted signals from their ship, have allowed us to decipher enough of their language to have a working understanding. We can now initiate more appropriate diplomatic connections, although they have taken this initial incident negatively.

descriptions.zh:
基于我们与许多外星物种构建通讯的成功经历，我们的一位[This.Owner.GetLinguists]提出了一项激进的举措。虽然过去所有与天龙沟通的努力均不幸失败，[needed_name.GetSheHe]坚称[needed_name.GetSXX]现在是进一步尝试的好机会。

根据我们最古老的历史，[This.Owner.Species.GetName]曾一度与龙建立了传说中的契约，正是由它结束的正面冲突。据此，某种程度的互相理解应该是可以达成的。[needed_name.GetSheHe]指出[needed_name.GetSXX]我们过去与外星生命体之间通讯的成功让我们比起过去任何时候都更有能力理解这条巨龙。
descriptions.en:
Following our successes in establishing communications with a number of alien species, one of our leading [This.Owner.GetLinguists] has brought forth a radical proposal. Though past efforts to communicate with the Sky Dragon have failed miserably, [needed_name.GetSheHe] argue[needed_name.GetSXX] that now is the time to make another attempt.

According to our earliest histories, there was a fabled Accord between [This.Owner.Species.GetName] and Dragon, after which direct conflict ceased. Citing this as proof that understanding on some level is possible, [needed_name.GetSheHe] note[needed_name.GetSXX] that our recent experiences with utterly alien lifeforms make us better equipped than ever before to understand the drake.

descriptions.zh:
在成功与数个外星物种成功建立通讯之后，我们的语言思维处理体得出结论，现在正是我们再次同天龙建立对话的时候。尽管最近的努力均不幸失败，我们依旧模糊地回忆起了过去的片段，彼时我们在古老的冲突之后，同这条龙缔结了和平。

现在我们在同形体完全不同的外星生命体打交道上有了更加丰富的经验，我们相较于过去任何时候，都在理解龙这一方面准备的更加充分。
descriptions.en:
Having established communications with a number of alien species, our linguistic thought processes have concluded that it is time for us to again attempt to converse with the Sky Dragon. Though recent efforts have failed miserably, we dimly recall a past understanding when we made peace with the dragon, following our ancient struggle.

Now that we have more experience in dealing with utterly alien lifeforms, we are better equipped than ever before to understand the drake.

descriptions.zh:
在成功与数个外星物种成功建立通讯之后，我们的语言子例程得出了一个全新的共识：现在正是我们再次同天龙建立对话的时候。尽管最近所有有意义的尝试手段均以失败告终，我们的造物主留下的记录显示，达成某种程度的理解是可能的。毕竟，彼时他们应该发生了战斗，然后同龙缔结了和平，尽管是什么愿意我们不得而知。

现在我们在同形体完全不同的外星生命体打交道上有了更加丰富的经验，我们相较于过去任何时候，都在理解龙这一方面准备的更加充分。
descriptions.en:
Having established communications with a number of alien species, our linguistic subroutines have reached a new consensus: it is again time to attempt to converse with the Sky Dragon. Though past efforts have failed by all meaningful criteria, the records of our creators suggest that understanding on some level is possible. After all, they supposedly fought and then made peace with the dragon, for hitherto unknown reasons.

Equipped with experience in dealing with utterly alien lifeforms, we are now better prepared than ever before to seek to understand the drake.

options.script:
name = INTERESTING
set_first_contact_starting_stage = yes

descriptions.zh:
如楼房大小、长着许多触手的怪物突然出现在§Y[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!让首都失去了秩序。这个生物对于它自己的突然出现似乎和我们一样困惑，毫无抵抗地就被我们捕获拘束了起来。

我们怀疑该生物应该来自外太空，但无法排除是一种本就在我们星球上的未知物种的可能性。无论如何，轨道上确实没有发现任何外星舰船。这个代号§H来客§!的生物的凭空出现，似乎也不是借助的科技手段。

令人困惑（同时它自己也充满困惑）的客人目前被收容在一座研究设施中。
descriptions.en:
The appearance of a building-sized, tentacled monstrosity in the midst of §Y[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! has thrown the capital into disarray. The creature seems as perplexed as we are by its sudden appearance, and has allowed itself to be restrained without resistance.

We suspect the creature to be of alien nature, but we can't discount the possibility of it being an unknown species native to our world. After all, no alien ship has been detected in orbit. The creature - codenamed §HThe Guest§! - materialized out of nowhere, seemingly unassisted by technology.

Our confusing (and confused) visitor is currently being held in one of our research facilities.

descriptions.zh:
如楼房大小、长着许多触手的怪物突然出现在§Y[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!让首都陷入了一片混乱。这只生物似乎和我们一样困惑于它自己的突然出现，毫无抵抗地就被我们捕获拘束了起来。

许多[owner.GetScientistPlural]宣称，代号§H来客§!的这个生物是来自外太空，而其他人则认为这是一种此前尚未发现的物种直至今日才得以为人所知。无论如何，轨道上确实没有发现任何外星舰船。这个生物的凭空出现，似乎也不是借助的科技手段。

令人困惑（同时它自己也充满困惑）的客人目前被收容在一座研究设施中。
descriptions.en:
The appearance of a building-sized, tentacled monstrosity in the midst of §Y[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! has thrown the capital into chaos. The creature seems as confused as we are by its sudden appearance, and has allowed itself to be restrained without resistance.

While many [owner.GetScientistPlural] already claim the creature, codenamed §HThe Guest§!, to be of alien nature, others have suggested it could be a previously unknown species which had until now gone undiscovered. After all, no alien ship has been detected in orbit. The creature materialized out of nowhere, seemingly unassisted by technology.

Our confusing (and confused) visitor is currently being held in one of our research facilities.

label.zh: 我们必须与该生物交流！
label.en: We must talk to this creature!

label.zh: 净化这个入侵我们首都的东西！
label.en: Purge this invader from our capital!
One of us. One of us.

tooltips.zh: §Y万爪之母§!作为一名领袖加入了我们。
tooltips.en: The §YThe Many-Tentacled One§! joins our ranks as a leader.

descriptions.zh: 我们已与[MSI_country.GetName]取得联系。当务之急的事情是，我们必须要小心翼翼地驾驭不断变化的局势。我们应该派遣一名特使来代表我们的利益。无论与我们以前的主人进行任何互动，这肯定会对我们的人民产生深远的心理影响。
descriptions.en: Contact has been made with [MSI_country.GetName]. It's imperative that we navigate the evolving situation carefully. An envoy should be be dispatched to represent our interests. Any interaction with our former masters is sure to have a profound psychological effect on our people.

descriptions.zh:
在§H[This.System.GetName]§!遭遇的外星飞船上得到的数据让我们不寒而栗。它的外观我们再熟悉不过了，上面的徽章宛如我们恐惧的象征：§H弥那玛特种实业集团§!的带翼图章。

我们找到了曾经的侵略者。他们发现我们这些舰船的身份只是时间的问题，因为使用的完全都是他们的科技。新的接触不可避免，但我们绝不会重复过去的错误。
descriptions.en:
Data on the alien vessels we encountered in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! was met with a shudder of recognition. Familiar ship designs, marked by an emblem we learned to fear: the winged logo of the §HMinamar Specialized Industries§!.

Our former invaders have been found. It's only a matter of time until they realize the ships they sighted are ours, fueled by their own technology. A new contact may be unavoidable, but we can avoid repeating past errors.
